title: Retail Seasonal Part-Time Associate, Fabletics (Westfield UTC - San Diego, CA)
description:
Job Description

Fabletics is currently looking for a Seasonal Store Associate for our Fabletics Store at Westfield UTC - San Diego, CA​!

What makes this job FAB?

Join our team as a Seasonal Store Associate and be at the forefront of delivering a best-in-class retail shopping experience! You'll empower our customers to seamlessly connect their online and in-store shopping journeys through innovative, cutting-edge technology. Collaborate with an energetic Store Manager, supportive leaders, and a dynamic team of associates who are all about helping customers live their passion. We're looking for self-driven, high-energy individuals who thrive in engaging with new people. You'll become part of a close-knit crew, united in hitting ambitious goals and driving the business to new heights. Ready to make an impact?

This position will report to the Store Manager and is expected to run for 3-4 months with potential to extend.

How you’ll play to Win

  • Embody our culture and values and providing insight to our customers on how to Live their passion.
  • Actively engage our customers in new and meaningful ways by providing knowledge on the fabrics, features, fit, and function of our product.
  • Drive customer engagement inside and outside of the store environment ranging from store events & promotions to community projects.
  • Communicate inventory and training needs to Store Manager to increase overall customer experience.
  • Maintain store-merchandising guidelines that make the store easy to shop and add value to the customer’s purchase journey.
  • Actively participate to provide and nourish feedback to Store Manager to continuously improve the business.
  • Strive for excellence meeting and exceeding Store objectives as it relates to Performance, Productivity, Efficiency, and Quality standards.
  • Maintain personal sales and achieve sales goals.
  • Maintain all safety and security standards, as well as identify and communicate potential issues.
  • Unpack boxes for inventory as required. Boxes can weigh 10-30 lbs.

What you bring to the team

  • At least 1 year minimum of work experience within a retail environment preferred.
  • Knowledge & familiarity of active lifestyle choices such as Yoga, Cycling/Spin, Pilates, Weight Training, Running, Nutrition and other healthy activities.
  • Ability to socially interact with Customers, Employees and Business Partners inside and outside of the store environment.
  • Ability to work with large teams.
  • Great interpersonal skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Familiar with retail inventory and POS systems.
  • Self-motivated, good communicator.
  • The ability to multi-task, set priorities and work well under pressure.
  • Flexibility in work hours, open to work evenings, weekends, and national holidays.
  • This position involves constant moving, talking, hearing, reaching, grabbing and standing for at least two consecutive hours. May occasionally involve stooping, kneeling, crouching and climbing ladders.
  • Applicants must be 18 years of age or older.

Availability

  • Willing to work onsite and a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Benefits of joining our team

  • The role has a salary between $17.25 - $17.50 hourly depending on experience
  • 70% employee discount on Fabletics Brands
  • Free outfits each month
  • And More!

#LI-Onsite

Initial communication is primarily via official email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. We recruit, employ, compensate, develop, and promote regardless of race, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable. We are one team from many backgrounds, innovating through diversity of individuals, who are driven by passion for creating an inclusive space for all. Fabletics, Inc. will continue to champion a workplace culture that prizes diversity and inclusivity.

title: Sentinel - Staff Engineer Systems - Lead Network Architect - 19581
description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

CLEARANCE TYPE: Top Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Join Northrop Grumman on our continued mission to push the boundaries of possible across land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace. Enjoy a culture where your voice is valued and start contributing to our team of passionate professionals providing real-life solutions to our world’s biggest challenges. We take pride in creating purposeful work and allowing our employees to grow and achieve their goals every day by Defining Possible. With our competitive pay and comprehensive benefits, we have the right opportunities to fit your life and launch your career today.

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems is seeking to hire a Staff Systems Engineer to be the lead Network Architect. This position will be located in Roy, Utah and supports the Sentinel Program. This role may offer a competitive relocation package.

What You'll Get To Do:
This candidate will join the Weapon System Integration (WSI) team under Sentinel Systems Engineering, Integration, & Test (SEIT), working on Network Systems Integration (NSI). Under the guidance of the Sentinel Network Lead, the selected candidate will support the NSI team which works to develop program-wide networking governance and standards, develop and/or synthesize network artifacts at the system level (including cross-segment network interfaces, program network architecture, and network documentation), perform program-wide gap assessments for network development, develop handling plans for any identified issues, and provide networking subject matter expertise to areas such as Major Program Event (MPE) reviews, modeling (architecture, simulation, analysis....), and requirements. NSI team purview includes the deliverable network architecture, incremental/test configs (lab networks), & ITF/MIF/VSFB test networks.

Specific duties include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Use Model-Based Systems Engineering practices to design, test, and verify network capabilities
  • Drive logical/physical network architecture governance, tool standardization, and system-level network architecture development
  • Coordinate with other (SDV and BU) MBSE governance and network developer teams
  • Influence network requirements and interfaces; translate program-level requirements into network-level deliverables
  • Mentor a mid-career architect/assignee on networking systems architecture synthesis and system-level development
  • Support governance adherence for waveform and lower-level OSI network management, protocols, and timing
  • Assess the design, implementation, and maintenance of scalable network infrastructure to include network design, architecture, specifications, cross-segment interfaces, and equipment selection per DoD requirements
  • Support all phases of the systems lifecycle including concept, design, fabrication, test, installation, operation, maintenance and disposal
  • Apply the principles of engineering to design components and systems using applicable standards and specifications
  • Participate in frequent working groups to support iterative development
  • Provide specific and detailed information for hardware and software selection as well as implementation techniques and tools for the most efficient solution to meet business needs, including present and future capacity requirements
  • Create and ensure that appropriate network documentation exists
  • Develop and document technical processes and procedures as needed
  • Recommend and implement system/process enhancements that will improve the performance and reliability of the system
  • Maintain knowledge of current and emerging Industry and DoD trends and technologies in network frameworks, management, and analytics while ensuring proper utilization where applicable
  • Establish and maintain high levels of customer satisfaction according to defined objectives while adhering to established policies
  • Exhibit good communication skills, an energetic approach, and patience with customers

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) discipline from an accredited university and 12 years of experience with Bachelor's degree, 10 with Master's degree, or 8 with PhD
  • Must be a US Citizen with an active U.S. Government DoD Top Secret security clearance with an ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) approval within a reasonable period of time as determined by the company to meet its business need
  • 6+ years of experience with designing, architecting, and deploying complex network infrastructures
  • 6+ years of experience implementing and using model-based systems engineering tools, practices, and methods (including using SysML or UML in Cameo or Rhapsody)
  • 4+ years of experience working with requirements including authoring, allocating, tracing, interpreting, etc...
  • 3+ years of strong program execution skills; demonstrated ability to meet program technical, cost, and schedule milestones
  • 5+ years strong partnership/collaboration skills with demonstrated ability to partner cross-IPT/cross-discipline within a team
  • 4+ years of experience with one or more of the following: C2, physical security, cybersecurity, communications systems, facility design, military aerospace development
  • 2+ years of experience developing network documentation and design planning
  • Familiarity with DoD approved routing/switching platforms, DoD security frameworks, NIST 800-53

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's Degree in a relevant technical specialty
  • 2+ years of experience with DOORS
  • Experience with ICBMs, Missile Programs, Command and Control, or Communications related programs
  • Communication and leadership skills and experience leading small teams in a dynamic work environment
  • Large scale / complex system development experience across multiple phases of a development program: preliminary design, detailed design, integration and test, verification and sell off, transition to production
  • Experience with technical reviews for large-scale and complex system development
  • Demonstrated experience in making sound decisions in uncertain and difficult situations
  • Cisco CCNA, CCNP, or CCIE Certification

Position Benefits

As a full-time employee of Northrop Grumman, you are eligible for our robust benefits package including:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • 401k
  • Educational Assistance
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programs & Work/Life Solutions
  • Paid Time Off
  • Health & Wellness Resources
  • Employee Discounts

This position’s standard work schedule is 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off.

#Sentinelsystems

Primary Level Salary Range: $152,900.00 - $229,300.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

title: Project Management Specialist
description:
Project Management Specialist

The Opportunity:

Are you searching for a position where you can use your project management and analysis skills to develop a project from concept to completion? A program requires a significant investment of limited resources. With that level of complexity, you need to keep the project on a productive path. That’s why we need you, a project management specialist who can help ensure success through careful analysis and effective communication.

On our team, you’ll implement and maintain organizational programs in support of the DoW. You’ll work with key stakeholders to review contracts, project cost accounting, and support overall project cost, schedule, and performance efforts. You’ll help with tactical planning using resources like MS Office suite and regular interactions with functional Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), clients, and project analysts.

You will provide project management support to government clients addressing the cost, schedule, and performance of new technology advancements, insertions, and capabilities as part of larger capability developments. This may involve support through the major capability lifecycle of development, procurement, deployment, implementation, and maintenance efforts. You'll maintain project spending plans, support budget submissions, create and manage stakeholder task letters, generate briefing materials, memorandums, and annual stakeholder agreements, and provide strategic support for classified material and services. You will coordinate with and brief functional Program Office and government SMEs to address project status, performance, risks, and mitigations in support of government clients.

The real impact of project management comes from communication to ensure the program achieves its goals and meets our quality standards. At Booz Allen, we recognize that we must continuously grow as a team to bring the best support to our clients, so here you’ll have all the resources to succeed. This is a chance to influence a meaningful mission while learning how to develop and maintain program strategy.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

  • 5+ years of experience in DoW project management

  • Experience developing or managing a DoW project spend plan

  • Experience generating informational briefs for clients and addressing key issues and challenges impacting expected project results

  • Experience using Microsoft Office tools, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook, and Project

title: Customer Experience Banker - Mahoning Ave Warren, OH
description:

Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Specimen Processor I

Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.

Labcorp is seeking a Specimen Processor I to join our team in Bristol, PA

Work Schedule: Monday – Friday 700pm – 3:30am, and rotating Saturdays

Job Responsibilities:

  • Prepare laboratory specimens for analysis and testing

  • Unpack and route specimens to their respective staging areas

  • Accurately identify and label specimens

  • Pack and ship specimens to proper testing facilities

  • Meet department activity and production goals

  • Properly prepare and store excess specimen samples

  • Data entry of patient information in an accurate and timely manner

  • Resolve and document any problem specimens

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School diploma or GED or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1 year or more experience in lab, accessioning, production, manufacturing, or warehouse

  • Comfortable handling biological specimens

  • Ability to accurately identify specimens

  • Experience working in a team environment

  • Strong data entry and organizational skills

  • High level of attention to detail

  • Experience with MS Office

  • Able to lift up to 40lbs.

  • Able to pass a standardized color blindness test

Are you organized, accountable, and have always gone the extra mile to make sure things are done right? Imagine the impact those skills can have in ensuring the accuracy of millions of healthcare tests, every month. The Specimen Accessioner will be responsible for performing clinical specimen accessioning, sample sorting and data entry in a fast-paced, high-throughput environment according to established standard operating procedures.

title: Freight Handler Part-Time
description:
Starting Rate of Pay: $ 21.16 per hour
Shift Time: 1700-2100

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Transport freight across dock area to/from trailers for loading to trailers.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Perform freight handling using appropriate motorized and manual equipment, including but not limited to: forklift, pallet jack and hand truck.

  • Verify documentation matches freight description (e.g. type, weight, hazardous materials), using current electronic or manual system.

  • Secure freight inside trailers using appropriate tools and supplies (e.g. pallets, straps, rope).

  • Recoup/repair damaged freight when necessary.

  • Verify and complete required documentation and reports.

  • Assist customers with freight and freight documentation as needed.

  • Perform hostling duties if required.

  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures.

  • Perform other duties as required.

DISCLAIMER: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, essential functions and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalent, preferred.

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

  • Prior experience in warehousing, freight handling and/or fork lift operations preferred.

  • If hostler/yard mule duties required, experience preferred.

  • Ability to count and perform basic math, with or without a calculator.

  • Basic written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to lift/carry hand freight of varying weights several times a week, to lift dock plates weighing approximately 100 pounds, and to open trailer doors requiring approximately 75 pounds of lift force, up to several times per day or more.

  • Ability to bend, twist, squat, pushing/pulling freight throughout shift.

  • Ability to work independently and/or as a team member.

  • Previous dock/warehouse experience preferred.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Dock environment; exposure to varied weather conditions, exhaust, fumes, dust, noise.

  • Hours may vary due to operational need.

  • Frequent contact with service center personnel; fast-paced, deadline oriented.

title: Project Manager - Water Transmission & Distribution Networks (Mechanical/Civil Engineer)
description:
Company Overview:

We are a dynamic organization committed to the development, rehabilitation, and expansion of water infrastructure projects across Nigeria. We collaborate with government institutions, NGOs, and donor agencies to deliver sustainable and impactful water supply systems nationwide.


Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager with a background in Mechanical, Civil, or Water Engineering to lead the implementation of water transmission and distribution network projects.

The ideal candidate must have successfully managed similar large-scale pipeline infrastructure projects, including transmission mains, distribution networks, pumping stations, and associated appurtenances. Proven experience handling donor-funded, NGO-sponsored, or government water infrastructure projects is mandatory.

The role requires strong technical expertise in pipeline systems, construction supervision, contract management, and stakeholder coordination. The position involves frequent travel within Nigeria for site supervision and engagement with relevant authorities and communities.


Key Responsibilities:

Project Planning & Execution:

  • Lead the end-to-end implementation of water transmission and distribution network projects.

  • Develop detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, and procurement strategies.

  • Coordinate construction of transmission mains, distribution lines, service connections, and related infrastructure.

  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.


Technical Oversight (Pipeline & Network Systems):

  • Oversee design review and execution of pipeline systems (DI, HDPE, PVC, steel pipelines).

  • Supervise installation of valves, hydrants, air release valves, washouts, chambers, and pumping systems.

  • Ensure proper hydraulic performance, pressure management, and leak prevention.

  • Monitor testing procedures including hydrostatic testing, flushing, and commissioning.


Construction Supervision & Quality Control:

  • Supervise contractors and field teams during excavation, pipe laying, backfilling, and reinstatement works.

  • Ensure compliance with approved drawings, technical specifications, and QA/QC standards.

  • Monitor material quality and installation standards.

  • Enforce environmental, health, and safety compliance on site.


Stakeholder & Donor Management:

  • Serve as primary liaison with government agencies, donor organizations, consultants, contractors, and host communities.

  • Prepare progress reports, risk assessments, and financial updates.

  • Coordinate audits, inspections, and compliance reviews.

  • Ensure adherence to donor safeguard policies and procurement guidelines.


Risk & Contract Management:

  • Identify and mitigate construction and operational risks.

  • Manage contract performance, variations, and claims.

  • Address right-of-way, community, and regulatory challenges effectively.



Requirements

Qualifications & Requirements:

Education & Experience:

  • BSc/MSc in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related field.

  • Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in water infrastructure projects, including substantial experience managing water transmission and distribution network projects.

  • Demonstrated experience handling donor-funded, NGO-sponsored, or government projects is mandatory.


Professional Certification (Compulsory):

  • Registered with COREN (Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria) – Mandatory.

  • Active member of NSE (Nigerian Society of Engineers) – Mandatory.

  • PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification is an added advantage.


Technical Competencies:

  • Strong knowledge of hydraulic principles and pipeline design.

  • Experience with large-diameter transmission mains and urban/rural distribution systems.

  • Familiarity with pumping stations and pressure management systems.

  • Proficiency in project management tools (MS Project, Primavera).

  • Understanding of Nigerian water sector regulations and procurement standards.


Personal Attributes:

  • Strong leadership and field coordination skills.

  • Excellent stakeholder and community engagement abilities.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability.

  • Results-oriented with the ability to manage multiple work fronts.

  • Willingness to travel extensively within Nigeria.




Benefits

Salary: ₦ 600,000 – ₦ 800,000

Northrop Grumman - Launch Vehicles Division is hiring a Systems Engineer Level 5- Airframe IPT Lead located in Chandler, Arizona.

This high-visibility position requires a technical and leadership expert capable of guiding multi-disciplinary engineering teams to design, integrate, and deliver cutting-edge airframe designs for hypersonic environments. The ideal candidate will have exceptional mechanical design and manufacturing expertise, a deep understanding of hypersonic system challenges, and proven program management abilities to balance cost, schedule, and quality.

The Seam Welder will report to the Tank Fab Manager of the facility and have responsibilities for manual welding and inspection. Position

Seam Weld

Location

USA, Camden, SC

title: Rekryteringskoordinator till Ed:Za i Stockholm
description:

Nu söker vi flera nya personer till vårt team. Hos oss får du en viktig roll i det dagliga arbetet och möjlighet att lära dig mer om rekrytering, search och konsultbranschen i en dynamisk och familjär miljö.

Om oss

Vi är ett nytänkande rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag med familjär känsla, korta beslutsvägar och stort engagemang i det vi gör. Vi är ett team som arbetar nära varandra, våra kunder och våra kandidater, där leverans och sälj går hand i hand.

På leveransen är vi ett drivet och positivt team med högt i tak. Vi stöttar varandra, delar erfarenheter och hjälps åt att hitta bra lösningar. När det passar försöker vi vara på kontoret samma dagar, och några gånger om året hittar vi även på något tillsammans, som en AW eller kickoff.

Vi gillar att tänka nytt och vara flexibla. Oavsett om en kund behöver hjälp med en enskild rekrytering eller en större konsultlösning anpassar vi oss efter behov och ser till att hitta rätt person för jobbet.

Hos oss får du även möjlighet att anpassa arbetet efter dina studier. Vi ser gärna att du arbetar 1–2 dagar i veckan och efter din upplärningsperiod finns även möjlighet till hybridarbete. Du får självklart en ordentlig introduktion och onboarding för att komma in i rollen på ett bra sätt, och därefter det stöd du behöver för att utvecklas.

Om rollen

Som rekryteringskoordinator är du en viktig del av våra rekryteringsprocesser och får möjlighet att arbeta brett, allt från att hitta och attrahera rätt kandidater till att bidra i urval, intervjuer och kvalitetssäkring. Vi arbetar främst med roller inom teknik och IT, men även inom bland annat försäljning, ekonomi, administration, HR och kommunikation.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

  • Search och proaktiv kandidatkontakt

  • Screening, urval och telefonavstämningar

  • Intervjuer och referenstagning

  • Framtagning och publicering av annonser

  • Stöd i kund- och rekryteringsprocesser

  • Bidra till att utveckla våra arbetssätt och processer

Rollen är bred och utvecklas i takt med dig. Du börjar med att bygga en stabil grund inom rekrytering och får successivt möjlighet att ta ett större ansvar i våra processer utifrån din erfarenhet, ambition och den tid du har vid sidan av dina studier.

Vem är du?

  • Du studerar inom HR/beteendevetenskap/rekrytering eller annan relevant utbildning/område

  • Helst har du 1-2 år kvar till examen

title: Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Officer
description:
Job Summary:

FHI 360 is seeking a Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) Officer responsible for Maternal, Neonatal and Child Health(MNCH) for the EpiC project to be implemented in Liberia in four counties: Montserrado, Nimba, Lofa, and Bong. Under the supervision of the Technical Advisor for Strategic Information, the Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) Officer will support the implementation and strengthening of Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) systems for Maternal, Newborn and Child Health (MCH), PMTCT, community health, and related health system strengthening interventions under the EpiC project in Liberia.

The officer will support routine data collection, management, analysis, reporting, data quality improvement, and data use activities across supported facilities, communities, counties, and national-level programs.

The role will also provide operational support for health information systems and digital reporting platforms, including DHIS2, Open mSupply, LMIS, and other electronic systems to improve reporting quality, commodity visibility, accountability, and evidence-based decision-making.

The MEL Officer will work closely with the Senior Informatics Officer, program teams, facility staff, County Health Teams, MOH departments, and implementing partners to strengthen data systems, reporting processes, dashboards, supportive supervision, and continuous quality improvement initiatives.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Support the implementation of MEL activities for HIV (PMTCT) and RMNCH health programs.
  • Support routine collection, compilation, validation, analysis, interpretation, and reporting of program data.
  • Assist in preparation and submission of weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual reports.
  • Support tracking and reporting of donor and national indicators, including United States Government (USG), Global Fund, and MOH indicators.
  • Ensure timely, complete, and accurate reporting from supported facilities and community structures.
  • Support maintenance and updating of indicator trackers, reporting tools, and databases.
  • Conduct routine data verification, validation, triangulation, and data quality checks.
  • Support implementation of Data Quality Assessments (DQAs), routine data reviews, and supportive supervision activities.
  • Identify reporting discrepancies, incomplete records, duplicate entries, and inconsistencies, and support corrective actions.
  • Participate in routine data review meetings, situation room discussions, and performance monitoring sessions.
  • Support generation of data summaries, scorecards, dashboards, and presentations to promote data use for decision-making.
  • Document lessons learned, best practices, and key program performance trends.
  • Work closely with pharmacy (health facility – mSupply), clinical, and M&E teams to strengthen commodity reporting and accountability.
  • Support development and updating of electronic data collection tools, templates, trackers, and reporting systems.
  • Conduct onsite mentorship, coaching, and supportive supervision for facility and community-level staff.
  • Provide routine technical assistance to supported sites to improve reporting performance and system use.
  • Assist in generating routine dashboards, charts, graphs, and presentations for program monitoring.
  • Support tracking of key HIV (PMTCT), MNCH, community health, and supply chain performance indicators.
  • Work closely with MOH departments, County Health Teams, facility teams, and implementing partners.
  • Participate in technical meetings, data review sessions, and program coordination activities.
  • Facilitate routine data review meetings and support development of action plans to address identified program performance gaps.
  • Support coordination of MEL activities across HIV (PMTCT), MNCH, and digital health implementation areas.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with stakeholders to support reporting compliance and data improvement initiatives.

Competencies:

  • Knowledge of monitoring, evaluation, and strategic information systems. Understanding of HIV (PMTCT), RMNCH, and community health indicators. Knowledge of data quality assurance and reporting processes. Ability to analyze and interpret routine health data.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, DHIS2, PowerPoint, Word; exposure to Open mSupply or LMIS is an added advantage.
  • Experience with Liberia RMNCH data collection tools and reporting platforms preferred.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
  • Good communication and report-writing skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong mentorship and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in public health, Monitoring & Evaluation, Health Informatics, Statistics, Epidemiology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Health Information Management, or related field.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience in MEL, Strategic Information, health informatics, or health data management.
  • Experience supporting HIV (PMTCT), MNCH, or donor-funded health programs preferred.
  • Experience working with DHIS2, LMIS, Open mSupply, or electronic reporting systems preferred.
  • Experience conducting data quality assessments and supportive supervision activities.
  • Familiarity with Liberia MOH reporting systems and donor reporting requirements is an added advantage.
  • Experience working with county and facility-level health systems preferred.

Typical Physical Demands:

  • Typical office environment.
  • Ability to spend long hours looking at a computer screen and doing repetitive work on a keyboard.
  • Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time.

Technology to be Used:

  • Personal Computer/Laptop, Microsoft applications (i.e., Office 365, SharePoint, Skype/Zoom/Teams), cell phone/mobile technology, and standard office equipment.

Travel Requirements:

  • 10% - 25%

title: Senior Manager, Data Science- Digital Transformation, Manufacturing
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

The Senior Manager, Data Science leads the delivery, growth, and technical direction of applied data science engagements for industrial and manufacturing clients. This is a dual-mandate role to own delivery and commercial outcomes, while developing our team of data scientists, consultants, and engineers.

Reporting to the Principal and Global Lead of Data Science and AI, this remote role sits at the intersection of physical systems and modern AI. The goal is to translate plant-floor and enterprise manufacturing problems into production-grade models. These models include predictive quality, process optimization, model predictive control, digital twin, industrial data operations, and predictive maintenance. The clients operate and sustain these models after we leave. We're delivering solutions on Rockwell's Autonomy stack and best-in-class partner technology.

Client Delivery & Program Leadership

  • Manage delivery escalations and course corrections; enforce objective, measurable acceptance criteria on every deliverable.

Commercial & Account Growth

  • Be a trusted advisor to operations, engineering, and C-suite stakeholders; build and expand executive relationships across priority manufacturing accounts.
  • Lead customer co-innovation opportunities.
  • Lead pursuit and proposal work: shape opportunities, author scope and estimates, and author or review SOWs and change orders with defensible scope boundaries and commercial protection.
  • Carry a sales-support/origination target in partnership with sales/account leadership; convert delivery credibility into follow-on and expansion work.

People & Practice Leadership

  • Lead delivery teams
  • Mentor and train our staff
  • Develop services and software offerings
  • Build reusable assets, accelerators, and methods that reduce delivery cost and raise consistency across engagements.

Technical & Capability Development

  • Grow the practice's applied AI capability in industrial contexts
  • Work with internal groups and ecosystem partners to shape solutions and go-to-market offerings.

  • Typically requires 12+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years in a delivery role.
  • 5+ years in a client-facing consulting, professional services, or internal-consulting capacity, including ownership of engagement scope, budget, and margin.
  • Demonstrated delivery in a manufacturing, industrial, energy, or process-intensive environment.
  • Hands-on depth in the modern ML stack; production experience with time-series, forecasting, optimization, or control-adjacent modeling.
  • Experience deploying models into sustained operation (MLOps, monitoring, retraining, and handover to client teams).

title: Director, Facilities
description:
Director Facilities


Washington, DC | In-Person | $80K - $90K | Washington Post Top Workplace


Join Community of Hope as a Director of facilites. In this role you will maintain facilities in compliance with applicable building, fire, accessibility, workplace safety, environmental health, shelter, and health care regulations. You will provide strategic and day-to-day leadership for planning, operation, maintenance, safety, security, compliance, and continuous improvement of facilities across the agency’s multiple health centers and temporary housing shelters. In addition you will ensure that administrative, program, and community-facing spaces are maintained in good repair, with conditions routinely assessed and confirmed as satisfactory, and that they remain safe, accessible, and welcoming. This position is located at Conway Health and Resource Center in Southwest, DC.


Our Approach and Values:

  • We celebrate people’s strengths and acknowledge the impact of trauma on people’s lives.
  • We embrace diversity, welcome all voices, and treat everyone with respect and compassion.
  • We lead and advocate for changes to make systems more equitable.
  • We strive for excellence and value integrity in all that we do

What You’ll Do

  • Directs daily operations, preventive maintenance, repair, inspection, and long-range planning across health centers, temporary housing shelters, administrative offices, storage areas, outdoor spaces, and supports facilities.
  • Performs regular facility inspections with the goal of visiting each site weekly to check conditions and to ensure that administrative, program, and community-facing spaces are maintained in good repair, with conditions routinely assessed and confirmed as satisfactory, and that they remain safe, accessible, and welcoming.
  • Maximizes the agency’s use of MaintainX as the computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to create, assign, prioritize, and monitor work orders; manage preventive maintenance schedules, inspections, checklists, asset records, documentation, and reporting; promotes timely follow-up, data quality, accountability, and continuous improvement across all sites.
  • Partners with operations, health and shelter leadership, and the Safety/Emergency Preparedness Committee to maintain emergency response plans for power outages, severe weather, utility interruptions, infectious disease concerns, facility incidents, resident emergencies, and other disruptions; schedules and leads emergency drills; serves on BERT (Building Emergency Response Team).
  • In collaboration with the supervisor and key Operations Leadership, provides capital improvement recommendations and works with the Director of Capital/Special Projects, where applicable, to ensure capital improvement projects are completed satisfactorily, on budget, and on schedule.
  • Meets with supervisees regularly and provides real-time feedback, training, support, and coaching as needed. Creates meeting agendas, sends meeting agendas in advance when possible, and documents concerns promptly as needed.
  • Applies principles learned through diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) trainings and/or trauma informed care trainings (TIC) and leads with a DEI and TIC lens when appropriate.
  • Reviews the performance of team members in a timely manner, including completing 90 day and annual performance evaluations per their due dates, documenting any issues or changes, providing recommendations for professional development and/or training opportunities, and recognizing staff when appropriate.
  • Partners with the Talent Management team regarding personnel matters including but not limited to, terminations, leaves of absence, training, onboarding, and other COH handbook policies.
  • If applicable, actively recruits for vacancies with a sense of urgency. This includes reviewing resumes, phone screening, interviewing, and completing references. This also includes partnering with Talent Management for assistance in an effort to fill vacancies promptly.

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.


Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.


About the role:

We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer (Java + React) to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate brings 8+ years of hands-on experience spanning both robust Java Spring Boot backend systems and modern React frontend development — with the technical depth and leadership presence to guide a team through complex, cross-cutting challenges. You are someone who can zoom out to shape architecture decisions and zoom in to deliver production-ready code, all while keeping business goals in focus. You thrive in ambiguity, take end-to-end ownership, and set the engineering bar for those around you. You also bring a forward-thinking mindset — actively embracing AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as tools that make you and your team measurably more effective. You will partner closely with product, design, and cross-functional engineering teams to lead the design, development, and delivery of high-performance, full-stack platform capabilities.


In This Role, You Will:

  • Lead the end-to-end design and delivery of full-stack features, spanning scalable Java Spring Boot microservices on the backend and responsive React applications on the frontend.
  • Drive architectural decisions across distributed systems — applying service decomposition, REST-based inter-service communication, resilience patterns, and frontend component architecture to build cohesive, maintainable platforms.
  • Build and optimize modern React applications with a focus on component reusability, state management, API integration, and frontend performance at scale.
  • Leverage Redis for high-performance caching, session management, and distributed data patterns including pub/sub, sorted sets, and TTL strategies.
  • Develop and tune Oracle Database schemas, queries, and stored procedures to support high-throughput, mission-critical data workloads.
  • Architect and operate cloud-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with a focus on scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Actively use AI coding assistants (such as Claude by Anthropic) as a force multiplier — accelerating development velocity, improving code quality, generating tests, and exploring architectural approaches faster.
  • Champion agentic development workflows — integrating AI-assisted code review, test generation, and documentation into the team's everyday engineering practices.
  • Mentor and technically guide engineers on the team, elevating code quality, design thinking, and engineering culture through hands-on involvement and thoughtful feedback.
  • Own the full delivery lifecycle — from design and development through deployment, monitoring, and production support — with minimal oversight and maximum accountability.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and containerized services, ensuring reliable, predictable releases and a healthy engineering delivery cadence.
  • Act as a bridge between technical complexity and business priorities — translating ambiguous requirements into clear, actionable engineering plans and communicating progress and trade-offs effectively to stakeholders.


Here's What You Need:

Primary Skills:

  • 8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong expertise in Java Spring Boot for building distributed microservices — including service decomposition, inter-service communication (REST), and resilience patterns
  • Strong experience with React for building modern, responsive frontend applications — including component-based architecture, state management, API integration, and performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with Redis for caching, session management, and distributed data patterns (pub/sub, sorted sets, TTL strategies)
  • Proficiency with Oracle Database — schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and cloud-native architectures
  • Hands-on experience with Claude (Anthropic) or comparable AI coding assistants — using them to accelerate development, debug code, and explore solutions faster
  • Familiarity with agentic development workflows — AI-assisted code review, test generation, or documentation — as part of a modern engineering productivity stack
  • Experience building scalable, high-performance backend systems
  • Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, and distributed systems
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerization
  • Strong ownership mindset — able to independently drive features from design to production


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or Terraform
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures and messaging systems (e.g. Kafka, Pub/Sub)
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools (e.g. Datadog, Cloud Monitoring)
  • Exposure to agile development methodologies
  • Experience building or integrating LLM-powered features, AI pipelines, or developer tooling new
  • Familiarity with enterprise application servers — WebLogic and Tomcat — including deployment, configuration, and performance tuning in production environments

We have a vast and ever-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles.

Axalta operates its business in two segments: Performance Coatings and Mobility Coatings, which serve four end markets, including Refinish, Industrial, Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle, across North America, EMEA, Latin America and Asia-Pacific. title: International Education Consultants
description:
International Education Consultants (Cambodia Education Investment Design Programme)

Location: Cambodia / Southeast Asia / International Consultants

Contract Type: Consultancy (project-based, subject to contract award)

About The Opportunity

We are seeking experienced International Education Consultants to support the design of a major donor-funded education investment focused on strengthening lower secondary education, teacher quality, inclusion and education system reform in Cambodia.

The programme aims to identify the most effective approaches to improving learning outcomes, participation and completion in lower secondary education, while strengthening teacher development systems, institutional capacity and inclusive education practices. The assignment will involve education sector analysis, stakeholder consultation, investment option development and preparation of procurement-ready programme design documentation.

The Programme Includes

  • Education investment design and strategic programme development
  • Lower secondary education reform
  • Teacher quality and professional development systems
  • Teacher Education College and workforce strengthening
  • Education systems strengthening and institutional capacity building
  • Monitoring, Evaluation, Research and Learning (MERL)
  • Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI)
  • Localisation and locally led development approaches
  • Climate resilience and continuity of learning
  • Stakeholder engagement with government, development partners and education institutions
  • Development of implementation, governance and delivery models
  • Preparation of program logic, MERL frameworks and procurement-ready documentation.

Expertise We Are Seeking

We are particularly interested in consultants with expertise in one or more of the following areas:

  • Education Investment Design
  • International Education Programme Design
  • Education Systems Strengthening
  • Teacher Workforce Development
  • Teacher Professional Development (CPD)
  • Teacher Education Reform
  • Curriculum and Assessment Reform
  • Education Policy and Planning
  • Monitoring, Evaluation, Research and Learning (MERL)
  • Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI)
  • Inclusive Education and Disability Inclusion
  • Localisation and Institutional Strengthening
  • Education Governance and Reform
  • Education Sector Analysis and Research
  • Climate Resilience and Education Systems

Working Model

These roles are expected to combine:

  • Remote technical support and report production
  • Participation in stakeholder consultations and workshops
  • Collaboration with Ministries of Education and development partners
  • Contributions to programme design documentation and technical papers
  • Engagement with national and international education experts
  • Potential in-country deployment and consultation activities, subject to project requirements

Both international and nationally based consultants may be considered depending on the specialist role.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Provide high-quality technical advice aligned to international best practice in education reform and development.
  • Support education investment design, programme development and strategic planning processes.
  • Translate evidence and research into practical, contextually relevant programme recommendations.
  • Contribute to high-quality technical reports, design documents and analytical products.

Education System Strengthening

  • Support analysis of education systems, institutions and policy environments.
  • Contribute to reform recommendations for teacher quality, educational leadership and system performance.
  • Strengthen institutional capacity and sustainable implementation approaches.
  • Identify opportunities for locally led and system-owned reform.

Programme Design

  • Support programme design processes from inception through to final documentation.
  • Contribute to development of program logic, results frameworks and implementation approaches.
  • Assist in assessing delivery models, governance arrangements and partnership structures.
  • Support quality assurance and peer review processes.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build effective relationships with Ministries of Education, development partners and education stakeholders.
  • Facilitate workshops, consultations and technical discussions.
  • Support co-design and localisation processes.
  • Contribute to programme learning, adaptive management and sustainability planning.


Requirements

Essential Experience & Qualifications

  • At least 10 years' professional experience in education reform, education systems strengthening, programme design, policy development, teacher development, MEL/MERL, GEDSI or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, reviewing or evaluating international education programmes or investments.
  • Experience working with Ministries of Education, government agencies and education sector stakeholders.
  • Experience working on DFAT-funded programmes, education investments, design assignments or similar donor-funded initiatives.
  • Strong analytical, consultation, facilitation and report-writing skills.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Master's degree (or equivalent) in Education, International Development, Public Policy, Educational Leadership, Social Sciences, Monitoring & Evaluation or a related discipline.
  • Additional specialist qualifications relevant to the consultant's area of expertise.

Key Competencies

  • Strong technical advisory and problem-solving capability.
  • Experience working effectively within complex government and donor-funded environments.
  • Ability to translate policy, evidence and international good practice into practical programme recommendations.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation and relationship management skills.
  • Excellent analytical, research and report-writing skills.
  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary and international teams.
  • Commitment to equity, inclusion, safeguarding and locally led development principles.

Language Requirements

  • Fluency in written and spoken English (required).
  • Khmer or another Southeast Asian language would be advantageous but is not essential.

Application Instructions

  • Please Submit
  • CV (maximum 3-4 pages) highlighting relevant assignments and technical expertise.
  • Brief statement outlining your suitability and relevant international education experience.
  • Details of relevant donor-funded assignments, particularly DFAT-funded work.
  • Countries and regions in which you have worked.
  • Availability and proposed daily rate.

We particularly welcome applications from consultants with substantial experience in Cambodia and Southeast Asia, as well as those with strong education investment design and donor-funded programme experience.

title: Electrical PLC Technician 2nd Shift
description:
Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We’re proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Our portfolio includes the iconic Campbell’s brand, as well as Cape Cod, Chunky, Goldfish, Kettle Brand, Lance, Late July, Pacific Foods, Pepperidge Farm, Prego, Pace, Rao’s Homemade, Snack Factory, Snyder’s of Hanover. Swanson, and V8.

Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.

Location: Downers Grove, Illinois

Pay Rate: $40-$43/hour

Shift: 2nd Shift (Generally starts as early as 2:45 PM until finish. Overtime and weekend work as needed. Start times and hours may vary based on production schedules, holidays, and staffing needs.)

Requirement: Strong attendance and punctuality are essential. Employees must remain in position for a minimum of one year and successfully complete a 90-day evaluation period.

HOW YOU WILL MAKE HISTORY HERE…

As an Electrical PLC Technician, you will play a critical role in ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of plant production and utility systems. You will leverage your expertise in electrical systems, PLC programming, instrumentation, and industrial automation to troubleshoot issues, drive continuous improvement, and support world-class manufacturing performance. Your contributions will directly impact equipment reliability, operational uptime, safety, and productivity across the facility.

WHAT YOU WILL DO…

  • Adhere to all company safety programs, policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Troubleshoot, repair, install, maintain, and modify low- and high-voltage industrial electrical, electromechanical, instrumentation, and control systems.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues involving single-phase and three-phase electrical systems up to 600V.
  • Support production and utility equipment by performing preventive maintenance, inspections, and corrective repairs.
  • Identify, recommend, and implement upgrades to outdated or unsafe electrical and control system installations.
  • Document new and existing equipment, power systems, control systems, schematics, and electrical drawings.
  • Support standardization efforts utilizing Allen-Bradley PLCs, drives, HMI systems, and related automation components whenever practical.
  • Perform system startups, operational checkouts, configuration, calibration, grounding verification, wiring validation, and power testing.
  • Reload and reboot PLCs and related control systems following power outages or fault conditions.
  • Size conductors and conduit, install and terminate wiring, fabricate conduit systems, and support electrical infrastructure projects.
  • Assist mechanical maintenance and installation activities as needed.
  • Provide hardware and software support for engineering, maintenance, and operations teams.
  • Troubleshoot and maintain PLCs, HMIs, motor controls, variable frequency drives (VFDs), servo systems, instrumentation, and industrial networking equipment.
  • Utilize equipment manuals, P&IDs, schematics, blueprints, safety documentation, and technical references to diagnose and resolve equipment issues.
  • Help maintain appropriate spare parts inventories for control and instrumentation systems.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to improve equipment reliability, process efficiency, and plant performance.
  • Support the creation and delivery of training programs related to controls, automation, troubleshooting, and maintenance practices.
  • Maintain documentation in accordance with management of change procedures.
  • Direct contractors on larger installation projects as required.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH…

You will collaborate closely with:

  • Engineering and Maintenance Supervisors
  • Maintenance Mechanics and Technicians
  • Operations and Production Teams
  • Process and Controls Engineers
  • Reliability and Continuous Improvement Teams
  • External Contractors and Service Providers
  • Safety and Quality Team Members

While this position does not have direct supervisory responsibility, you may provide technical guidance and direction to contractors and project support personnel during installations and equipment upgrades.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE… (MUST HAVE)

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of industrial electrical, automation, controls, or electromechanical maintenance experience and/or training.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of PLC programming, troubleshooting, and maintenance experience.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of HMI troubleshooting and support experience.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of industrial electrical systems, including AC and DC circuits up to 600V.
  • Experience troubleshooting and repairing electrical, electromechanical, and automated manufacturing equipment.
  • Ability to read, interpret, troubleshoot, and modify electrical schematics, blueprints, and wiring diagrams.
  • Experience using electrical diagnostic equipment, including digital multimeters and related test equipment.
  • Working knowledge of relay logic, motor controls, and discrete control systems.
  • Experience installing conduit, pulling wire, and performing electrical installations in industrial environments.
  • Knowledge of sensors, instrumentation, and process control devices.
  • Experience with VFDs, AC/DC motors, and servo-controlled systems.
  • Understanding of industrial automation networks and communications systems.
  • Knowledge of applicable electrical safety standards and codes, including NEC and NFPA requirements.
  • Ability to troubleshoot equipment using technical manuals, schematics, P&IDs, and system documentation.

Core Competencies

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills.
  • Commitment to safety, quality, productivity, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Dependable attendance and strong work ethic.

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to bend, kneel, crouch, climb, and work in elevated or confined spaces.
  • Ability to regularly lift up to 50 pounds and push/pull loads up to 1,500 pounds with appropriate equipment.
  • Ability to work around moving machinery, electrical systems, industrial noise, temperature extremes, vibration, and forklift traffic.
  • Ability to work overtime as needed to support plant operations.
  • Ability to pass required aptitude testing and licensing requirements associated with powered industrial equipment.

IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU HAVE… (NICE TO HAVE)

  • Associate degree or higher in Electrical Technology, Industrial Automation, Mechatronics, Engineering Technology, or a related field.
  • PLC certification.
  • State Electrician License.
  • Experience with Allen-Bradley PLCs, PanelView HMIs, VFDs, and servo systems.
  • Experience with Wonderware or similar HMI/SCADA platforms.
  • Experience in food, beverage, consumer packaged goods, or other high-volume manufacturing environments.
  • Knowledge of intrinsically safe and explosion-proof electrical installations.
  • Experience supporting continuous improvement, reliability, or automation upgrade projects.
  • Previous experience developing and delivering technical training programs.

Individual base pay depends on work location and additional factors such as experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training. Total pay may include other forms of compensation. In addition, we offer competitive health, dental, 401k and wellness benefits beginning on the first day of employment. Please ask your Talent Acquisition Partner for more information about our total rewards package.

For more than 50 years, we’ve worked throughout San Diego to provide safe shelter, transitional housing, intervention prevention programs, mental health support, and many other services that meet the ever-changing needs of our communities.


Our organization is dedicated to offering high-quality services and ensuring all services align with the community's needs. To best serve our communities, SBCS partners with various grassroots organizations throughout California to develop innovative strategies that enhance services, empower clients, and ensure that culturally appropriate and trauma-informed care is offered. SBCS provides a wide range of services tailored to meet each client's unique needs. At SBCS, our client-centered approach highlights the importance of respect, empathy, and compassion when interacting with all community members.


As a mission-driven organization, our work is centered around providing exceptional, face-to-face support to our clients and community members in order to foster trust, accessibility, and personal connection that are critical to our mission.


About YOU

You are an advocate and champion of nurturing communities where families can pursue their dreams and fulfill their potential.


You are dedicated to and energized by engaging directly with individuals and communities.

You care deeply about the well-being and prosperity of ALL children and youth throughout San Diego.


You want to become a part of an energetic and effective team, and contribute your expertise, creativity, and insights to a unique role encompassing program management, development, and direct counseling services for at-risk children, adolescents, and families.


About our organization

SBCS is home to a committed team of 470 dedicated employees and volunteers who diligently serve all of San Diego County. Having offered services for 52 years, SBCS is committed to providing hope and support for numerous young children, individuals, and families facing adversity. With an annual budget of $68 million, SBCS continues to be a beacon of assistance in the community.


Competitive and Sustainable Employee Pay Package:

SBCS offers competitive pay and additional benefits for full-time employees, including generous vacation time, holidays, health, vision, dental, flexible spending accounts, an employee assistance program, discount programs, public service forgiveness loan, and an excellent retirement plan with matching contributions.


Program

SBCS' Youth in Transition (YIT) program offers seamless high-quality services to youth transitioning out of the foster care system. Our trauma-informed services and activities provide foster youth with opportunities to enhance their self-sufficiency as they move into adulthood. YIT supports youth to address past trauma, teach independent living skills, provide transitional housing, safe places, employment/education pathways, experiences that build self-confidence, as well as identify permanent supportive adults and other resources that assist to develop the skills necessary to succeed independently.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

Under the supervision of the Youth in Transition Program Director/Coordinator, the Independent Living Skills (ILS) Youth & Family Development Associate will provide case management services for current and former foster youth ages 16 to 21 as they go through their transition from the foster care system into independence. ILS is committed to providing services that are trauma-informed, strength-based, person-centered, and empowerment-oriented. Through close interaction with the county social worker and YFDA, foster youth are encouraged to develop skills necessary to be successful in living independently. Services will be in keeping with agency goals, objectives, mission, and style and provided within a team framework. Associates are responsible for working with the team in developing team goals and objectives and in meeting those goals and objectives, including but not limited to:


DUTIES:

  • Provide case management, crisis intervention, safety planning, and other services to foster youth.
  • Collaborate with HHSA Child & Family Well-Being (CWFB) Social Workers regarding services
  • Collaborate with THP+/FC case worker(s) and attend Child & Family Team Meetings
  • Guide and support eligible youth through the service and housing plan
  • Assist clients in obtaining all necessary documentation required to obtain permanent housing (i.e., government-issued photo identification, Social Security card, proof of income, etc.)
  • Complete programmatic, data entry, quality assurance, and billing reports on a variety of software programs and required databases as requested and/or required.
  • Provide one-on-one individualized coaching to develop essential life skills and live independently. Tailor instruction to individual needs and learning styles.
  • Participate in MDTs to process to identify barriers to self-sufficiency
  • Assist youth in completing housing applications and other required paperwork
  • Work with the CWFB Social Workers involved with the youth to assure youth are actively working towards their goals to remove barriers to permanent housing
  • Assist youth in their communication with prospective landlords or/and roommates
  • Develop strong working relationships with community partners who may help a youth advance their goals
  • Provide other supports that assist youth in achieving self sufficiency
  • Attend all agency required meetings and trainings.
  • As other duties assigned.

title: Senior UI/UX Designer - Berlin
description:

Our mission is to not only provide personalized banking services for our clientele, but to encourage our staff to personally contribute to making a difference in the communities that we serve.

  • Supplemental insurance options

The New Accounts Representative serves as a primary point of contact for Bank customers and is responsible for creating a welcoming, helpful, and professional experience. Opens and services accounts, listens carefully and asks questions to understand customer needs, recommends appropriate Bank products and services, answers questions and takes ownership of resolving account in an efficient, timely, friendly, and courteous manner by performing the following duties:

Ability to read and comprehend instructions, correspondence, and memos. Ability to write clear and professional correspondence. Ability to communicate respectfully in person, by telephone, and in writing. Ability to actively listen, ask relevant questions, explain products, procedures and next steps in one-on-one and small group situations to customers, clients, and other employees of the organization.

Math Ability:

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

Ability to apply common sense and sound judgement to understand customer needs, research routine issues, evaluate available solutions, solve problems within established procedures and determine when escalation or assistance from another employee or department is appropriate.
