title: Project Manager (Civil/Structural – Concrete Reservoir Projects)
description:
Company Overview:

We are a dynamic organization committed to the development and execution of large-scale water infrastructure projects across Nigeria. We collaborate with government institutions, NGOs, and donor agencies to deliver sustainable and impactful water supply solutions nationwide.


Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager with a Civil/Structural Engineering background to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of reinforced concrete reservoir projects. The ideal candidate must have successfully managed similar water-retaining structure projects and have hands-on experience delivering donor-funded, NGO-sponsored, or government infrastructure projects.

The role requires strong leadership, technical expertise in concrete reservoir construction, stakeholder coordination, and strict adherence to regulatory and donor compliance requirements. The position involves frequent travel within Nigeria for project monitoring and site supervision.


Key Responsibilities:

Project Planning & Execution:

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of reinforced concrete reservoir projects from initiation to commissioning.

  • Develop project plans, schedules, budgets, and resource allocation strategies.

  • Ensure alignment with project scope, technical specifications, and funding requirements.

  • Monitor progress to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery.


Technical Oversight (Civil/Structural):

  • Provide technical leadership on the design and construction of water-retaining concrete structures (ground, elevated, or underground reservoirs).

  • Review and approve structural drawings, calculations, BOQs, and contractor submissions.

  • Ensure compliance with Nigerian codes, international standards, and donor guidelines.

  • Oversee implementation of proper reinforcement detailing, waterproofing, crack control, and durability measures.


Construction Supervision & Quality Assurance:

  • Supervise contractors and site teams to ensure quality execution.

  • Enforce QA/QC standards for concrete works, materials testing, and structural integrity.

  • Conduct site inspections and resolve technical challenges promptly.

  • Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental standards.


Stakeholder & Donor Management:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for government agencies, donor organizations, NGOs, consultants, and contractors.

  • Prepare and present progress reports, risk assessments, financial updates, and compliance documentation.

  • Facilitate site visits, audits, and technical review meetings.

  • Ensure compliance with donor safeguard policies and procurement procedures.


Risk & Compliance Management:

  • Identify potential project risks and implement mitigation strategies.

  • Manage contract performance and variations.

  • Ensure full compliance with COREN regulations, Nigerian construction standards, and funding agency requirements.




Requirements

Qualifications & Requirements:

Education & Experience:

  • BSc/MSc in Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering.

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in civil/structural engineering and project management.

  • Proven track record managing reinforced concrete reservoir or water-retaining structure projects.

  • Mandatory experience handling donor-funded, NGO-sponsored, or government infrastructure projects.


Professional Certification (Compulsory):

  • Registered with COREN (Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria) – Mandatory.

  • Active member of NSE (Nigerian Society of Engineers) – Mandatory.

  • PMP, PRINCE2, or other project management certification is an added advantage.


Technical Competencies:

  • Strong knowledge of reinforced concrete design and construction.

  • Proficiency in project management tools (MS Project, Primavera).

  • Familiarity with structural design software (ETABS, SAFE, STAAD.Pro, AutoCAD).

  • Solid understanding of Nigerian building regulations and international standards for water-retaining structures.


Personal Attributes:

  • Strong leadership and decision-making skills.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation abilities.

  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical capabilities.

  • Results driven with the ability to manage multiple sites simultaneously.

  • Willingness to travel extensively within Nigeria.




Benefits

Salary: ₦ 600,000 – ₦ 800,000

title: Cyber Analyst, Junior
description:
Cyber Analyst, Junior

The Opportunity:

As a cyber intelligence analyst, you know that detailed threat analysis gives organizations a critical edge. At Booz Allen, you can build your expertise in cyber intelligence to support innovative solutions that will shape the future of cybersecurity. We’re looking for a professional like you to apply your foundational knowledge in cyber threat intelligence concepts, SIEM platforms, and networking principles to make a lasting difference for our nation’s security.

In this role, you’ll use your skills in analyzing security log data and threat information to collect, assess, and produce actionable intelligence that supports routine cyber operations and incident handling. Using specialized tools and services, you’ll support and contribute to monitoring threat activity, identifying network anomalies, and researching routine security issues. You'll apply cutting-edge technologies to enhance our ability to process metadata and content for discovery, while developing your skills in creating intelligence products that strengthen the organization’s cyber defense posture.

If you’d like to contribute to missions that protect and secure our national interests, this is the opportunity for you. Work with us as we accelerate outcomes for the nation through technology.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

  • Experience analyzing cybersecurity risks, participating in hands-on academic lab environments, or completing cybersecurity internships

  • Knowledge of threat monitoring technology, SIEM concepts, and basic networking principles such as TCP/IP, subnets, and standard ports

  • Ability to research routine technical issues, learn new security tools under direct supervision, and document findings clearly

  • Ability to obtain a Secret clearance

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or Computer Science

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with scripting or querying languages such as Python, Bash, or SQL used to process or analyze security logs

  • Knowledge of common security frameworks such as the MITRE ATT&CK framework or NIST Special Publications

  • Ability to collaborate effectively in team-based environments to escalate and resolve routine technical issues

  • Top Secret clearance

  • Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field

  • CompTIA Security+, CySA+, or Network+ Certification

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $53,000.00 to $108,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model
Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.

  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.

  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

title: Facilities Management Analyst
description:
Facilities Management Analyst

The Opportunity:

As a facilities professional, you understand how essential field accuracy, documentation quality, and coordinated analysis are in supporting installation infrastructure and operations. We need a motivated facilities specialist who can contribute to facilities operations, maintenance analysis, facilities asset management, facilities warehouse logistics and supply, and data quality assurance for Marine Corps.

On our team, you’ll support multiple facility‑focused functions that enhance installation readiness. You’ll assist with documenting validating real property asset management data and helping identify discrepancies that require government review. You’ll contribute to operations and maintenance (O&M) analysis by helping collect asset information, tracking and managing warehouse supplies in support of day-to-day maintenance activities, reviewing and analyzing facilities-related data, and preparing documentation that informs installation-level facilities O&M decisions. You’ll support data quality efforts by capturing observations, assisting with compliance checks, and documenting issues discovered during review.

Working alongside Public Works, engineering teams, and installation stakeholders, you’ll help ensure information flowing into facilities O&M processes is accurate, timely, and mission-aligned. With mentoring and opportunities to learn new tools and apply new skills, we focus on growing as a team to make the best solutions for our customers. Work with us as we support projects that impact the Marine Corps’ daily operations and long‑term infrastructure performance for the better.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • Knowledge of facility operations, basic maintenance workflows, field documentation practices, or facility lifecycle concepts
  • Ability to assist with documentation, data entry, field condition validation, or basic planning inputs

Your New Role...

CNN Newsource is CNN's affiliate news service, delivering breaking news, enterprise reporting, live content, and editorial resources to more than 1,000 local news partners worldwide. A Newsource Content Producer leverages the global newsgathering resources of CNN and its affiliate partners to identify, curate, produce, package, and distribute compelling content that helps local newsrooms create impactful coverage across broadcast, digital, social, and streaming platforms. The role requires strong editorial judgment, a passion for breaking news, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative newsroom environment. The ideal candidate is a proactive journalist who can recognize compelling stories, communicate effectively with affiliate partners, and ensure content is delivered accurately, efficiently, and with the highest editorial standards.

Your Role Accountabilities...

  • Monitor CNN, affiliate, and external news sources to identify and prioritize stories for distribution.

  • Curate, package, write, and publish content for CNN Newsource platforms and affiliate partners.

  • Coordinate editorial coverage and content distribution during breaking news and major planned events.

  • Mine content and newsgathering resources for story opportunities, enterprise reporting, and beat assignments.

  • Promote available content, live opportunities, and editorial resources to affiliate stations.

  • Collaborate with CNN editorial teams, affiliates, and partner organizations to maximize content value and audience impact.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of affiliate needs and proactively provide content and services that support local newsroom coverage.

  • Exercise sound editorial judgment and ensure all distributed content meets CNN standards for accuracy, fairness, and quality.

  • Adapt quickly to changing news priorities and make timely decisions in high-pressure situations.

  • Contribute to special projects and initiatives that enhance Newsource's value to affiliate partners.

Your Qualifications & Experience...

  • 3-5 years of experience in a newsroom environment, such as an assignment editor, news producer, line producer, digital producer, writer, or content producer.

  • Strong news judgment and a demonstrated ability to identify stories that resonate with diverse audiences.

  • Excellent writing, editing, and communication skills.

  • Proven ability to make sound editorial decisions under deadline pressure.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Experience covering breaking news and adapting quickly to changing circumstances.

  • Exceptional interpersonal and customer service skills with the ability to build relationships across teams and partner organizations.

  • Proficiency with digital publishing tools, social media platforms, and newsroom workflows.

  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

  • Experience in local television news is strongly preferred.

  • Must be willing and able to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, holidays, and overnights as news coverage demands.

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

title: Manager, Help Desk
description:
Who We Are

Scale Computing is a global leader in edge computing, hyperconverged infrastructure, and managed networking solutions. We deliver innovative, secure, and scalable technology that powers critical operations worldwide.


Summary

The Help Desk Manager is responsible for the overall operational health of Scale Computing's IT systems and the leadership of the Help Desk/System Administration team in India as well as fostering open communications with the US Help Desk/System Administration counterparts. This position's primary focus is on people management, process optimization, and service delivery. While management is the core of your day-to-day, you will maintain a technical edge, acting as a point of escalation for complex issues that require expert intervention.

You will manage the lifecycle of IT tickets, ensure adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs), oversee critical infrastructure (Systems/Network), and drive the professional development of your direct reports. The ideal candidate is a seasoned IT leader who can balance high-level technical strategy with day-to-day operational excellence.


Essential Functions

Operational Leadership: Manage the daily operations of the IT Helpdesk and Systems Administration functions, ensuring 24/7 (coordinating with the US Manager/Teams) coverage and rapid resolution of incidents.

People Management: Recruit, train, coach, and conduct performance reviews for a blended team of SysAdmins and Helpdesk technicians.

Strategic Planning: Assist senior leadership in planning IT budgets, resource allocation, and technology roadmaps.


Key Responsibilities


1. Team Leadership & Management

Lead, coach, and manage a team of Systems Administrators and Helpdesk Support staff.

Conduct regular 1:1s, performance appraisals, and career development planning for direct reports.

Manage staff scheduling, on-call rotations, and resource allocation to ensure coverage during critical business hours.

Foster a culture of accountability, internal customer service excellence, and continuous learning.


2. Helpdesk & Service Delivery

SLA Management: Define, monitor, and enforce Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for ticket response and resolution times using Jira Service Management.

Incident Management: Serve as the primary point of escalation for high-priority or complex technical issues that the team cannot resolve.

Trend Analysis: Analyze ticket data to identify recurring issues and implement root-cause fixes to reduce ticket volume.

Onboarding: Oversee the "New Hire" process to ensure first-day productivity for new employees (hardware, accounts, access).


3. Infrastructure & Systems Oversight

System Governance: Oversee the administration of core enterprise systems, including JumpCloud, Google Workspace, Dialpad, and Atlassian Suite (Jira/Confluence).

Network Strategy: Supervise the health of the network infrastructure (Fortinet firewalls, switches, routers), ensuring the team performs timely firmware updates and security patching.

Asset Management: Manage IT asset lifecycle (procurement, inventory tracking, and retirement) for the India office and remote workforce.


4. Security & Compliance

Policy Enforcement: Ensure all IT operations comply with internal security policies and external frameworks (PCI-DSS, CIS Controls, SOC2).

Audit Readiness: Collaborate with the Information Security team to maintain documentation and evidence for security audits.

Risk Management: Proactively identify risks in the IT environment and propose mitigation strategies.


Success Metrics for the Role

Team Performance: High retention rates and positive feedback on team performance reviews.

Operational Efficiency: Consistently meeting or exceeding SLAs for helpdesk ticket resolution.

System Uptime: Maintenance of 99.9% uptime for core internal systems and network infrastructure.

Project Delivery: Successful oversight of completion of IT infrastructure projects on time and within budget.

Being at Cimpress means that you don’t see work as just a building, a desk or a manufacturing floor. You see it as a chance to take a step forward in your career journey – and your life. description:
Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We’re proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Our portfolio includes the iconic Campbell’s brand, as well as Cape Cod, Chunky, Goldfish, Kettle Brand, Lance, Late July, Pacific Foods, Pepperidge Farm, Prego, Pace, Rao’s Homemade, Snack Factory, Snyder’s of Hanover. Swanson, and V8.

Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.

Why Campbell’s…

  • Benefits begin on day one and include medical, dental, short and long-term disability, AD&D, and life insurance (for individual, families, and domestic partners).
  • Employees are eligible for our matching 401(k) plan and can enroll on the first day of employment with immediate vesting.
  • Campbell’s offers unlimited sick time along with paid time off and holiday pay.
  • If in WHQ – free access to the fitness center. Access to on-site day care (operated by Bright Horizons) and company store.
  • Giving back to the communities where our employees work and live is very important to Campbell’s. Our “Campbell’s Cares” program matches employee donations and/or volunteer activity up to $1,500 annually.
  • Campbell’s has a variety of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support employees.

How You Will Make History Here…

The Market Development Lead (MDL) drives market growth and development by partnering and engaging with Independent Distributor Partners (IDPs) and retail outlets. This role builds strong relationships with IDPs, store leadership, and key retailer decision makers, and uses disciplined planning to adapt to changing technology, retail conditions, and consumer behavior.

What You Will Do…

Independent Distributor Partner (IDP) Engagement

• Build collaborative relationships with IDPs to support customer service and identify sales growth opportunities.

• Recommend optional resources and technology, help resolve retailer disputes, and partner with internal teams to reduce route disruption and strengthen route health.[AK1.1]

• Lead route consults as IDPs request; conduct optional business meetings with IDPs to understand needs, support planning, and identify growth opportunities.

Retail Development

• Deliver weekly, period, and quarterly sales plans and grow market share.

• Identify market opportunities and share insights with IDPs.

• Support retailer expectations by communicating, organizing, and planning targets for distribution, merchandising, promotions and key retailer events.

• Support call coverage, coordinate inventory and logistics needs, evaluate competition and shopper trends, secure incremental placements and displays, and respond to retailer concerns within 24 hours.

Business Fundamentals

• Use data to identify retailer needs, performance trends, and growth opportunities, and communicate them clearly to IDPs and internal partners.

• Build trust with store management and retail partners, support new item launches, planogram compliance, store resets, inventories, and service issue resolution.

• Identify potential IDPs for open routes, visit key accounts to identify opportunities, and apply retailer-specific knowledge across channels.

• Communicate professionally, manage priorities, solve problems, use technology and business insights effectively, and participate in training and special projects.

• Demonstrate strong presentation, written, and verbal communication skills, along with proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant internal sales systems.

Who You Will Work With…

Partner with the Business Development Manager, Zone Sales Manager, retailers, warehouse teams, and IDPs to identify business constraints, opportunities, and needs.

What You Bring to the Table… (Must Have)

• 3+ years of related sales or CPG experience, or 2+ years of relevant experience with a bachelor’s degree.

• Strong written and verbal communication, influencing, leadership, problem-solving, technical, and analytical skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

• Ability to travel locally and overnight, relocate if required, and work flexible hours based on business and retailer needs.

• Ability to stand, walk, sit, bend, lift up to 50 pounds occasionally, and drive regularly to stores, warehouses, and hubs in the market.

It Would Be Great if You Have… (Nice to Have)

• B.A. preferred.

title: Observability Pipeline Engineer
description:
Observability Pipeline Engineer

The Opportunity:

Are you looking for an opportunity to combine deep technical skill with big picture thinking to make an impact on the systems people depend on every day? You understand that observability starts with the data, and that every dashboard, alert, and investigation is only as good as the telemetry underneath it. As an observability pipeline engineer on our team, you'll own the telemetry that feeds logging, monitoring, and security analytics across commercial and accredited government environments.

Your customers will trust you not only to build and operate the pipeline in Cribl and Splunk, but to evolve it — delivering source onboarding as code, applying AI to the parser and schema work that has traditionally consumed days, and building a pipeline that detects its own failures before anyone downstream is affected.

On our team, you'll broaden your skills in OpenTelemetry and telemetry standards. This role builds the pipeline itself. The work sits upstream of the dashboards, alerts, and searches everyone else uses, and its quality determines theirs. The ideal candidate comes from a data engineering, log platform, SIEM, or observability infrastructure background and has run high-volume pipelines in production under real cost and retention constraints.

What You'll Work On:

  • Build and evolve the telemetry pipeline that carries logs, metrics, and events across every accredited environment, including sources, parsing, enrichment, normalization, routing, and destinations.

  • Engineer the Splunk log platform from distributed architecture and index design through data onboarding and search performance.

  • Automate source onboarding end to end so that adding a data source is a pull request rather than a ticket, with all pipeline configuration managed as code under GitOps.

  • Apply AI tooling to parser generation, schema mapping, and normalization, collapsing work that used to take days.

  • Instrument the pipeline to detect its own failures, including silent sources, schema drift, and volume and cost anomalies, before anyone downstream notices.

  • Design reduction, cardinality, retention, and masking strategies that control cost, protect sensitive data by destination, and keep the operational record provable.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 4+ years of experience engineering telemetry, log, or event data pipelines at enterprise scale

  • Experience building and operating a telemetry routing tier such as Cribl Stream, OpenTelemetry Collector, Vector, Fluent Bit, or Logstash, including schema design, parsing, normalization, reduction, and retention tiering

  • Experience with a query language, including SPL, DQL, LogQL, PromQL, or KQL

  • Experience managing data volume, cardinality, and cost under volume-based or consumption-based licensing

  • Experience managing configuration as code, including infrastructure as code such as GitOps practice and Terraform, across multiple environments

  • Experience writing production code in a language such as Python, working against REST APIs, and administering Linux and Windows systems

  • Ability to learn new query languages

  • Secret clearance

  • Bachelor's degree in CS, Information Systems, or Engineering

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience designing OpenTelemetry Collector processors and pipelines at scale

  • Experience handling PII or sensitive data in telemetry, including masking and in-flight data-protection controls

  • Experience applying AI tooling to data engineering work, including parser generation, schema inference, or anomaly detection on data flows and validating the output before trusting it

  • Experience with DoD cloud environments such as Azure or AWS IL5/IL6, including change control and continuous monitoring obligations

  • Experience with CIM-compliant data engineering

  • Cribl Certified Observability Engineer (CCOE) or equivalent certification

  • Splunk Enterprise Certified Architect Certification

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

​

POSITION SPECIFICS​

The Eberly College of Science at The Pennsylvania State University invites applications for an experienced Data Analyst (Intermediate Professional). In this position, the successful candidate will be responsible for retrieving and analyzing data from a variety of data sources in order to provide information and analyses in the form of reports to college leadership for planning, assessment, and performance improvements. This position will proactively support the college administration, along with the academic departments and units of the college.

Responsibilities of the data analyst include:

  • Retrieving and analyzing data from a variety of institutional data sources to provide reports and information to college leadership for planning, assessment, and performance improvements across the college
  • Collaborate with college personnel to support strategic planning efforts, including the development of key performance indicators and the establishment of qualitative and quantitative metrics informed by available data and institutional knowledge
  • Design, write, and analyze survey data
  • Serve as a consultant to college units by providing facilitation and training in data gathering, interpretation, and utilization
  • Provide consultation to college offices on assessment initiatives, assisting stakeholders in understanding and utilizing results, and enhancing the assessment of learning outcomes associated with co-curricular programs and services
  • Partner with the college IT team to develop and maintain a secure data repository to support analysis for college stakeholders
  • Contribute to a range of projects and ad hoc analyses, maintaining responsiveness and adaptability in data extraction and in determining the appropriate scope of data required
  • Serve on college or university committees to support college initiatives

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience working in a higher education setting translating data into actionable insights
  • A working knowledge of contemporary challenges in higher education and STEM disciplines is desired to include a high level of fluency in the issues for students in science and higher education
  • Strong time and project management skills
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment
  • Strong data presentation skills and excellent communication skills
  • Fluent in the information systems that house student data (LionPath, Canvas, Starfish, etc.) as well as having a working knowledge of educational structures (campuses, colleges, programs, entrance to major processes, university policies and procedures, etc.) preferred

MINIMUM EDUCATION, WORK EXPERIENCE & REQUIRED CERTIFICATIONS

Bachelor's Degree
1+ years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience accepted
Required Certifications:
None

Application Materials Required:

Applicants must submit both a resume and a cover letter for full consideration. In the cover letter, candidates are encouraged to describe experience working in higher education and applying data analysis to support decision-making or operational improvement within a higher education environment.

This position offers a hybrid work arrangement that combines home office and on campus work.

Home to world-class faculty, top-tier students, and groundbreaking research, the Eberly College of Science is a vibrant academic community within one of the nation’s leading public research institutions. The College plays a central role in Pennsylvania State Universities research mission and is committed to excellence in teaching, scholarship, and community engagement.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
At IQM, we build world-leading quantum computers for the well-being of humankind. We design systems to tackle computational challenges beyond the practical limits of classical machines. Our work sits at the edge of science and engineering. It's complex, demanding, and deeply collaborative. We turn deep research into reliable, full-stack systems that drive discoveries in fields like medicine, energy, and technology, reshaping how the world computes.

Join the team that gives quantum a heartbeat.

The work

We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer (mid-level) to join the Vertical Deployment team and contribute to building the platform that makes exploring and using quantum computing for real-world problems as seamless as solving them any other way. The team builds tools that enable users to configure, execute, monitor, and understand computational workflows — from pipeline execution and job scheduling to data processing and results visualization.

While this is a full-stack engineering role, the work will be slightly more inclined towards frontend development. The role will work across the stack when needed, including the integration points between frontend and backend, and take ownership of engineering work from implementation through deployment.

The role involves close collaboration with researchers and engineers across IQM to turn complex computational requirements into reliable, intuitive, and production-quality software.

This role is to be based at IQM, in Munich, Berlin, or Espoo.

What you’ll actually do

  • Independently plan and execute a set of related tasks or a feature area, from ticket through to deployment.

  • Break down ambiguous or loosely specified tasks into a concrete implementation plan, checking in at key decision points rather than requiring step-by-step direction.

  • Design, write, test, and ship software across the frontend and backend, with a primary focus on frontend development.

  • Build user interfaces for configuring, running, and monitoring computational workflows.

  • Contribute to backend APIs, workflow execution logic, and data pipelines where required.

  • Debug and resolve moderately complex issues spanning multiple layers of the stack, such as a frontend issue caused by backend state or asynchronous job execution.

  • Participate in triaging and resolving workflow execution issues.

  • Follow and reinforce existing coding standards, architectural patterns, and CI/CD practices.

  • Collaborate closely with researchers and developers across teams and departments to clarify requirements, asking the right questions rather than relying on fully specified requirements.

  • Push back or flag concerns when a requested approach conflicts with existing patterns, creates unnecessary complexity, or introduces technical risk.

  • Take ownership of your work and proactively communicate progress, blockers, risks, and technical decisions.

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of experience in full-stack software development.

  • Solid proficiency across the full stack relevant to the platform, including:

    • Vue.js or a comparable frontend framework

    • TypeScript and Node.js for backend development

    • REST APIs

    • Relational and job-queue-backed data stores, including PostgreSQL and Redis

  • Strong frontend development skills and an interest in building intuitive, reliable user interfaces for complex computational workflows.

  • Comfortable working with the challenges of computational and workflow systems, including asynchronous execution, state management for long-running jobs, databases, retries and idempotency, task dependencies, and graceful failure handling.

  • Experience working with Argo Workflows or a comparable workflow orchestration system is a strong advantage.

  • Ability to read and reason about a codebase beyond your immediate task, avoiding duplicated logic and unintended impacts on adjacent functionality.

  • Basic familiarity with deployment and infrastructure pipelines, including CI/CD, Docker, logging, and monitoring/OTEL, sufficient to ship and debug independently.

  • Degree in Computer Science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent industry experience.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of parallel processing techniques and experience with libraries such as mpi4py.

  • Familiarity with GPU acceleration using CUDA, OpenCL, JAX, or Numba.

  • Experience with quantum software development kits, simulators, or related research tooling.

  • Background in quantum algorithms, hybrid quantum-classical workflows, or scientific computing.

Why IQM?

  • Full-stack quantum computing: From quantum hardware to software layers and beyond, we build across the full-stack.

  • High-performance playground: We aim high, and we know sustainable performance only works when life outside work does too—hybrid setups, flexible hours.

  • Never the smartest: You won’t always be the smartest person in the room. Neither will we. Expect to learn constantly - from each other and beyond with IQM’s Learning Hub, LinkedIn Learning, and a team-based L&D budget.

  • Approachable leadership: Flat hierarchy, direct access. Feel free to approach any leaders. They're friendlier than they look!

  • The sweet spot: Big enough to matter. Small enough to move fast. Growing between a startup and a corporation. We’re in the phase where top performers get noticed.

  • Bigger than IQM: Our people build know-how for the entire quantum ecosystem. We publish papers, run hackathons, and help shape a market that's still being defined.

The future of computing won’t build itself. You might be one of the few who do.

  • Meet our people and learn more about IQM on our stories page.

  • Explore our scientific publications.

We'll start interviews and move forward with hiring as soon as we meet strong candidates. Please submit your application soon.

title: Senior Finance Regulatory Specialist
description:
About Ameren Illinois​

Ameren Illinois provides electric transmission and distribution service and natural gas distribution service. Every day, we deliver electricity to 1.2 million electric and 816,000 natural gas customers in central and southern Illinois. We deliver safe, reliable energy to more than 1,200 communities.

Our benefits include:

  • Medical coverage on date of hire

  • 100% employer paid cash balance pension plan

  • 401(k) with company match fully vested on date of hire

  • Minimum of 15 days paid vacation and 12 paid holidays

  • Paid parental leave and family caregiver leave

Visit our Benefits and Perks Page for more information on benefits provided to regular full-time employees.

About the Position

The Senior Finance Regulatory Specialist plays a key role in the ongoing development and execution of Ameren's regulatory initiatives and may be responsible for leading cross functional teams and providing strategic input related to regulatory initiatives. The specialists will utilize a robust understanding of the relevant regulatory frameworks to provide reports and key insights to team members. The specialists will also be responsible for preparing and filing various financial analyses to various regulatory stakeholders and may be required to discuss such analysis to various regulatory stakeholders and provide testimony supporting the analyses.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Supports development of the revenue requirement models that provide the basis for Ameren Illinois electric and gas rate reviews, including aspects used to evaluate financial implications and regulatory alternatives
  • Supports the analysis of opposing parties' positions, including recommendations of rebuttal strategies
  • Responds to Staff and intervenor inquiries regarding revenue requirement models and calculations
  • Prepares financial analysis and provides strategic insight related to regulatory and legislative initiatives
  • Establishes and maintains positive working relationships with coworkers in a wide range of departments that provide inputs or support to regulatory initiatives
  • Represents Ameren Illinois' interests with external regulatory stakeholders through discussions, written communications, and expert testimony
  • Supports the preparation of analysis and presentations used for discussions with executives that inform key business decisions. May prepare and deliver departmental or larger group presentations.
  • Supports the preparation of external regulatory filings with the SEC, FERC, and State Public Service Commissions, including regulatory compliance reports, affiliate transaction support, and depreciation studies
  • Prepares, reviews, analyzes, and interprets complex accounting, financial, and statistical data
  • Performs other special financial projects as necessary, which may include financial modeling supporting Certificate or Rider requests, specific capital projects, or new revenue generating activities
  • Supports the Transmission team's calculation of Attachment O and response to Staff and intervenor inquiries and positions on various issues

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Accounting from an accredited college or university required. CPA also required. Three or more years of accounting experience required with a thorough knowledge of accounting principles, standards and methods preferred. Reporting experience (e.g., SEC and FERC) preferred. Master's Degree preferred. In-depth utility knowledge preferred, Ability to draw insights from complex analysis and communicate them in an understandable way is a plus.

In addition to the above qualifications, the successful candidate will demonstrate:

Strong analytical skills, including the ability to identify, analyze and research financial issues required. Strong oral communication and writing skills required. Demonstrated decision-making skills and ability to work independently required. Working knowledge of Word, Excel and PowerPoint required.

Additional Information

Ameren’s selection process includes a series of interviews and may include candidate testing and/or an individual aptitude or skill-based assessment. Specific details will be provided to qualified candidates.

Compensation Range:

$105,100.00 - $162,900.00

At Ameren, base salary is one component of a competitive compensation package for employees. Our pay ranges are broad to allow for movement within our organization and to accommodate different skill sets and levels of expertise. We take into consideration a variety of factors including, but not limited to, skills, abilities, experience, education, credentials, and internal equity when determining the base salary offered. Roles are eligible for additional rewards including annual incentive payments based on individual and company performance.

title: Water Quality Specialist – Water Infrastructure Projects
description:
Company Overview:

We are a dynamic organization committed to the development, rehabilitation, and expansion of water infrastructure projects across Nigeria. We collaborate with government institutions, NGOs, and donor agencies to deliver sustainable and impactful water supply and sanitation solutions nationwide.


Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Water Quality Specialist to oversee water quality monitoring, treatment optimization, laboratory analysis, and regulatory compliance across water infrastructure projects.

The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience in water quality testing, treatment process monitoring, and compliance management for water treatment plants, borehole schemes, transmission systems, and distribution networks. Experience handling donor-funded, NGO-sponsored, or government water projects is highly desirable.

The role requires strong knowledge of drinking water standards, laboratory procedures, and treatment technologies to ensure safe and compliant water supply systems.


Key Responsibilities:

Water Quality Monitoring & Testing:

  • Develop and implement water quality monitoring programs.

  • Conduct routine sampling and laboratory analysis of raw and treated water.

  • Monitor physical, chemical, and microbiological parameters.

  • Ensure compliance with Nigerian drinking water standards (NSDWQ) and WHO guidelines.


Treatment Process Oversight:

  • Support optimization of water treatment processes including coagulation, filtration, chlorination, and disinfection.

  • Monitor dosing systems and recommend adjustments to improve performance.

  • Identify treatment inefficiencies and recommend corrective actions.

  • Support commissioning of new or rehabilitated treatment facilities.


Laboratory & Documentation Management:

  • Maintain accurate laboratory records and quality control documentation.

  • Prepare water quality reports for management, regulators, and donors.

  • Support audits and regulatory inspections.

  • Ensure proper calibration and maintenance of laboratory equipment.


Compliance & Risk Management:

  • Ensure compliance with environmental and public health regulations.

  • Develop water safety plans and risk mitigation strategies.

  • Investigate water quality incidents and provide technical recommendations.


Stakeholder Coordination:

  • Work closely with Engineers, Project Managers, and plant operators.

  • Provide technical training to plant personnel on water quality standards and procedures.

  • Support donor reporting requirements related to water quality compliance.



Requirements

Qualifications & Requirements:

Education & Experience:

  • BSc/MSc in Environmental Science, Chemistry, Water Resources, Public Health, or related field.

  • Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in water quality management within water treatment or supply projects.

  • Experience in donor-funded, NGO-sponsored, or government projects is highly desirable.


Professional Certification (Preferred):

  • Relevant professional certification or membership in recognized environmental or water quality bodies is an advantage.

  • Certification in laboratory quality management systems is an added advantage.


Technical Competencies:

  • Strong knowledge of drinking water standards (NSDWQ, WHO).

  • Experience with laboratory testing methods and equipment.

  • Familiarity with water treatment processes and chemical dosing systems.

  • Ability to analyze water quality data and prepare technical reports.

  • Understanding of environmental regulations and compliance requirements.


Personal Attributes:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • High attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Good communication and reporting skills.

  • Ability to work independently and within multidisciplinary teams.

  • Willingness to travel for site monitoring and inspections.




Benefits

Salary: ₦ 350,000 – ₦ 500,000

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Customer360
description:
Amazon's mission is to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Customer360 is Amazon's customer memory, the centralized system that captures, reconciles, and retrieves everything we know about each customer across every Amazon experience. This unified memory powers AI-driven personalization where a preference stated once is understood everywhere, from shopping on Amazon.com, to watching Prime Video, to talking with Alexa.

As a builder on Customer360, you'll work at the intersection of large-scale data systems and AI. You'll lead software development for infrastructure that ingests customer signals across Amazon, powers contextual retrieval for AI experiences, and enables privacy-by-default data sharing at scale.

We're looking for an SDE III who leads their team's software development across the full lifecycle: working backwards from the customer, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance. You'll own your team's architectural direction, work on problems where the customer case is defined but the technology strategy is not, and deliver systems serving hundreds of millions of customers across real-time data pipelines, retrieval systems, privacy infrastructure, and AI integrations.

You'll drive engineering best practices, coach and mentor multiple engineers, and ensure the quality and coherence of your team's software. You'll balance short-term delivery against long-term architecture, identify one-way-door technical decisions, and advocate for the right solutions. You'll ensure your team has strong operational practices with correct alarms, telemetry, runbooks, and retrospective processes.

You'll partner with principal engineers, applied scientists, and product leaders to translate customer and business needs into robust, scalable systems. You'll lead inclusive, constructive dialogue when disagreements arise and build consensus on the best path forward. We expect you to proactively identify gaps, resolve root causes of endemic problems, and drive solutions to completion, including influencing decisions in systems you depend on.

Your work will have high visibility across the organization. Your team will be stronger because of your presence but will not depend on your presence to be successful. You'll contribute to our technical roadmap and help shape how Amazon understands its customers.

If you want to lead systems at Amazon scale and have the technical depth and ownership mindset to drive them forward, Customer360 is the place.

title: Director of Retail Banking
description:
Job Summary

The Director of Retail Banking is responsible for leading retail branch performance across the Bank's footprint through a balanced focus on sales growth, customer experience, operational excellence, talent development, and risk management. This position partners closely with Regional Managers to develop high-performing teams, strengthen leadership capabilities, drive branch growth, improve customer engagement, and ensure consistent execution of the Bank's retail strategy.


The Director of Retail Banking serves as a key leader within the Retail Banking Division and works closely with the Chief Deposit Growth Officer to execute growth strategies, sales and service initiatives, business development activities, community engagement efforts, and branch performance objectives. This position partners with key stakeholders throughout the organization to drive deposit growth, strengthen customer relationships, enhance employee performance, and ensure successful execution of strategic priorities across the retail network.


The position provides leadership, coaching, performance management, and strategic direction to Regional Managers while fostering a culture of accountability, employee development, customer advocacy, operational effectiveness, collaboration, and continuous improvement throughout the retail branch network.


Essential Functions/Duties

The following duties are representative of the essential functions of the position:

  • Lead retail branch performance across the Bank's footprint to achieve sales, service, operational, customer experience, and financial objectives.
  • Provide leadership, coaching, performance management, and development to Regional Managers and their respective teams.
  • Foster a balanced culture focused on sales growth, customer experience, operational excellence, compliance, and risk management.
  • Develop and execute retail business plans that support deposit growth, customer acquisition, relationship expansion, profitability, and market development.
  • Establish performance expectations and accountability measures while monitoring key performance indicators across the retail network.
  • Analyze branch performance trends and develop strategies to improve employee performance, customer experience, sales effectiveness, and operational results.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Chargebee

Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.


Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2.

With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.


About the Team

You’ll join the Revenue Story Modules team, a cross-functional group of engineers, product managers, and designers based primarily in India and collaborating with global stakeholders. The team builds reporting, insights, and revenue intelligence capabilities that help customers understand and operationalize their subscription revenue performance. We work closely with Platform, Billing, Support, and GTM teams to deliver scalable solutions with strong correctness guarantees, performance, and reliability.


About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own and deliver key product capabilities for our Revenue Story Modules. You’ll work end-to-end—from design to rollout—while partnering closely with Product and Engineering peers to build reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems. You will play a key role in improving code quality, performance, and operational excellence, and support junior engineers through mentorship and reviews.


What you’ll do

  • Own the design, implementation, testing, and rollout of product features end-to-end.
  • Build and maintain backend services with strong reliability, performance, and security standards.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL queries, improve data correctness, and enhance performance for reporting/data workflows.
  • Drive code quality through code reviews, testing practices, and refactoring initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Product, Design, and cross-functional teams to translate customer needs into robust technical solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement long-term fixes.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team-wide engineering best practices.


What you’ll bring (required skills and experience)

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of software development experience delivering high-quality, scalable systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Core Java.
  • Strong hands-on experience with MySQL/PostgreSQL, SQL, and familiarity with NoSQL.
  • Experience writing complex SQL queries and optimizing performance (query plans, indexes, scalability).
  • Experience with microservices architecture and cloud platforms such as AWS.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
  • Working knowledge / hands-on exposure to Javascript frameworks (React / Angular / Vue) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work across teams.


Nice to have (preferred)

  • Experience designing/consuming RESTful APIs (added advantage).
  • Experience with a query builder / query engine.
  • Experience building reporting/analytics products or working in revenue/finance domains.
  • Experience mentoring developers and leading technical initiatives within a team.
  • Actively using AI tools for development workflows (coding copilots, etc.).

title: Senior Commercial Loan Closer
description:
General Responsibilities:


Responsible for performing a variety of duties to support the loan documentation and loan processing function for commercial/small business, residential, and consumer loan transactions; coordinating work within the department, as well as with other departments; reporting pertinent information to the immediate supervisor; responding to inquiries or requests for information.



Essential Duties:


  • Performs a variety of duties to support the loan documentation function as follows:
  • Verifies all loan information pertaining to small business and commercial lending in preparation for final loan documentation for closing.
  • Verifies loan approvals to loan policies.
  • Reviews loan applications to verify that application data is complete and meets establishment standards, including full execution by all parties and Bank.
  • Reviews document preparation folders for completeness and accuracy
  • Informs Lenders and administrative support of missing information, documentation and discrepancies.
  • Verifies loan to values as appropriate to the transaction at hand and for reporting accuracy.
  • Completes and/or follows up on any additional records with regard to the processed loans
  • Prepares and reviews commercial modification documentation as needed including calculation of adjusted payments.

  • Performs review of attorney-prepared loan documentation for accuracy and informs Lenders of necessary changes, as needed.
  • Performs secondary review of loan documentation of other loan closers prior to distribution of loan documents including review of attorney-prepared loan documentation.

title: EMEA Regional Molecular Trainer ADx
description:
As a result of the combination of the BD Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business with Waters Corporation (NYSE: WAT), by applying to this role, you will be applying for a position with Waters. Waters is a global leader in life sciences, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, Waters’ innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across biology, chemistry, and physics. Waters collaborates with analytical laboratories around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, assure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combatting growing antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, Waters’ passionate team of approximately 16,000 colleagues partner with customers to turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.



We are the people who give possibilities purpose

BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.

Job Description

Role and responsibilities

As part of the ADx Technical Services team, reporting to the EMEA Regional Support and Training Manager, you will design, develop and deliver high-quality molecular diagnostics technical training for Field Service Engineers, Technical Instrument Specialists, Customer Remote Support associates and regional support teams across EMEA. The role focuses on strengthening molecular platform capability, improving service readiness, supporting consistent troubleshooting discipline and enabling associates to deliver reliable customer outcomes across the installed base.

As the Molecular Trainer, you will build and maintain training content, deliver classroom and hands-on technical training, support new product and software readiness, coach regional trainers and specialists, and create training programmes that improve EMEA Technical Service capability by strengthening platform knowledge, troubleshooting discipline and service execution consistency.

Your specific responsibilities will consist of:

Role priorities: consistent molecular technical training across EMEA; improved service readiness for molecular platforms; strengthened regional expert capability; effective knowledge transfer that supports faster, more accurate troubleshooting and reduced escalation dependency.

Acquiring, maintaining and transferring knowledge

  • Maintain advanced knowledge of ADx molecular diagnostic platforms, workflows, software, connectivity, service procedures and troubleshooting methods.
  • Keep molecular platform knowledge current through field feedback, service bulletins, product updates, quality notifications and collaboration with global subject matter experts.
  • Participate in molecular technical forums to share best practices, training needs, issue trends and resolution strategies.
  • Build and sustain an EMEA molecular training and expert network with Customer Remote Support, Field Service, Country Product Technical Specialists and regional trainers to accelerate knowledge transfer and consistent support execution.

Training

  • Develop, maintain and deliver molecular technical training covering installation, maintenance, system operation, troubleshooting, workflow, connectivity and escalation handling.
  • Create and update training materials, practical exercises, assessments, trainer guides and knowledge resources that improve EMEA Technical Service capability and remain aligned with current service documentation and quality requirements.
  • Coach regional trainers, Technical Instrument Specialists and Field Service Engineers to deliver consistent molecular training and reinforce standard troubleshooting approaches.
  • Communicate molecular technical guidelines, procedures, service resources and documentation to field-based and remote support associates.

Organizational support

  • Support technical and training readiness for molecular new products, software releases, upgrades and service campaigns, including prelaunch activities and regional readiness reviews.
  • Partner with Regional Support, Customer Remote Support, Field Service, Application, Sales and Marketing teams to ensure training supports business needs, customer continuity and service execution.
  • Monitor training feedback, service trends and recurring knowledge gaps to improve training content, learning effectiveness and regional capability development.

Remote support, diagnostics & troubleshooting capability

  • Work closely with Customer Remote Support and Field Service to embed molecular troubleshooting discipline, remote diagnostics practices, log review methods and first-time resolution principles into training programmes.
  • Translate complex molecular technical issues and lessons learned into practical training modules, case studies and knowledge resources.
  • Support escalations when needed by helping identify training gaps, reinforcing correct troubleshooting processes and sharing learning back into the regional training curriculum.

Field corrective actions, upgrades & service readiness

  • Support Regional Support in preparing training and communication packages for molecular field corrective actions, upgrades, software updates and service campaigns.
  • Maintain compliance with ADx quality regulations and molecular platform-specific service, documentation, training and escalation requirements.

Functional administrative reporting

  • Manage personal planning and training delivery schedules in agreement with the Manager.
  • Follow administrative processes for training records, course documentation, learning assessments, ServiceMax-related knowledge capture, technical reporting and training effectiveness feedback.

Requirements (qualifications / experience)

  • Engineering degree in electromechanics, electronics, automation, software, physics, biomedical science or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in molecular diagnostics, laboratory automation, field service, technical support or technical training is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with PC hardware, software, LIS, networking, middleware, database management and automated workflow connectivity is desirable.
  • Willing to undertake occasional travel across EMEA to deliver molecular training and provide occasional support when required.
  • Knowledge of Windows and common Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, OneNote, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint and Word.
  • Strong customer focus, analytical problem-solving skills, collaborative mindset, ability to multitask, and openness to diversity and different cultures.
  • Discipline in creating, using and implementing processes that promote a safe working environment across the organization.
  • Effective presentation, training, facilitation and teaching skills.
  • Effective organization and planning skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Location of the EMEA Molecular Trainer ADx:

  • The EMEA Molecular Trainer can be based in Drachten, Netherlands or Heidelberg, Germany. Occasional travel may be needed across EMEA to deliver training and provide occasional support.

Why Join Us?

To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive.

We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success.

Course Description: Legal research is undergoing its most significant transformation since the introduction of online legal databases. For generations, lawyers were trained to locate authorities, interpret legal texts, and construct arguments through manual research processes. Today, advanced technologies are changing how legal professionals discover information, analyze issues, generate insights, and deliver value to clients. This course examines how legal research is evolving and explores what it means to be a lawyer in an era where legal knowledge is increasingly accessible through technology. Students will critically assess the opportunities and limitations of advanced technologies, learn how modern legal workflows are changing, and explore the skills future lawyers will need to remain effective and indispensable. The course combines discussion, debates, simulations, hands-on exercises, and collaborative design activities.

title: Business Unit Director
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

JOB SUMMARY

Develops and implements programs, projects or processes for an assigned customer account(s) (Business Unit), strategically managing the customer relationship road map. Develops and sponsors tactics to achieve strategic objectives across functional groups or within a business group through senior- and executive-level customer interaction. Influences strategic direction and develops tactical plans and completes complex assignments with minimal supervision or review, including contract negotiation and amendment. Provides comprehensive solutions to complex problems. End results are evaluated for achieving goals and objectives. Extensive contact with internal and external customers is required to obtain, clarify or provide facts and information.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

· Demonstrates an entrepreneurial spirit and drive.
· Full global responsibility for a customer Profit & Loss (P&L) statement (multi-site responsibility).
· Pricing (i.e. materials and value-add) is a core responsibility of the Business Unit Director.
· Establishes and manages current customer relationships, striving to capitalize on organic revenue growth opportunities.
· Manages the customer relationship road map from a strategic relationship perspective.
· Demonstrated strategic capability to look beyond the customer and understand the end market and industry.
· Negotiates contract terms and/or amends established contract terms and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with customers.
· Defines the Business Unit organization structure and staffs appropriately. Manages the team to effectively support customer contract terms and SLAs.
· Owns the execution of operational SLA delivery and escalations.
· Ultimately held accountable for revenue growth success with assigned customer base.
· Exhibits demonstrated successful relationship-building skills with highest-level audiences at more strategic and senior levels within the customer’s organization and within Jabil.
· Responsible for the Request for Proposal (RFP) process for assigned customer accounts. May support RFP processes for others.
· Manages the performance, developments, and rewards for direct reports. Indirectly manages work of others through Jabil’s Workcell business model.
· Full responsibility for continuous improvement of customer relationship performance metrics and customer satisfaction.
· Assumes leadership role in site-level strategic planning meetings.
· Manages and drives the Quarterly Business Review (QBR) process with assigned customer account.
· May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS
KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS

· Excellent communication skills.
· Fundamental concepts, practices and procedures of global business awareness/experience (e.g., taxation, laws, culture).
· Advanced concepts, practices and procedures of operational functions (e.g., manufacturing, supply chain, etc.).
· Extensive knowledge of total Jabil solutions available for offer.

· Strong financial skill knowledge and aptitude (e.g. balance sheet and income statement).
· Jabil tools (Financial system, quote process, etc.).
· Advanced contract and negotiation knowledge/experience at a more strategic level.
· Leadership/people-management skills.
· Strong customer service skills and experience.
· Strong knowledge of global and regional logistics operations and industry.
· Strong proficiency in determining logistics requirements to enable company’s business goals and objectives with ability to devise and implement strategy to achieve targets.
· Strong financial and analytical ability. Proficiency in managing business analytics to determine optimum company footprint.
· Strong knowledge of international direct and indirect taxes as well as global customs regimes.
· Proven track record of successful change management accomplishments, implementing and management continuous productivity and cost reduction programs.
· Strong and convincing communication skills.
· Proficiency in use of personal computers, Microsoft Office products (Excel, Word and PowerPoint) and e-mail skills required.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

· Bachelor's Degree required. Masters Degree preferred.
· Degree in Engineering, Finance/Accounting, or Business Management preferred.
· Eight (8) to ten (10) years work-related experience required, preferably in Financial or Manufacturing Operations fields.
· Significant previous Business Unit Manager (or equivalent job) work experience preferred.
· Minimum of 5 years management experience required.
· Or an equivalent combination of education, training or experience.
· Or a combination of education, experience and/or training.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Data Specialist
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.


At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.


Your Team's Impact

FactSet has a dynamic presence in the energy market, empowering clients with data-driven insights that shape pivotal investment and operational decisions. Our Deep Sector Oil & Gas data team specializes in delivering comprehensive datasets covering wells, pipelines, refineries, LNG terminals, and other critical components of the global energy value chain. By delivering timely and accurate data for a wide range of publicly-trade and private entities, our team equips industry leaders with the information needed to optimize strategies and seize opportunities in the market. Our expertly curated data and powerful analytics serves as a reliable foundation for our clients, ensuring informed and impactful decision-making in the ever-evolving energy landscape.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Oil and Gas Data Specialist, you will be responsible for two or more Deep Sector Oil & Gas data products. Your primary focus will be U.S. interstate natural gas pipeline nominations, major corridor flows, and daily natural gas prices. Additional duties may be adjusted based on user feedback and business requirements. This position requires data management experience with a solid foundation in data modeling, programmatic data acquisition and processing, and designing robust data pipelines. Oil & Gas data specialists are also expected to stay up to date with sector developments, providing knowledgeable support to product end users by keeping up with industry news, market dynamics, and key industry players and regulatory bodies.

What We're Looking For

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, or related field.
  • 3-5 years of demonstrated experience working with large databases, building data pipelines, and automating workflows.
  • Advanced proficiency with Python and SQL (certifications preferred).
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or at any time in the future.

Desired Skills:

  • A results-oriented and client-centric approach.
  • Ability to multitask and collaborate effectively with teams.
  • Experience in quantitative/statistical modeling, machine learning, and/or agentic workflows.
  • GIS knowledge is a plus.

    Why Life is Better as a FactSetter

    • Secure your future with our discounted employee stock purchase program and 401K matching.
    • 3 weeks paid time off your first year of employment.
    • No or low-cost medical, dental and vision care.
    • Reimbursement for eligible expenses related to the CFA, CIPM, CAIA and FRM exams.
    • Wellness programs including gym discounts and more.
    • 16 weeks paid parental leave for the primary caregiver (4 weeks for secondary).
    • Employee referral bonuses.

    What's In It for You

    At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

    • The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
    • Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, and family leave.
    • Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
    • A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
    • Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
    • Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

    Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.

    The budgeted salary range for this position in the State of Colorado is $80,000 - $100,000.

    Company Overview:

    FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.

title: Retail Training Specialist
description:
General Responsibilities

The Retail Training Specialist supports Retail Banking training initiatives through the delivery of sales, service, operational, product, systems, and onboarding training. This position is responsible for facilitating training programs, supporting employee development, assisting with onboarding activities, maintaining training materials, and reinforcing operational consistency throughout the retail network and Virtual Banking Center.


The Retail Training Specialist serves as a resource for frontline employees, helping to ensure team members have the knowledge, skills, and tools necessary to deliver exceptional customer experiences, achieve sales and service goals, and consistently execute operational procedures.


The role also assists with operational readiness initiatives, branch audit activities, and employee development efforts that support service excellence, sales performance, operational effectiveness, and organizational objectives.


Essential Functions/Duties

The following duties are representative of the essential functions of the position:

  • Utilize the Bank's One Bank, One Team, One Brand philosophy to foster collaboration and support organizational goals.
  • Deliver instructor-led, virtual, and on-demand training programs for Retail Banking and the Virtual Banking Center.
  • Facilitate training related to sales, customer service, branch operations, deposit products, consumer lending, systems, account opening, compliance requirements, and operational procedures.
  • Conduct onboarding and orientation training for newly hired employees.
