  • Participate in branch visits and observational activities to support employee development, operational consistency, and training reinforcement.
  • Assist with branch audits, operational reviews, and observational assessments as directed.
  • Support the collection and organization of documentation required for internal and external audits and examinations.
  • Assist with testing and validation of new products, services, systems, procedures, and operational processes prior to implementation.
  • Collaborate with the Senior Trainer & Operations Specialist to identify training opportunities related to audit findings, operational trends, and employee development needs.

  • Travel throughout the Bank's footprint as needed to conduct training and support Retail Banking initiatives.

title: IT Change & Transition Specialist
description:
The IT Change & Transition Specialist is responsible for governing, planning, coordinating, and overseeing all IT service transitions, change activities, release deployments, and operational readiness initiatives across a complex technology and integrations landscape. The role ensures that new systems, technology changes, upgrades, integrations, and project deliverables are introduced into production in a controlled, compliant, well-communicated, and risk-managed manner while minimizing disruption to business operations and users.

The position acts as the central coordination point between Tech Operations, Service Delivery, Cyber Security, Infrastructure, Applications, Delivery Management, Vendors, and Business Stakeholders to ensure successful delivery, hypercare, adoption, support handover, and lifecycle management of technology services.

Key Accountabilities

IT Change Management

  • Own and govern the enterprise Technology Change Management / Change Enablement process.

  • Facilitate Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings, including agenda preparation, risk review, approvals, and follow-up actions.

  • Review, assess, approve, reject, or escalate change requests based on technical risk, business impact, user impact, compliance requirements, and operational readiness.

  • Maintain the enterprise change calendar and coordinate scheduling to avoid conflicts with critical business periods, peak operational windows, financial activities, and change freeze periods.

  • Ensure all changes are properly documented, tested, approved, communicated, and supported by rollback or contingency plans.

  • Define and maintain change categories, including Standard, Normal, Major, Emergency, and Retrospective changes.

  • Monitor failed changes, emergency changes, unauthorized changes, and change-related incidents to drive continuous improvement.


Service Transition & Operational Readiness

  • Lead end-to-end transition activities for new technology services moving from project delivery into live production support.

  • Develop and maintain service transition frameworks, go-live readiness checklists, acceptance criteria, and operational handover templates.

  • Ensure service ownership, support model, escalation paths, monitoring requirements, service desk scripts, knowledge articles, SOPs, and training materials are completed before go-live.

  • Coordinate knowledge transfer from Delivery teams, vendors, and implementation partners to internal Tech support teams.

  • Assess operational readiness for new systems, upgrades, integrations, and technology platforms before production deployment.

  • Ensure post-go-live support/hypercare plans are defined, communicated, and resourced appropriately.

Release & Deployment Management

  • Coordinate enterprise release schedules across applications, infrastructure, cloud services, network, security platforms and business systems.

  • Ensure release plans include deployment steps, validation activities, communication plans, business sign-off, rollback procedures and contingency measures.

  • Oversee production implementation windows and major technology cutovers in coordination with vendors, internal Tech teams and business stakeholders.

  • Conduct post-implementation reviews to identify lessons learned, recurring issues and improvement opportunities.

  • Maintain consistent governance for releases, patches, upgrades and production deployments.

Stakeholder & Vendor Coordination

  • Act as the primary Tech liaison for change, release, and service transition activities.

  • Partner with Tech Infrastructure, Data & Automation, Applications, Cyber Security, Service Delivery, Delivery, Digital Transformation, Finance, Procurement, Human Resources and all business units.

  • Coordinate third-party vendors and implementation partners to ensure delivery standards, support documentation, testing evidence, and handover requirements are met.

  • Provide clear and timely updates to Asnad Tech leadership and business stakeholders regarding major changes, risks, readiness gaps, and deployment outcomes.

  • Support a culture of strong communication, accountability, planning discipline, and service excellence.

Risk, Compliance & Governance

  • Identify technical, operational, cyber security, data privacy, service continuity, user-impact, and business risks associated with proposed changes.

  • Ensure change and transition activities comply with internal IT governance, audit expectations, cyber security controls, vendor obligations, and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Coordinate risk mitigation plans, change windows, contingency plans, rollback plans, and business communications for high-impact changes.

  • Participate in audit reviews and provide evidence for change approvals, testing, implementation, and post-change validation.

  • Escalate material risks, delayed readiness items, or unmanaged dependencies to Asnad Tech leadership.

Documentation, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain accurate change records, CAB minutes, transition plans, release schedules, risk logs, readiness assessments, and post-implementation review documentation.

  • Develop and track KPIs including change success rate, failed change percentage, emergency change volume, deployment success rate, transition readiness outcomes, and post-go-live incident trends.

  • Identify recurring service transition gaps and implement process improvements to increase service stability and operational maturity.

  • Support enhancement of ITSM tools, workflows, dashboards, approvals, templates, and automation opportunities.

  • Promote ITIL-aligned best practices across IT and business teams.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related discipline required.

  • ITILv4 Create, Deliver & Support preferred

  • ITILv4 Practice Manager e.g., Monitor Support and Fulfil (MSF), Plan Implement and Control (PIC), or Collaborate, Assure and Improve (CAI) preferred

  • PMP, Prince2, Agile, Scrum, Lean Six Signa, COBIT or related certifications required.

Technical Knowledge & Systems Exposure

  • Strong knowledge of ITIL practices, particularly Change Enablement, Service Transition, Release Management, Incident Management, Problem Management, Knowledge Management, Service Request Management, and Configuration Management / CMDB.

  • Understanding of infrastructure, network, cloud, cyber security, business applications, integrations management, identity access management, service desk operations, business continuity, disaster recovery, monitoring, and operational support models.

  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, and Azure Devops Release management is required.

  • Exposure to Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, Active Directory / Entra ID, endpoint management, enterprise applications, or related operational platforms is preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in implementing and driving adoption of IT Service Management, IT Operations, Change Management, Service Transition, Release Management, Devops Release Management.

title: DRP Supply Planner
description:
DRP Supply Planner

Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products – whether they are battling heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals – and add dimension and beauty with colorful finishes. We have a vast and ever-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles.

Job Summary: The DRP Supply Planner works directly with the North America DRP Supply Manager, North America Supply Chain Manager, and supply chain team to effectively report and analyze key metrics and data related to inventory health and customer order fulfillment, as well as managing and sustaining inventory levels within the US Low Bake network. The DRP Supply Planner owns and maintains the capability and sustainability of Transport Requirement Planning (TRP). The DRP Supply Planner translates and works directly with the supply chain team to challenge and improve current processes to improve network inventory levels, inventory day supply, and customer order fulfillment.

The DRP Supply Planner is accountable to provide quality and on-time supply chain reports, key metrics reported regionally and globally, collaborating with business teams to improve inventory health in North America and help maintain inventory levels to sustain service levels and inventory value goals as provided by the Axalta leadership teams.

Work Location: This role requires an onsite presence in Front Royal, VA and is not eligible for relocation nor sponsorship.

Expected Compensation: We consider an individual’s qualifications, skillset, and experience to determine final salary. This role is eligible for benefits such as health insurance and paid time off. The expected compensation range for this position is $70,000 - $80,000 annually. The actual offer will be at the company’s sole discretion and determined by relevant business considerations, including the final candidate’s qualifications, years of experience, skillset, and geographic location.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Recommend and/or implement process improvements related to inventory health within the refinish, commercial vehicle and liquid industrial supply chain, as well as export/intercompany supply.
  • Analyze and communicate with supply chain team and operations by keeping the right materials on hand to maintain a certain level of inventory within the network associated with global inventory health goals.
  • Manage and sustain transport requirement planning with collaboration and execution by the warehouse scheduling team.
  • Review and improve open orders (leading metrics) and on time/in full (lagging metrics) with collaboration from demand planning, customer service and master/detailed scheduling including representing supply chain planning on MSO (multi-shop owner) Conversions for NA Refinish market.
  • Review and provide alternate shipping to customer service related to open order fulfillment (i.e. fulfilling orders from different locations, triggering STO fulfillment either from Front Royal TRP planning or manual STO planning within the network).
  • Redirect inventory appropriately within the North America network to maintain appropriate inventory levels, improve service and stop unnecessary batch planning.
  • Maintain safety stocks and safety stock analysis process.
  • Provide quarterly/bi-annual reviews on inventory strategies to the supply chain manager to leverage best practices to sustain target inventory levels: ABC strategies, safety stock levels, replenishment planning.
  • Accountable to ensure that finished good product is in the right place at the right time to service customers at an identified fill rate.
  • Efficiently analyze and collaborate with supply chain planning team to alleviate supply chain imbalances that are creating potential customer order stock outs, low inventory service risks and/or non-quality costs.
  • Extract key data from SAP and/or OMP planning tools to populate spreadsheets and databases for supply analysis, including weekly and monthly reporting and metric population. Create and implement new metrics to help maintain distribution management of materials in our US Low Bake network.
  • Validate data and escalate key issues related to data needs, reporting, and metrics.
  • Assist operations, sourcing and/or supply chain in the execution of production, sourcing, supply scheduling and planning, and/or inventory management plans.
  • Determine/challenge most appropriate method for providing/reporting desired data.
  • Represent inventory network management in related projects, group discussions, meetings, critical tasks.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Minimum of three (3) years’ experience in a ‘planning’ function within Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Materials Management, Logistics or Analytics.

OR

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Materials Management, Logistics or related discipline.

Essential Skills/Knowledge:

  • Sound knowledge of supply planning, demand planning, S&OP process, inventory management, and forecasting.
  • Experience in batch planning processes with coatings or related industry alignment strongly preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge and understanding of technical aspects of product line.
  • Excellent writing capabilities and public speaking skills.
  • Problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to manage complexity and resolve conflicts that arise from balancing multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • APICS CPIM certification.

  • Experience with SAP/IBP

title: Grinder - 3rd Shift
description:
Work Model: This is a fully onsite role, with work performed at your designated Regal Rexnord office.

____________________

SUMMARY

Grind and clean castings to correct defects and/or prepare surfaces for further finishing, using industrial air tools.

Hours of this position are Sunday - Wednesday 8pm - 6am. Associates working 3rd shift are eligible for $2.75/hr shift differential.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Remove products or workpieces from production equipment

  • Select production equipment according to product specifications

  • Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment, utilizing cranes and hoists

  • Move controls to adjust, start, or stop equipment during grinding and polishing processes

  • Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications

  • Mark defects such as sand holes, cracks, and splits for repair

  • Record operational or production data

  • Maintain tools and equipment in good, working condition, and conduct regular inspections as required

  • Keep work area clean and organized

  • Adhere to all safety regulations

  • Work with team leads and other team members to improve processes

  • Remove gates and risers from castings using an air cannon

  • Separate gates and risers and place into appropriate bins

  • Perform other related or non-related duties as assigned

Critical Competencies

  • Must possess demonstrated knowledge of the structure and content of the English language, including the meaning and spelling of words, rules of composition, and grammar

  • Ability to follow directions and standard work procedures

  • Accuracy and attention to detail required

Education and Experience Requirements

  • High school diploma or GED preferred

  • Prior experience in manufacturing operations preferred, but not required

  • Successful completion of TB Woods PIV/Forklift License training and certification might be required upon hire

Physical Demand and Work Environment:

Work environment includes regular exposure to noise levels at or above 85 decibels, dust particles, and exposure to weather elements and heat. Some work stations require use of a respirator. The incumbent may be required to work in a “booth” during most of their shift. Work Appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be required to be worn during shift.

Physical requirements include lifting up to 50lbs, standing for long periods of time, good hand and finger dexterity, and ability to lean, bend, twist, and reach. The incumbent would need the ability to see at a close range and the ability to quickly and repeatedly adjust the controls of a machine or vehicle. The incumbent would need the ability to withstand the use of vibrating tools for extended periods of time. Power/air tools may include (but not limited to) the following: Cup Grinder, Cone Grinder, Burr Grinder, Air Chipper, Chipping Hammer, Chipping Gun, Saw.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescription Drug Coverage
  • Spending accounts (HSA, Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA)
  • Paid Time Off and Holidays
  • 401k Retirement Plan with Matching Employer Contributions
  • Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance
  • Paid Leaves
  • Tuition Assistance

Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.


The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.

title: Associate Director of Development, Home Base Program Texas
description:
Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated


Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.


Job Summary

The Mass General Brigham Development Office represents a team of 450+ vibrant, collaborative, and skilled fundraising professionals. We are dedicated to inspiring visionary philanthropy that advances caring and curing for patients in Boston and around the world. Philanthropy enables Mass General Brigham to deliver the highest quality patient care, pursue the most innovative and promising research, train the brightest minds to become the next generation of healthcare leaders, and expand and improve our world-class facilities. Join us in our mission to transform the future of medicine. The Mass General Brigham Development Office offers excellent benefits, competitive salaries, and a hybrid flexible work schedule.

To Apply:
Applications must include a current resume and a cover letter detailing applicable experience and accomplishments.

The Associate Director of Development, Home Base Texas, plays a key role within the Home Base Development team to advance the mission of Home Base and the Mass General Brigham Development Office. The Associate Director is responsible for the management and growth of a fundraising program in the Greater Houston area, which consists of the cultivation, solicitation and stewardship of individual, corporate and community supporters in Houston with potential expansion to other major cities/regions, along with highly visible events, for Home Base, a philanthropic partnership between the Red Sox Foundation and Mass General Hospital to provide clinical and support services to veterans, service members and their families impacted by post-traumatic stress, traumatic brain injuries and/or combat-related stress disorders.

Working under the direction of the Director of Development for Home Base and the Regional Associate Director, Home Base Texas, the Associate Director is responsible for securing support for Home Base’s Texas Operations, with a focus on unrestricted support. The Associate Director will work in close collaboration with the Home Base Texas and the Boston-based Development teams, key volunteers and with colleagues in various areas in the department and the hospital.

The ideal candidate will be a highly professional and collegial team player with an understanding of fundraising principles and practices; experience working with major gifts donors and volunteers; experience planning, organizing, and executing fundraising events; knowledge of health care; and familiarity with the goals and objectives of Home Base and the Mass General Brigham. The role is based in Houston, Texas and requires the ability to travel and to work evenings and weekends, as needed.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Frontline Fundraising
• Build and actively manage a portfolio of prospects and donors with an average giving capacity of $50K or higher, with the goal of raising about $1 million annually via individual and corporate giving. This includes: formulate and document appropriate development strategies, follow agreed upon targets for prospect activity and fundraising outcomes, implement moves management, and fully document work in ATLAS.
• Successfully solicit and close gifts (outright, life income, bequests, and gifts of assets) working with Home Base leadership, as appropriate.
• Work with prospects and donors to develop and enhance their relationship to and connection with Home Base, ultimately leveraging that relationship to maximize philanthropic giving with a focus on unrestricted support for Home Base’s Texas programs.
• Create and maintain a menu of giving opportunities and write case statements and proposals as needed.
• Seek out and advance higher level philanthropic opportunities.
• Working with the Director of Development and Regional Associate Director, manage relationships with key Home Base Texas volunteers and the Texas Leadership Council.
• Partner with volunteers to manage and recruit new prospects with the goal of developing and leveraging individual relationships to expand the philanthropic network.
• Facilitate regular meetings with volunteers and handle all logistics related to these meetings.
• Identify and recruit appropriate members to assigned philanthropic volunteer programs.
• Partner with the team and the Corporate and Foundation Relations program to build a pipeline for corporate and foundation support for the Texas programs.
• Work toward the successful attainment of individual and team fundraising goals, following approved development plans.
• Work in close collaboration with the Director of Development to manage the strategy for assigned volunteer groups, councils, and committees.
• Take on other duties at the request of Development and Home Base leadership.

Event Fundraising
• Partner with the Senior Director, Signature Events and other colleagues on the implementation of cultivation events.
• Collaborate with Special Events, Community Fundraising, Corporate and Foundation Relations and other Development programs to manage the following responsibilities:
o Manage and solicit corporate sponsorships for the programs within portfolio, including: working with Development staff to develop a strategic plan for corporate outreach for events.
o Work closely with Home Base Development staff to develop criteria for event guest lists and manage the process to create the list and mailings.
o Manage event committees including members’ communications; organize and attend meetings; and follow up.
o Work closely with the Home Base Events team to develop, promote and cultivate an active community fundraising plan, including a stewardship strategy for organizers.
o Develop an outreach to past organizers and ensure proper follow up.

description:

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems (NGMS) seeks to fill a Sr. Principal Engineer Systems Engineer position in the Mission Modeling Department at our Rolling Meadows, Illinois location. This role encompasses team leadership, management, and technical performance. Department assignments will be made at the conclusion of the interview process and be based on the candidate’s fit and preference.


NGMS is a leading global provider, manufacturer and integrator of advanced, secure and agile software-defined systems and solutions. Our products range from advanced sensing technologies to state-of-the-art targeting and tracking systems that are deployed in Electro-Optical Infrared (EOIR) tracking and counter measures and Radio Frequency Electronic Warfare (RFEW) systems. Our SEIT organization provides complex avionics systems in Targeting, EOIR, and RF technology areas.

In the Mission Modeling department, you will develop, integrate, test and analyze complex virtual representations of systems and environments. Responsibilities may include development of simulation code and scripts, design of system models, documentation of model assumptions and performance, test automation, test reports, and execution of integration test activities in virtual environments and/or System Integration Labs (SILs) or offsite locations. You will also perform mission level operational analysis utilizing System of Systems modeling and agent-based simulation. You’ll be able to apply your knowledge and experience in EOIR systems, optics, RF systems, algorithms, detection and tracking.


This position will be full-time, on-site at our Rolling Meadows, IL location.

This position is contingent upon Funding/Contract award, special access programs and acquiring and maintaining the necessary US Government security clearance per customers' requirements prior to start.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) field with 7 years of related experience; OR a Master’s degree in a STEM field with 5 years of related experience; OR PhD in a STEM field with 3 years of related experience.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in analytical thinking, problem solving skills and Systems thinking mindset
  • Experience as a Systems Engineering lead or integrated product team (IPT) lead on Infrared Countermeasures (IRCM) government engineering development programs
  • Highly proficient in model-based systems engineering concepts such as SysML and tools such as Cameo and Rhapsody
  • Active Object Management Group (OMG)
  • Certifications: OSCMP SysML Model User, and Model Builder Fundamental
  • Active OMG Certification: SysML v2 Model User
  • Experience utilizing SysML and UAF for modeling Mission Threads and Mission Engineering Threads
  • Experience developing automated reports from SysML modeling
  • Experience authoring model-development plans
  • Experience developing MBSE and Style Guides for the SysML, UML, or UAF Languages
  • Demonstrated experience developing federated sets of models
  • Demonstrated experience applying MBSE methodologies and techniques to technical trade studies
  • Experience presenting MBSE content to internal and external stakeholders and customers
  • Experience developing MBSE Onboarding materials
  • Knowledge of and experience in MATLAB, C, C++, CUDA, VHDL, OpenCL, SysML, Python, or other scripting languages
  • Knowledge of virtual environments, operational analysis or mission modeling (AFSIM, STK, BRAWLER, ATCOM, ONESAF)
  • US Citizenship required
  • Active Top-Secret Clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with real-time signal processing in both firmware and software
  • Agile development experience
  • Experience in Electronic Warfare
  • Experience in an abstract modeling environment (Rhapsody, Cameo, UML etc) for complex electronic systems evaluation
  • Experience performing system verification and validation
  • Working knowledge of EOIR systems, optics, RF systems, algorithms, detection and/or tracking
  • Proficiency in MATLAB, C, C++, CUDA, VHDL, OpenCL, SysML, Python, or other scripting languages
  • Working knowledge of DOORS and ClearCase/ClearQuest
  • Experience in an integration and test environment for complex electronic systems evaluation
  • Experience in development and earned value management of cost accounts and schedules as related to Systems Engineering tasks

title: Senior Research Scientist
description:
Site: The Brigham and Women's Hospital, Inc.


Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.


Job Summary

The Chief Scientific Officer, Research Strategy and Operations serves as the senior scientific and operational leader for the Korzenik Lab at the Resnek Family Center for Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis Research. Working in close partnership with the Principal Investigator, this role provides high-level leadership across research strategy, program operations, personnel management, regulatory oversight, and institutional collaboration in support of a complex and growing research enterprise.
This individual will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing the Center’s scientific and operational vision across basic, translational, and clinical research initiatives. The Executive Lab Director will align people, processes, and resources to advance scientific priorities, strengthen organizational infrastructure, and position the lab for sustained impact, growth, and cross-disciplinary collaboration.
The ideal candidate is an accomplished research leader with a strong scientific foundation, exceptional operational judgment, and the ability to lead through influence in a highly collaborative academic medical environment.


Qualifications

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Scientific and Program Leadership

Serve as a senior partner to the Principal Investigator in defining and advancing the scientific and operational vision of the Korzenik Lab and the Resnek Family Center. Provide leadership across a diverse research portfolio spanning basic, translational, and clinical investigation. Guide the planning, prioritization, and execution of research initiatives to ensure alignment with programmatic goals and institutional standards. Contribute to scientific analysis, interpretation, and the development of presentations, reports, publications, and other scholarly outputs. Anticipate scientific and operational barriers and drive solutions that support research progress and program growth.

Research Operations and Infrastructure

Lead all aspects of laboratory operations, ensuring a high-performing, well-organized, and scalable research environment. Oversee laboratory infrastructure, workflows, scheduling, space allocation, equipment, vendor relationships, and inventory systems. Design and implement operational systems that enhance efficiency, resource stewardship, and execution across the research enterprise. Establish best practices and operating procedures that support consistency, quality, and long-term sustainability.

Leadership, Talent, and Culture

Provide leadership, supervision, and mentorship to research staff, trainees, and laboratory personnel. Build an engaged, inclusive, and accountable team culture grounded in collaboration, professionalism, and scientific excellence. Oversee talent-related processes including onboarding, training compliance, role clarity, and day-to-day staff support. Help develop internal capacity by coaching team members and strengthening operational and research capabilities across the lab.

Regulatory, Compliance, and Risk Oversight

Provide senior oversight for research compliance, laboratory safety, biosafety practices, and regulatory readiness. Direct the preparation, maintenance, and monitoring of relevant research and animal protocols. Serve as the primary liaison to institutional compliance offices, animal care programs, and administrative partners on regulatory and operational matters. Ensure systems are in place to support audit readiness, protocol renewals, and compliance continuity.

Financial and Resource Stewardship

Lead budget planning, expenditure oversight, and financial forecasting for the laboratory and related research activities. Partner with finance, grants, and administrative teams to support sound post-award management and operational decision-making. Monitor resource utilization and identify opportunities for cost containment, vendor optimization, and long-term sustainability. Provide the Principal Investigator with strategic insight into spending trends, operational needs, and resource planning.

Institutional and External Partnership Development

Represent the lab in interactions with institutional leaders, researchers, clinicians, and external collaborators. Strengthen coordination across multidisciplinary teams and support the development of collaborative initiatives and shared resources. Serve as a trusted connector across scientific, operational, and administrative stakeholders to enable effective execution and partnership.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a biological, chemical, biomedical, or related scientific field required. Significant experience in research leadership, laboratory operations, or research administration in an academic medical center, hospital, or biomedical research environment required.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree preferred; Master’s degree or PhD strongly favored. Demonstrated success overseeing complex research programs, teams, compliance processes, and budgets strongly preferred. Experience working across institutional systems and with multidisciplinary collaborators preferred.

Leadership Profile

Executive-level judgment and strategic thinking. Strong people leadership and team development capabilities. Operational sophistication and the ability to build high-functioning systems. Excellent communication and relationship management skills. Collaborative leadership style with the ability to influence across functions and levels. Commitment to scientific rigor, operational excellence, and mission-driven research.

Working Environment

This position is based in the Korzenik Lab at the Resnek Family Center for Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis Research and supports a high-impact research program dedicated to advancing understanding and treatment of primary sclerosing cholangitis through integrated basic, translational, and clinical investigation.

title: Safety Representative
description:
This job description is a general description of the essential job functions and is not intended to be an employment contract. Eastern Shipbuilding Group, Inc. maintains its status as an at-will employer. Position requirements, skills, and abilities included in this job description have been determined to be the minimal standards required to successfully perform the position. Eastern Shipbuilding Group Inc. reserves the right to increase, waive or reduce these minimal standards. In no instance, however, should the duties, responsibilities, and requirements described be interpreted as all-inclusive. All employees of Eastern Shipbuilding Group, Inc. are expected to perform the duties as assigned by Eastern Shipbuilding Group, Inc., supervisory/management personnel, regardless of job title or routine job duties. Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

To perform this job successfully, an individual is expected to be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability expected. In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. However, no accommodation will be made which may pose serious health or safety risks to the employee or others or which imposes undue hardship on Eastern Shipbuilding.

POSITION SUMMARY

Support the Safety Manager in safety-related functions within the shipyards. Perform safety activities on Company property to evaluate, identify, and correct potential safety issues.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES MAY INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING: Because Eastern Shipbuilding is continually growing to meet the needs of our customers; your duties and responsibilities may be different than described.

  • Regular attendance at work and the ability to work flexible hours, including overtime, weekends, and holidays.
  • Comply with company, Federal, State, and local safety, ethics, and environmental rules, regulations, and policies while performing duties.
  • Inspect designated workplace areas.
  • Assist in enforcing the use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and safety equipment.
  • Assist in the issuance and monitoring of hot work permits, confined space entries, and lockout/ tag-out permits.
  • Administer first aid as needed.
  • Conduct Safety Orientation.
  • Administer post-accident/ near-miss drug tests as required.
  • Advance knowledge of safety (minimum 18 months of safety experience) and knowledge of fire or medical (preferred). Including a type of certification or medical/fire class.
  • Advanced computer skills, including word, Excel.
  • Holds teamwork and consistency in high regard
  • Have a solid foundational knowledge of safety (minimum 12 months of safety experience) and fire or medical(preferred).
    • Due to the need for medical professionals, experience may be substituted
  • Solid computer knowledge, including word, Excel.
  • Safety Competent Person trained.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

REQUIREMENTS

Education/ Experience: High school diploma or GED equivalence plus one year of safety experience in a manufacturing or construction environment desired. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered. Knowledge of ship terminology, safety, and OSHA regulations is desired. Shipyard Competent Person Certification is required. Completion of First Aid and CPR training desired.

Skills: Basic level Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook. Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, Company policies/ procedures, and governmental regulations. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from supervisors and employees. Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.

Behavioral Attributes: Integrity, ethics, flexibility/ adaptability, initiative, interpersonal skills, attention to detail, safety consciousness, and multitasking. Maintain the confidential integrity of details pertaining to Eastern Shipbuilding Group.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations: The ability to obtain and maintain a valid driver’s license is required.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate. The employee is frequently required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. This position is very active and requires standing, walking, bending, kneeling, stooping, crouching, crawling, and climbing throughout the workday. The employee must frequently lift and/ or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. The employee must be physically and medically qualified to wear all required personal protective equipment, as prescribed under Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) standards. The employee must be able to work above ground at heights of a minimum of 50 feet aloft and/ or working from scaffolding and/ or man-lifts while working with machinery; in confined spaces and withstanding extreme heat and cold in an outside climate or confined space.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The employee may be exposed to the risk of electrical shock, moving mechanical parts, vibration, fumes, airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals, continual loud noise, and other hazards found in a heavy industrial shipyard environment. Rigorous compliance with safety procedures, policies, and personal safety equipment requirements is therefore mandatory.

We are equal opportunity/affirmative action employers, committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under state or local law.

title: Er du den trygge voksne i hverdagen vår? ❤️
description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Fast
⏰ Arbeidstid: Kveld og dag


Vi er to tvilling jenter som er bosatt med mamma i Skatval. Vi er blide og hyggelige jenter som liker å bade i basseng, pusle puslespill og leke med putte i boks. Vi liker å dra på svømming to ganger i uken, og vi er veldig glade i sang og musikk. I tillegg liker vi godt å være ute sammen med assistentene våre.

Vi har en sjelden genetisk tilstand som skaper litt forsinkelser i utviklingen, samt noen atferds utfordringer. Vi har også epilepsi. Dette gjør at vi trenger hjelp til det meste i hverdagen, fra bleieskift til personlig stell og lek. Vi trenger voksne personer som kan støtte og trygge oss i hverdagen og hjelpe oss med å få til ting selv. Med litt hjelp og støtte så klarer vi nemlig det meste selv!

Er du vår nye assistent? Vi gleder oss til å lese søknaden din 😊

Togstasjonen er bare 15 min. gange fra der vi bor, om du ikke har bil og kjører selv. Arbeidstid kan justeres etter togruter.

Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidstid:

Vi har ledige deltidsstillinger på kveld i ukedager og dag og kveld på helg.

Alle stillingene har to arbeids helger pr. turnus på 4 uker.

1. 55% stilling ledig kveld/dag

2. 50% stilling ledig kveld/dag

3. 50% stilling ledig kveld/dag

4. 25% stilling ledig kveld/dag

5. 25% stilling ledig kveld/dag

Arbeidstid på kveld 15.00 til 22.30

Arbeidstid på dag 08.30 til 15.00

Alle stillingene har mulighet for vikartimer om det er av interesse.

Vennligst oppgi i søknaden hvilken stilling du søker på.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Være en støtteperson i hverdagen

  • Personlig stell, f.eks. bytte bleier

  • Hjelp med påkledning

  • Noe husarbeid

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Gode norskkunnskaper

  • Over 18 år

  • Fordel med tidligere erfaring med atferdsvansker hos barn

  • Fordel med førerkort klasse B, men ikke et krav

  • Fordel med kjennskap til epilepsi

  • Fordel med erfaring med tegn til tale/ASK

Egenskaper:

  • Tålmodige

  • Lekne

  • Trygge på seg selv

  • Tilpasningsdyktige og åpne for å lære

  • Regulerende voksne som vet når man må være rolig

Vi kaller inn til intervjuer fortløpende, og ansetter så snart vi har funnet riktig kandidater.

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Wenche Winsnes på epost: wenche.winsnes@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

title: AI Data Analyst
description:
AI Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As an AI Data Analyst supporting expeditionary logistics, you will unlock the information and value held by a data set, machine learning, and artificial intelligence (AI). In an increasingly connected world, massive amounts of structured and unstructured data open new opportunities to logistics. As a data scientist at Booz Allen, you can help turn these complex data sets into useful information to solve global challenges. You’ll work with and learn from your teammates as you develop algorithms and systems. You’ll use the right combination of tools and frameworks to turn sets of disparate data points into objective answers so that your clients can make informed decisions. Ultimately, you’ll provide a deep understanding of the data, what it all means, and how it can be used.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • Experience with common scripting languages such as Python or R
  • Experience with object-oriented programming
  • Knowledge of data processing frameworks such as Pandas, Polars, or Spark
  • Knowledge of structured and unstructured data sources
  • Knowledge of machine learning, AI, or natural language processing
  • Ability to develop predictive data models, quantitative analyses, and visualization of targeted data sources
  • Ability to deploy natural language processing, text mining, or machine learning techniques
  • Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience in the development of algorithms leveraging R, Python, or SQL and NoSQL
  • Experience with distributed data or computing tools, including MapReduce, Hadoop, Hive, EMR, Kafka, Spark, Gurobi, or MySQL

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Software Engineer / Lead Software Engineer to join a new enterprise application development project. The selected candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, and supporting enterprise-grade applications across frontend, backend, integration, reporting, and database layers.

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in ReactJS as the primary technology, complemented by solid hands-on experience in Spring Boot and NodeJS. The role demands the ability to build, optimize, and support high-performance, transaction-intensive applications while leveraging modern AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and software quality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications using ReactJS, NodeJS, and Spring Boot.
  • Develop responsive, scalable, and high-performance user interfaces with a strong focus on usability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Build and integrate RESTful APIs and microservices with frontend applications and external systems.
  • Perform application performance tuning, troubleshooting, and production support activities.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, exception handling, and transaction management best practices.
  • Support secure integrations using WSO2 API Manager and SFTP/OpenSSH.
  • Develop and maintain reports using Jasper Reports Server.
  • Design, optimize, and troubleshoot PostgreSQL database queries and related database components.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, and release activities.
  • Utilize AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent solutions for:
  • Code generation
  • Code refactoring
  • Root cause analysis
  • Troubleshooting and debugging
  • Unit test creation
  • Documentation generation
  • Productivity improvement
  • Ensure compliance with coding standards, security guidelines, and software development lifecycle processes.

Mandatory Technical Skills

Frontend Development (Primary Skill)

  • Strong hands-on experience in ReactJS development with the ability to independently develop and maintain complex enterprise applications.
  • Deep understanding of:
  • Component Architecture
  • React Hooks
  • Routing
  • State Management (Redux Toolkit, Context API)
  • Asynchronous API Integration
  • Frontend Performance Optimization
  • Browser Debugging and Troubleshooting
  • Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and modern frontend development practices.
  • Experience handling real-time transactions, performance bottlenecks, logging, and monitoring within enterprise applications.
  • Strong understanding of scalable and maintainable frontend architecture and design principles.

Application Platform

  • Hands-on experience with NodeJS for application build, dependency management, packaging, deployment, and hosting of ReactJS applications.
  • Good understanding of modern frontend build and deployment frameworks.
  • Exposure to ExpressJS will be an added advantage.

Backend Development

  • Strong development experience in Spring Boot.
  • Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs and Microservices.
  • Good understanding of:
  • Transaction Management

title: Senior Engineer, Product Security Testing
description:
Job Description :

Job Description Details: Senior Engineer - Product Security : Bangalore, India


We are currently seeking a Senior Engineer, Product Security to join our Product Security team, based in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of attack surfaces in modern compiled applications and operating systems. Candidates must demonstrate the ability to analyze closed source applications using several off-the-shelf or custom-developed tools. Additionally, the ideal candidate will be able to demonstrate exceptional organizational skills, work efficiently under minimal supervision, be able to deliver results that meet or exceed the organization’s expectations, be a strong team player, and actively participate in a fast-paced and challenging global environment.


As part of our Product Security team, you shall perform penetration testing which includes internet,

intranet, wireless, web application, APIs, Mobile Applications and social engineering. You shall also

perform in-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create reports that describe findings,

exploitation procedures, risks and recommendation


Key Responsibilities:

● Hands-on experience with OWASP Web and Mobile Top 10 standards,NIST CSF, NIST SP 800,PCI

DSS including mitigation of common threats.

● Strong understanding of the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and OWASP Top 10 for

Generative AI, with hands-on experience identifying and validating AI/LLM-specific security risks.

● Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10 web and the ability to effectively communicate

methodologies and techniques with development teams

● Execute penetration testing projects using the established methodology, tools and rules of

engagements.

● Solid understanding of application security topics such as authentication, authorization,

encryption, session management, federation, API security, etc.

● Extensive experience with web and mobile application security tools like code scanners

(Checkmarx, Fortify, Ghidra, Hopper, MobSF) and dynamic analysis tools (Burp Suite, ZAP, etc.).

● Experienced in performing security assessments of AI models, LLM-powered applications,

chatbots, AI agents, and AI-integrated APIs, covering both traditional and AI-specific attack

vectors.

● Hands-on experience with AI security testing tools, prompt engineering, adversarial testing

techniques, and integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with security tools to

automate and enhance AI security assessments.

● Skilled in evaluating AI systems for vulnerabilities such as prompt injection, indirect prompt

injection, sensitive information disclosure, insecure tool usage, excessive agency, model

manipulation, and unsafe output handling.

● Proficient in designing and executing end-to-end AI penetration testing methodologies,

leveraging automation and custom tooling to improve assessment efficiency and coverage.

● Write reports including recommendations, root cause analysis, security summary analysis, and

project roadmaps.

● Review application code for security vulnerabilities and practices dangerous to security and

privacy.

● Convey complex technical security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences including

executives.

● Mentor junior members of the team and act as a subject matter expert for application security

issues.

● Manage integration with manual and automated tools for static and dynamic testing.

● Conduct threat modeling and risk analysis to identify exposure and develop mitigation plans.

● Build security into infrastructure and architecture designs and guide the implementation with

the operations team

● Experience with cloud security, particularly for AWS and/or Azure Experience with integrating

security into a DevOps culture.


Minimum Qualifications.

● Bachelor's degree/MTech with an emphasis on cyber security.

● Minimum 6 years of experience in Product and Application Security performing, Penetration

Testing on Web Application, Mobile (Android and IOS) APIs, SAST, SCA, SSDLC. Threat Modeling

and Secure design review would be an added advantage.

● 1-2 years of software development with at least 1 year in developing secure systems.

● Experience in one or more of the following modern languages/frameworks - Python, Java, Ruby,

node.js, JavaScript, PHP, Go.

● Basic understanding of DevOps & DevSecOps principles and building code pipelines.

● A passion for application security and working knowledge of web application vulnerabilities and

mitigations.

● Known for being a great communicator and collaborator with excellent written and verbal

communication skills.

● Demonstrable flair for technical writing, including engagement reports, presentations and

operating procedures

● Experience with severity ratings systems, and ability to calculate CVSS ratings for identified

vulnerabilities.


Preferred Certifications

● CPENT, LPT, GPEN, OSCP

title: Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L1)
description:

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA
As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will be the first point of contact for our clients, ensuring their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You will proactively identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, focusing on first-line support for standard and low-complexity incidents and service requests. Your aim? To ensure zero missed service level agreement conditions.

Every day, you will monitor client infrastructure and solutions, identifying problems and errors before or as they occur. You will dive deep into first-line incidents assigned to you, pinpointing the root causes, and providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support to our clients when they need it most. Maintenance activities, such as patching and configuration changes, will be part of your routine, ensuring the smooth operation of client systems.

You will work across two or more technology domains, such as Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications, or Collaboration. Your day may include updating existing knowledge articles or creating new ones, seeking opportunities for work optimization, and supporting project work as needed. Additionally, you will contribute to disaster recovery functions and tests, ensuring our clients' DATA is safe and sound.

Shift changes are made seamless with your careful handovers, ensuring service continuity. You will report and escalate incidents when necessary and strive for efficient, comprehensive resolutions of incidents and requests. With each interaction, you will aim to provide a positive client experience, placing their needs at the forefront of all you do.

  • Skill in planning activities and projects in advance and adapting to changing circumstances.
  • A client-centric approach, understanding their requirements and ensuring a positive experience throughout their journey.
  • Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
  • Proficiency in active listening techniques and refraining from interrupting.
  • A positive outlook at work, even in pressurized environments.

Transport freight across dock area to/from trailers for loading to trailers.

title: Baliemedewerker
description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een praktijk waar je een volle en gevarieerde agenda hebt en wil je aan de slag in een team dat voor elkaar klaar staat? Ben jij iemand die bij- en nascholing belangrijk vindt en ga je voor een langdurige samenwerking? Lees dan verder!

Voor onze tandartspraktijk in Zwolle zijn wij op zoek naar een Baliemedewerker voor 3 dagen per week. De dagen zijn in overleg. Ben je meer of minder uur beschikbaar? Ook dan komen wij graag met jou in contact!

Waar ga je werken?
Je gaat werken bij Heeldemond Tandartsen, een tandartspraktijk met een ervaren, professioneel en betrokken team. De praktijk heeft 6 ruim ingerichte behandelkamers waar onze patiënten terecht kunnen voor algemene tandheelkunde, holistische tandheelkunde, implantologie en prothetiek. Als tandartspraktijk geloven wij in professionaliteit en in samenwerking. Deze kernwaarden definiëren onze passie en trots: het leveren van de beste Mondzorg aan onze patiënten! Intercollegiaal overleg vinden we belangrijk, we bespreken casussen en leren op die manier van elkaar.

De praktijk wordt ondersteund door een Praktijk Manager en een Service Center, waardoor jij en de rest van het team zich volledig kunnen focussen op het vakgebied.

Wat bieden wij jou?

• Een arbeidsovereenkomst met een passend salaris volgens de "Colosseum schalen"
• Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de "Arbeidsvoorwaarden Colosseum"
• Een leuke, veelzijdige baan, waar geen dag hetzelfde is

• Uitstekende bij- en nascholingsmogelijkheden via onze "Colosseum Academy"
• Je gaat werken in een inspirerende, professionele werkomgeving als lid van een gemotiveerd team

Onze verwachtingen

Als baliemedewerker ben je het eerste aanspreekpunt van de praktijk en daarmee het visitekaartje van Smile Clinic Ommoord. Patiënten kunnen bij jou terecht met vragen en opmerkingen. Als baliemedewerker is je hoofdtaak om de agenda’s van de vele behandelaren optimaal te plannen. Dit doe je persoonlijk met patiënten aan de balie of telefonisch.

Bij pijnklachten moet je de urgentie van hulpvraag kunnen beoordelen. Verder verricht je ondersteunende administratieve werkzaamheden.

Je werkt met een tandheelkundig programma, Exquise genaamd.

We zoeken iemand die een langdurige samenwerking ambieert en zich herkent in het volgende:

· Je beschikt over mbo niveau 4 werk- en denkniveau en hebt bij voorkeur werkervaring in de tandheelkunde

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift

· Je beheerst het programma Exquise

· Goede kennis van MS Office

• Je hebt een positieve instelling en bent een doener

• Je bent in het bezit van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) of bereid deze aan te vragen

title: Senior Commercial Loan Closer
description:
General Responsibilities

Responsible for performing a variety of duties to support the loan documentation and loan processing function for commercial/small business transactions; coordinating work within the department, as well as with other departments; reporting pertinent information to the immediate supervisor; responding to inquiries or requests for information.


Essential Duties

  1. Performs a variety of duties to support the loan documentation function as follows:
  • Verifies all loan information pertaining to small business and commercial lending in preparation for final loan documentation for closing.
  • Verifies loan approvals to loan policies.
  • Reviews loan applications to verify that application data is complete and meets establishment standards, including full execution by all parties and Bank.
  • Reviews document preparation folders for completeness and accuracy
  • Informs Lenders and administrative support of missing information, documentation and discrepancies.
  • Verifies loan to values as appropriate to the transaction at hand and for reporting accuracy.
  • Completes and/or follows up on any additional records with regard to the processed loans
  • Prepares and reviews commercial modification documentation as needed including calculation of adjusted payments.
  • Obtains additional needed information through a variety of methods in order to ensure that the proper preliminary documentation has been obtained prior to the preparation of final loan documentation, i.e. articles of incorporation, business agreements, certificate of good standing, appraisals, automated underwriting findings, investment account statements, etc.
  • Performs review of attorney-prepared loan documentation for accuracy and informs Lenders of necessary changes, as needed.
  • Performs secondary review of loan documentation of other loan closers prior to distribution of loan documents including review of attorney-prepared loan documentation.
  • Generates and distributes loan documentation for closings to Lenders and administrative support; reviews HUD Settlements statements and verifies accuracy and funds to close.
  • Reviews executed loan documentation to ensure that the proper signatures have been obtained after closing including loans where documentation has been prepared by outside counsel; ensures all the proper documents are included in the final loan files and completes the organization of the permanent loan documentation file.
  • Provides support to post-closing loan processor, when necessary, with regards to tracking and preparation of the loan file for imaging and filing
  • Processes withdrawn, approved not accepted and declined commercial loans as needed for HMDA reporting purposes including generating Adverse Action Notice for loans declined due to poor credit history
  • May assist in the training of Commercial Loan Closer


Ancillary Duties

  • Perform tasks which are supportive in nature of the essential functions of the job, but which may be altered or re-designed depending upon individual circumstances.


Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the essential job functions of this position, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, talk, hear, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel objects, and reach with hands and arms. At times required to stoop, kneel, bend, crouch and lift up to 25 pounds. This position requires regular use of a computer.

title: GP Hub Recovery Coordinator (London)
description:
GP Hub Recovery Coordinator

Location: HAGA, Seven Sisters Road
Working Hours: 37 hours (full time)
Contract Type: Permanent
Salary: £28,690.00 - £37,126.37

Make a real difference in your community

Are you passionate about helping others live safer, healthier and more independent lives?


Join Waythrough, one of the UK’s leading mental health and social support charities, and make a lasting impact every day.


We support over 125,000 people each year through our 200 services, empowering individuals to overcome challenges around mental health, housing, and substance use.

About the role

We have an exciting opportunity to join Haringey Alcohol and Recovery Service (HAGA) as a GP Hub Recovery Coordinator.

As a GP Hub Recovery Coordinator, you will work as part of a dedicated multi-disciplinary team, supporting people affected by substance use who are accessing support through GP and primary care settings. You will play an important role in engaging people early, helping them to understand the impact of their substance use and supporting them to access the right treatment, recovery and community services.

You will work closely with GP practices, healthcare professionals, service users and partner agencies to provide a joined-up approach to support. The role will involve working with people on a one-to-one basis, as well as contributing to and facilitating peer support groups and other community-based interventions.

The role will suit someone who is positive, motivated and able to work confidently with people who may have a range of complex needs. You will be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and developing effective relationships with professionals across primary care and the wider community.

Direct experience of working in substance use services is desirable but not essential. We welcome applications from people with transferable skills and experience who have a genuine passion for supporting people to achieve positive change.

Key responsibilities

  • Manage a caseload of service users, devising, implementing and reviewing personalised recovery and treatment plans, working closely with colleagues, family members and significant others where appropriate.

  • Carry out triage, screening and comprehensive assessments, identifying individuals' needs, strengths and risks and ensuring they are supported to access appropriate treatment and recovery pathways.

  • Work collaboratively with GP practices, healthcare professionals and partner agencies to provide joined-up support and promote progression from initial engagement through structured treatment towards sustained recovery.

  • Facilitate access to treatment, peer support and community resources, helping service users to build their recovery and social capital and supporting them to develop sustainable support networks within their local community.

  • Develop and deliver high-quality psychosocial interventions, group work and one-to-one support, helping individuals to build confidence, self-efficacy and the skills needed to achieve their recovery goals.

About you

  • You will have experience of working in a client-facing role, with the ability to build positive and trusting relationships with people from a range of backgrounds and circumstances.

  • You will be compassionate, non-judgemental and person-centred, with a genuine belief in people's ability to make positive changes and take control of their recovery journey.

  • You will be confident working collaboratively with professionals and partner agencies, including colleagues within primary care, and able to communicate effectively across a multi-disciplinary team.

  • You will be organised and adaptable, with the ability to manage a caseload, prioritise competing demands and work effectively in a fast-paced and sometimes challenging environment.

  • You will be motivated to develop your knowledge and skills, with an understanding of or interest in substance use, health inequalities and recovery. Direct substance use experience is desirable, but transferable experience will also be considered.

We welcome applications from people with lived experience of substance use, as we recognise the valuable insight and perspective this can bring to our services.

To view the job description, please click here.

Please note: The salary listed reflects the full earning potential for this role. Starting salaries depend on experience and progression within the band.

About Waythrough

Waythrough was formed in 2024 following the merger of Humankind and Richmond Fellowship. Together, we’ve created one of the largest mental health and social support charities in England.

Every year, we support around 125,000 people through nearly 200 services – and it’s all made possible by our 3,500 brilliant staff and volunteers.

Make a real difference in your community

Are you passionate about helping others live safer, healthier, more independent lives? Join our team at Waythrough and support people facing challenges around mental health, substance use, housing or domestic abuse. This is more than just a job – it’s a chance to build meaningful relationships and create lasting change.

What We Offer

We value the people who make a difference every day. Alongside meaningful work, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package:

  • 27 days’ annual leave, rising to 32 after 1 year (plus bank holidays)

  • Pension scheme with 4.5% employer contribution, matched up to 6.5%

  • Life assurance (3× annual salary)

  • Enhanced sick pay and family-friendly pay

  • Birthday leave and the option to buy up to 5 extra days’ annual leave

  • Professional fee reimbursement for relevant qualifications

  • 24/7 online GP access and Employee Assistance Programme

  • Recognition and long service awards via our Way to Go and Aspirations portals

  • £500 Recommend a Friend bonus

  • Cycle to Work scheme and Credit Union membership

  • Discounts via Blue Light Card, Charity Discounts, Extras and Tickets for Good

  • Free will writing service and wellbeing initiatives throughout the year

Inclusion and accessibility

Waythrough is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and communities, especially those with lived experience of the issues we support.

We have signed up to the Disability Confident Scheme - all applicants are welcome, and adjustments can be made to enable fair participation.

If you need adjustments or support to apply, please email our recruitment team: recruitmentteam@waythrough.org.uk

As a Logistics Process Analyst supporting Expeditionary Logistics, you will help organizational and continuously improve business processes of current and future logistics requirements. Your work will provide process analysis as organizations refocusing on the future operating environment envisioned in concepts and a rapidly changing current operations tempo. Future logistics operations will involve the continued integration of capabilities to meet the challenge of seamlessly integrating the needs of the warfighters today with the capabilities required and developing efforts and support required to improve capabilities and lethality by improving expeditionary logistics processes in support of evolving requirements and concepts.

Your work will prioritize quality and consistency while helping the team deliver logistics capabilities more quickly, improve adoption, and reduce unnecessary manual effort. Your ability to organize complex information, collaborate across teams, and translate business needs into practical operational solutions will directly improve how logistics delivers capabilities. title: Data Center Controls Technician, Controls Deployment Service
description:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.

Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.

Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.

Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.

Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.

Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.

Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.

Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.

Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.

Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.

Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.

Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.

Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.

Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.

Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.

Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.

Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.

Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Controls Technician, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who rely on you to keep Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) healthy and operational. On a given day, you are the boots on the ground solving problems that directly impact data center availability. You might diagnose a controller communication loss, calibrate instruments feeding inaccurate data to operators, or supervise vendors performing quarterly maintenance. For new builds, you perform point to point testing and support commissioning alongside construction teams. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Engineer, Controls Manager, partner teams (Field Engineering, Critical Project Implementation, DCEO), and the vendors you oversee.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Staff Test Engineer – Lab Manager Lead
description:
