Job Requisition ID:

JR0000004533

Shift:

Not Applicable (United States of America)

Compensation Details:

$35 - $50 / HOUR

Job Description:


POSITION: PART-

TIME INTERPRETER, SIGN LANGUAGE

Part time opportunities become available periodically at various campuses. we accept application to build a resource pool of qualified part-time employees

PRIMARY LOCATION:

College-wide (Contingent on Class Locations)

DESCRIPTION:

Under general supervision, provides interpreting/transliterating for deaf and hard of hearing students. Confers and plans with students, teachers and other interpreters in preparation for assignments. Sign language interpreters facilitate the communication and integration of deaf and hard-of-hearing students (including faculty, staff and college guests) into the classroom, other instructional settings, and into the college community either by way of American Sign language (ASL), or Signed English, Transliteration (a manual, oral or tactile system of communication.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required.

Provide American Sign Language (ASL) interpreting and transliteration services for Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (D/HH) students, faculty, and staff in classrooms and a variety of academic and institutional settings (meetings, registration, advising, testing, tutoring, counseling, etc.).

Must have strong attention to detail, excellent listening skills, and a solid grasp of English grammar, vocabulary, and punctuation.

Accurately convey the meaning, intent, tone, and register of spoken and signed communication.

Exercise independent, real-time professional judgment to determine the most effective interpreting methods based on the assignment and the communication needs of the consumer.

Adhere to the Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf (RID) Code of Professional Conduct, including standards related to confidentiality, professionalism, and appropriate role boundaries.

Collaborate with students, faculty, staff, and accessibility services to ensure effective communication access.

Adapt interpreting strategies to meet diverse linguistic, cultural, and educational needs.

Prepare for assignments by reviewing relevant materials, terminology, and subject matter when available.

Maintain professionalism, punctuality, and reliability for all scheduled assignments.

Perform related duties as assigned in support of intuitional accessibility and compliance obligations

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Associate degree in American Sign Language Studies from an accredited Interpreter Training Program (ITP) is required. In lieu of the required degree, a minimum of two (2) years of documented professional experience as a sign language interpreter in a postsecondary educational setting may be substituted. Substitution of experience for the degree will be accepted on a year-for-year basis.

All applicants must complete an online application, upload resume, unofficial transcripts, and cover letter. Official transcripts are required within 60 days of employment.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

In addition to minimum qualifications, MUST have NIC (National Interpreter Certification) or RID Legacy Certification (CI/CT)

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

Must have and maintain a valid driver's license

Maintain automobile insurance coverage; and have reliable transportation

Willingness to travel to assignments as needed

TIME-BASED /EMPLOYEMENT STATUS

Hourly, intermittent, on-call temporary position. Successful candidates may be appointed for assignments ranging from a few days up to one (1) year, depending on institutional needs. Temporary assignments may expire prior to the stated ending date.

**** Flexible Schedule: Willingness to adjust schedules to meet student needs, which may include evenings or weekends. ****

Physical Demands: Depending on the class or activity, the employee may be required to interpret outdoors. Depending on the class, the employee may need to provide their own PPE (personal protection equipment such as appropriate footwear and eyewear. If the class exceeds an hour and forty-five minutes, the interpreter will be provided a team interpreter.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and listen. The employee is regularly required to stand, walk, sit, and use hands to operate instructional equipment and computers. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job includes close visions and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment: While performing the duties of this position, the employee will travel by automobile and be exposed to changing weather conditions. The employee will be required to drive to various instructional facilities.

salary/benefits:

The starting salary is $35 - $50 per hour. Actual salary will be based on the candidate’s certifying credentials. This is a part time position working up to 19.5 hours per week and is not eligible for benefits. Georgia Defined Contributions, Social Security and taxes will be deducted.

Minimum Qualifications:

High school diploma or equivalent *and* Two (2) years related work experience

Summary<br>Manages comprehensive medical nutritional care for patients, including nutrition assessment, development of nutrition care plans, dietary modification, nutrition education, and all activities related to the nutritional needs of the patient/client population.

The new, air-conditioned facility is located off of Joe B Jackson Parkway giving team members an opportunity to avoid the Nashville traffic! JOB SUMMARY

The position, Graphics I, is responsible for applying various graphics to emergency apparatus according to specified customer orders. This position requires attention to detail and the ability to troubleshoot issues with application effectively. This position also requires maintaining orders for the laser engraver and delegating work to teammates according to workflow.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Demonstrate strong attention to detail for precise alignment, trimming, and positioning to ensure a professional finish
  • Exhibit manual dexterity and steady hand-eye coordination when applying vinyl, decals, and wraps
  • Apply knowledge of materials and tools, including vinyl types, adhesives, squeegees, heat guns, and cutting tools

  • Utilize problem-solving skills to navigate irregular surfaces, environmental factors, or misalignments
  • Interpret graphic layouts and installation guides accurately
  • Manage time effectively to complete tasks within schedule constraints
  • Interpret and communicate design layouts, work orders, and prints to accurately prepare patterns and products
  • Measure and mark up truck with striping layout
  • Pre-fit/pre-cut material pieces
  • Prepare numbers and letters for application to truck (weeding/masking)
  • Apply striping, numbers, letters, and emblems to vehicles according to layout specifications
  • Disassemble and reassemble small components of vehicles as needed
  • Prioritize the work based upon schedule
  • Troubleshoot issues that may delay application
  • Design and operate laser engraver
  • Operate graphics printers and plotters
  • Modify designs and drawings as needed to match and fit the intended layout on the vehicle
  • Perform product inspections and final sign off
  • Collect and maintain record stats and process control
  • Maintain a safe and clean work environment by complying with procedures, rules, and regulations
  • Demonstrate effective interpersonal communication skills
  • All other duties and responsibilities as assigned

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma or equivalent education or two-three years of related experience and/or training

STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to use tape measure.
  • Ability to use various small and pneumatic hand tools.
  • Ability to use various software such as World, Corel Draw, Composer, Excel, and Word

title: Technician
description:
Starting Rate of Pay: $ 34.97 per hour

As a Mechanic / Technician with FedEx Freight, you will use your heavy equipment experience and/or diesel mechanic education to maintain and repair our fleet of diesel tractors. Diesel mechanics are also responsible for trailers, forklifts, and other equipment that requires preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, modifications, and repairs.

Benefits for Fleet Maintenance Technicians:
• Additional $5.50 per hour for candidates with A.S.E. Master Certification
• $1,000 Annual Tool Reimbursement Allowance
• Shift Differential Pay Available
• Tuition Reimbursement for Diesel Mechanic ASE Certifications

POSITION OVERVIEW:
To provide timely, quality, and cost-effective repair and maintenance for vehicle fleet including tractors, trailers, forklifts, and other equipment that requires preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, modifications, and repairs.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Performs preventative and routine maintenance on tractors, trailers, forklifts, and other equipment.
  • Performs basic diagnostics to identify source of trouble and makes necessary adjustments to equipment for safe and efficient operation.
  • Works with other technicians in performing preventative maintenance and repairs.
  • Ensures proper and accurate documentation of all maintenance performed, completes reports in writing and electronically.
  • Performs safety inspections of equipment and documents the work Performs paint and body work on vehicles, as required.
  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures.
  • Perform other duties as required

Disclaimer: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, essential functions and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High School Diploma (or GED), preferred
  • Must have one (1) year experience performing vehicle maintenance or either possess (or be within sixty (60) days of obtaining) a vehicle maintenance certificate from an accredited vocation/trade school or completion of the FedEx Freight, Inc. Apprentice Program with satisfactory performance.
  • One or more Medium/Heavy Truck ASE Certifications and Class A CDL preferred
  • Must possess necessary tools to perform assigned tasks
  • Valid driver’s license may be required depending on work assignment
  • Knowledge of the use and operation of testing equipment, gauges and tools associated with vehicle troubleshooting and repairs
  • Basic computer skills including maintenance programs, and diagnostic systems
  • Basic knowledge of gas and diesel engines
  • Familiarity with precision measurement instruments, oxygen/acetylene equipment, and lifting devices (bottle, floor, wheel, or transmission jacks, floor cranes, etc.) preferred.
  • Able to frequently lift components weighing approximately 110 pounds with appropriate equipment and/or assistance from another person
  • Ability to safely operate vehicles equipped with manual and automatic transmission
  • Ability to enter and exit driver’s compartment of truck and/or behind cab using normally available foot and handholds
  • Paint and body work experience preferred
  • Ability to work independently and/or as a team member
  • Basic written and verbal communication skills

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Exposure to heavy traffic areas while performing the duties of the job

Exposure to considerable amounts of dust, diesel fumes and noise

May be required to drive service van to off-site locations and perform work

Exposure to climate conditions of the geographic area

Exposure to chemicals, oils, greases, paints or other irritants

Hours may vary due to operational need

title: Security Officer (Part-time)
description:
As a Security Officer, you will help create and maintain a safe, secure, and welcoming environment for guests, residents, tenants, visitors, and team members across our commercial and residential properties. You will combine strong security practices with a hospitality-minded approach, providing professional, courteous, and responsive service while protecting people, property, and assets.

You are often one of the first points of contact for those visiting or living within our properties. Your ability to anticipate needs, provide helpful information, build positive relationships, and respond calmly and professionally to a wide range of situations is essential to delivering an exceptional experience.

About the role

  • Effectively monitor property and assets using closed-circuit surveillance systems.

  • Monitor and control access to the property by auditing and creating access groups.

  • Patrol assigned areas frequently to identify unsafe conditions, security concerns, and inoperative safety equipment.

  • Maintain a visible and approachable security presence while providing professional and courteous service to guests, residents, tenants, visitors, and team members.

  • Generate shift logs identifying and documenting activity occurring during assigned shifts.

  • Follow proper investigative procedures for loss of hotel, residential, commercial, and property assets by ensuring policy compliance, investigating loss claims from guests, residents, tenants, and visitors, and conducting special investigations and surveillance related to incidents such as internal and external theft.

  • Generate, review, store, and maintain accurate records and reports of all incidents.

  • Maintain knowledge of property activities, amenities, services, and events to provide guests, residents, tenants, and visitors with accurate information and assistance as requested.

  • Verify age and identification using an identification-verifying device to confirm all guests consuming alcohol are at least 21 years of age.

  • De-escalate conflict situations using sound judgment, professionalism, and effective communication to promote the safety, security, and comfort of all team members, guests, residents, tenants, and visitors.

  • Perform and enforce directives set forth by security leadership, including special details, assignments, and other security-related responsibilities.

  • Respond promptly and professionally to security, safety, and service-related concerns while maintaining a hospitality-focused approach.

  • Collaborate with property teams and leadership to support a safe, welcoming, and positive environment across commercial and residential spaces.

About you

You are a security professional who understands that exceptional security and exceptional hospitality go hand in hand. You are observant, dependable, service-oriented, and comfortable interacting with a diverse range of guests, residents, tenants, visitors, and team members.​

Minimum Qualifications

  • 1 year of relevant experience in the physical security and/or hospitality industry.

  • Availability to work a contingent, flexible schedule, including day, evening, overnight, weekend, and holiday shifts as needed to support 24-hour operations.

  • Ability to be on-call and respond to staffing needs when requested, including weekends and holidays.

  • Ability to spend eight-hour shifts both sitting at a desk and/or walking to patrol assigned areas.

  • Ability to climb 10 flights of stairs at a time in case of emergency.

  • Proficiency with technology, including desktop computers, mobile devices, and mobile applications.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact professionally and courteously with guests, residents, tenants, visitors, and team members.

  • Ability to remain calm, professional, and service-oriented when responding to challenging or high-pressure situations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3 years of relevant experience in a physical security, military or law enforcement role.

  • CPR/First-Aid certification.

  • Experience working in a hotel, residential, commercial, mixed-use, or other hospitality-oriented property environment.

What you’ll get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.

About us

Rock Security offers 24/7 safety and security services and training to Rock Family of Companies team members, tenants and visitors. We’re proud to be part of collaborative public-private partnerships working toward the common goals of enhancing the safety of everyone who lives, works and visits Detroit, Cleveland and our other home cities.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Yulista Tactical Services LLC

Regular

PRIMARY FUNCTION

The Logistics Coordinator coordinates and expedites flow of material, parts, and assemblies within or between departments in accordance with production schedules or department priorities. Responds immediately to customer questions and complaints and notifies customer and maintenance personnel of any delays in the delivery schedule of parts and equipment required for mission success.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

• Coordinates and expedites flow of material, parts, and assemblies within or
between departments in accordance with production schedules or
department priorities.
• Provides MX Managers and Team Leads with daily and weekly reports on requisitions status, back shop repair status, awaiting parts (AWP) status and warehouse low balance parts. Works with all levels of personnel to further the objectives of the organization.
• Review production schedules and confer with project managers, engineers, supervisors, and technicians to determine material required or overdue.
• Locate material, requisition material and establish delivery sequences to departments according to job order priorities and anticipated material availability.
• Arrange repair and assembly of material and its distribution to various departments with department supervisors.
• Arranges and monitors transfer of materials to meet production schedules.
• Compute amount of material needed for specific job orders, applying knowledge of product and manufacturing processes to compile report of quantity and type of material on hand.
• Track material in process of production, using manual or computerized system.
• The Logistics Coordinator may be required to perform other related duties to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.


SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position has the responsibility and authority to assign and direct daily tasks for personnel assigned to Life Cycle Management Organization.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES

• 2 years of computer skills specifically using Microsoft Office Suite, Excel, Project and Access. Ability to learn additional computer skills or software programs. Working knowledge of advanced software applications is preferred.
• Ability to enter data accurately into databases.
• Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
• Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
• Interpersonal skills are necessary to work effectively and cooperatively with all levels of management and staff. Will also routinely interact with other crew members.
• Must possess effective communication skills to clearly communicate information to others.
• Ability to use general office equipment such as fax, phone, copier, scanner, printers, etc.
• Ability to follow a process.
• Strong professional customer service skills, including active listening, prompt service and follow-up.
• Strong decision analysis and problem-solving skills; ability to draw conclusions and justify decisions. Must be able to communicate issues to management.
• Ability to learn and understand corporate policies and procedures and how they relate to Yulista LLC goals.
• Ability to perform basic mathematical computations.
• High degree of self-motivation and the ability to work independently.
• Ability to multi-task.


QUALIFICATIONS

• High School Diploma or equivalent.
• 2 years Microsoft Excel and Project.
• 7+ years of aerospace industry experience and 2+ years in a leadership role.
• Experience supporting a NASA/DoD contract.
• Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Government Security Clearance.

PREFERENCE STATEMENT
Preference will be given to Calista shareholders and their descendants and to spouses of Calista shareholders, and to shareholders of other corporations created pursuant to the Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act, in accordance with Title 43 U.S. Code 1626(g).

EEO STATEMENT
Additionally, it is our policy to select, place, train and promote the most qualified individuals based upon relevant factors such as work quality, attitude and experience, so as to provide equal employment opportunity for all employees in compliance with applicable local, state and federal laws and without regard to non-work related factors such as race, color, religion/creed, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship, genetic information, or other protected status. When applicable, our policy of non-discrimination applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to, recruiting, hiring, training, transfer, promotion, placement, layoff, compensation, termination, reduction in force and benefits.

title: Sr. Director, Global GTM Strategy
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Sr. Director, Global GTM Strategy

Mission

Architect and optimize Qualys’s global go-to-market strategy across customer segments, regions, and routes to market to drive sustainable, scalable, and profitable growth.

The Sr. Director, Global GTM Strategy serves as the architect of Qualys’s growth strategy, connecting market opportunity, customer segmentation, pricing, coverage, and GTM investment into a cohesive plan for growth. This leader will identify where and how Qualys should invest to maximize revenue opportunity and ensure each region, segment, and channel has a clear strategy and execution framework.

Working across Sales, Marketing, Product, Partner, Finance, Revenue Operations, and Field Operations, this role will translate market and performance insights into actionable GTM priorities and ensure resources are aligned to the highest-value growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Global & Regional GTM Strategy

  • Own the development of an integrated global GTM strategy and translate it into tailored plans for the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.
  • Partner with regional and functional leaders to define market priorities, customer segments, routes to market, and growth opportunities while ensuring regional strategies remain aligned to global business objectives and revenue targets.
  • Identify opportunities to evolve GTM models based on market maturity, customer needs, competitive dynamics, and business performance.

Strategic Planning & Investment Allocation

  • Lead the GTM strategy component of annual and long-range planning, translating company growth objectives into clear market, segment, coverage, and investment priorities.
  • Develop data-driven recommendations for where Qualys should deploy incremental resources—including sales capacity, marketing investment, partner resources, and GTM programs—to maximize growth and return on investment.
  • Build business cases and scenario analyses that evaluate market opportunity, capacity, productivity, expected returns, and tradeoffs to support executive investment decisions.
  • Continuously assess performance against strategic assumptions and recommend resource reallocation as market conditions and business priorities evolve.

Segmentation, Targeting & Market Prioritization

  • Own and continuously refine customer and market segmentation frameworks to identify the highest-potential markets, customer cohorts, verticals, and buyer opportunities.
  • Translate segmentation, propensity, and customer insights into actionable targeting strategies that guide sales focus, marketing investment, partner engagement, and account-level growth motions.
  • Partner with Field Operations on territory and quota planning, providing strategic analysis of market opportunity, coverage, capacity, productivity, and growth potential.

Pricing, Packaging & Monetization Strategy

  • Lead broader pricing and monetization strategy in partnership with Product and Finance, ensuring pricing and packaging reflect customer value, competitive dynamics, and company growth objectives.
  • Evaluate pricing performance, discounting, deal economics, win rates, and customer behavior to identify opportunities to improve revenue quality and profitability.
  • Provide strategic guidance on new pricing models, packaging approaches, and commercial structures as Qualys evolves its portfolio and routes to market.

Partner & Channel Strategy

  • Partner with Channel leadership to shape the global partner strategy across channel, technology, alliance, and other partner motions.
  • Define the strategic role of partners within the broader GTM model, including partner segmentation, market coverage, incentives, co-selling motions, and investment priorities.
  • Evaluate partner performance and market opportunity to identify opportunities to increase partner contribution to pipeline, revenue, and market reach.

Product & Emerging GTM Motions

  • Partner with Product, Marketing, and Sales to define the GTM strategy for new products, solutions, and emerging sales motions.
  • Ensure PLG, self-service, hybrid, and other emerging motions are integrated into the broader GTM strategy and aligned to appropriate customer segments and acquisition or expansion opportunities.
  • Evaluate adoption and commercial performance to determine where new motions should be expanded, adjusted, or integrated into existing sales and partner models.

Market & Competitive Intelligence

  • Develop a structured view of market trends, customer needs, competitive dynamics, and emerging growth opportunities.
  • Translate market intelligence into actionable recommendations for market entry, product positioning, pricing, segmentation, and GTM investment.
  • Provide leadership with clear perspectives on where market dynamics may require changes to existing GTM strategies or investment priorities.

GTM Motion Design & Optimization

  • Ensure Qualys’s GTM motions—including direct sales, partner-led, PLG/self-service, and hybrid models—are designed around the needs and economics of each customer segment.
  • Define best practices and strategic frameworks for customer acquisition, expansion, and retention motions.
  • Partner with functional teams to continuously improve sales plays, targeting, enablement, and execution based on performance and customer insights.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Executive Alignment

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to executive, regional, and functional leaders on GTM priorities, growth opportunities, pricing, and resource allocation.
  • Create alignment across Sales, Marketing, Product, Partner, Finance, Revenue Operations, and Field Operations around GTM strategy and investment priorities.
  • Drive complex cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution, establishing clear ownership, decision points, and measures of success.

Performance Measurement & Optimization

  • Establish the KPIs and analytical frameworks used to evaluate GTM effectiveness across regions, segments, channels, and motions.
  • Monitor key indicators including pipeline generation, conversion, win rates, productivity, market penetration, partner contribution, revenue growth, and profitability.
  • Identify performance gaps and emerging opportunities and recommend changes to strategy, investment, coverage, or execution.
  • Create a continuous feedback loop between GTM performance and strategic planning to ensure resources remain focused on the highest-value growth opportunities.

Skill Sets & Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in GTM strategy, revenue strategy, pricing, monetization, strategic planning, or related functions, ideally within a global B2B technology or SaaS organization.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing enterprise GTM strategies across multiple regions, customer segments, and routes to market, including direct and partner-led motions.
  • Proven people leader with experience building, leading, and developing high-performing teams. Ability to develop leadership capability within the organization and effectively lead through people managers as the function scales.
  • Strong expertise in customer segmentation, market prioritization, targeting, coverage and capacity planning, and resource allocation, with the ability to translate market opportunity into actionable growth strategies.
  • Demonstrated experience with strategic planning and investment allocation, including developing business cases, evaluating ROI, modeling growth scenarios, and recommending where to deploy incremental resources.
  • Proven experience developing or influencing pricing, packaging, and monetization strategy, with a strong understanding of customer value, competitive positioning, win rates, and revenue economics.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen with demonstrated ability to use market, customer, pipeline, and revenue data to identify opportunities and inform executive decision-making.
  • Ability to connect strategy to execution by establishing clear priorities, operating plans, KPIs, and mechanisms for measuring GTM effectiveness.
  • Demonstrated success working across Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, Revenue Operations, and Partner/Channel organizations, with the ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment without direct authority.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives in ambiguous, high-growth, and rapidly evolving environments.
  • Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to synthesize complex analysis into clear recommendations and decisions.
  • Working knowledge of modern GTM systems and analytics platforms, including Salesforce, BI/analytics tools, and CPQ/revenue technology; deep system administration expertise is not required.
  • Experience within enterprise cybersecurity, SaaS, or another complex B2B technology environment preferred.

title: People Strategy Consultant

Description

Northrop Grumman - Launch Vehicles Division is hiring a Systems Engineer Level 4 - Flight Test IPT lead, located in Chandler, Arizona.

This high-visibility position requires a technical and leadership expert capable of guiding multi-disciplinary engineering teams to design, integrate, and deliver cutting-edge kill vehicle systems for hypersonic environments. The ideal candidate will have strong avionics design expertise, a deep understanding of hypersonic system challenges, and proven program management abilities to balance cost, schedule, and quality in executing Flight Test events.

Position Overview

Serve as Leader of the technical, cost, schedule, and resource execution for all of the Flight Test activities. You will collaborate with all stakeholders to identify the test objectives, derive mission specific requirements, lead the team to design, build, test and integrate mission specific hardware and software. You will lead the development of mission specific integration and test procedures, execute the Integration and test of the mission vehicle, deploy to the launch site to coordinate the field campaign support the launch activities and post flight analysis.

What You’ll Get To Do:
As the Flight Test Integrated Product Team Lead, you will:

  • Lead a High-Performing Team: Coordinate a cross-functional engineering team in a high-visibility and fast-paced program environment. Collaborate with diverse groups including Engineering & Program Management, Software and Hardware Engineers, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Mission Assurance teams.

  • Be a Key Liaison: Work closely with U.S. and Japanese partners, fostering teamwork and collaboration in both domestic and international settings to meet technical and programmatic goals specifically related to the GPI Flight Test Program.

  • Deliver End-to-End Solutions: Drive the test and support equipment design effort across multiple engineering disciplines, ensuring the development and integration of several delivered components and subsystems.

  • Solve Complex Challenges: Apply your organizational and technical problem-solving skills to ensure successful execution of system designs while addressing development risks and emerging challenges in real-time.

  • Communicate at all Levels: Provide technical leadership and support for internal and external executive briefings, including program updates, engineering reviews, and risk management discussions.

  • Maintain High Standards: Thrive in a high-expectation environment, demonstrating initiative, meticulous attention to detail, and polished verbal and written communication skills.

Leadership and Team Management

  • Serve as the technical and leadership authority for the Flight Test IPT team, delivering on challenging performance, schedule, and cost objectives.

  • Collaborate with the Performance Pillar PMO, Interceptor Pillar PMO and Assembly, Test and Launch Operations (ATLO) Pillar PMO to Assemble, Test and Launch GPI Flight Test configurations which include radio, controller, optical seeker and sensor systems, balancing critical thermal, electrical, and mechanical interfaces.

  • Serve as the primary technical interface for internal and external stakeholders, preparing and delivering clear communication on risks, trade-offs, decisions, and successes.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems, Multi-Domain Operations, and Missile Defense Integration Business Unit (BU) has an exciting career opportunity for a Modeling & Simulation Systems Engineer – Level 2 or 3 (Kinematic Mod/Sim Systems Engineer) to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals. This position will be located on-site at Schriever Space Force Base, in Colorado Springs, CO.

This role requires employees to be onsite daily with no option for remote/hybrid work.

Position Overview:

Threat Systems Engineering (TSE) is responsible for the development and delivery of high-fidelity threat modeling products in support of the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) and MDA’s Ballistic Missile Defense System (BMDS). TSE is responsible for the development of models and simulations (M&S) used to stimulate element models of MDA’s BMDS, including kinematic missile modeling, IR signature modeling, data production/analysis activities, and maintenance/sustainment activities for the entire TSE software baseline. TSE is a cornerstone element to the Threat and Advanced Simulation Development (TASD) contract.

This position is responsible for understanding Aerodynamic forces, Guidance, Navigation and Control (GNC) systems, modeling & simulation of systems’ kinematics characteristics within the TSE’s model generation framework, and providing documentation required for running threat data in Ground Test architecture.

The selected individual must be able to work with little or no direct supervision, work as an integral member of a product delivery team and meet critical delivery schedules.

Essential Functions:

  • Responsible for developing ballistic and advanced/hypersonic kinematic threat models for use in a variety of modeling and simulation tools/frameworks/media.
  • Will apply standard engineering and mathematical algorithms to ensure the accurate portrayal of expected missile or space launch vehicle behavioral characteristics during all phases of powered and un-powered flight.
  • Will have a good understanding of modeling and simulation methods and processes.
  • Will research, interpret, verify parameters required to build, replicate, and propagate missile or space launch vehicle trajectories including, but not limited to, staging debris, countermeasures, and payload traits.
  • Will author highly technical Verification and Validation (V&V) documents.
  • Will work with little to no direct supervision, work as an integral member of a product delivery team and meet time-critical delivery schedules.

Seeking candidates who find satisfaction in working on challenging and diverse assignments in collaborative settings across all levels.

This requisition may be filled at a higher grade based on qualifications listed below.

This requisition may be filled at either a Modeling & Simulation Systems Engineer – Level 2 or a Principal Modeling & Simulation Systems Engineer – Level 3.

  • Modeling & Simulation Systems Engineer – Level 3 - Bachelor of Science degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math) discipline preferred with 5 years of relevant experience, or 3 years’ experience with a Master of Science degree; or a PhD and 1 year of related experience.

  • Programming background to include languages such as MATLAB, Python, LaTex, or other relevant programming experience.
  • Familiarity with the flight characteristics, motion, and performance of ballistic missiles
  • Must be self-motivated, able to work in a dynamic team environment
  • Ability to collaborate with systems engineers, software engineers, users, and MDA ground test stakeholders to ensure product requirements are met.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Modeling, Simulation, and automation experience
  • Previous experience with modeling flight characteristics, motion, atmospheric dynamics, and missile performance parameters of ballistic missiles
  • Strong background in missile system engineering performance is highly desirable
  • Mastery of engineering modeling principles behind body motion, trajectory generation, counter measures, and debris is a plus
  • Possess and active DoD Secret Clearance with the ability to obtain a DoD Top Secret Clearance
  • Experience with Verification and Validation (V&V) of vehicle kinematics simulation results.

title: Research Scientist, RNA Therapeutics
description:
Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated


Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.


Job Summary

The Gene and Cell Therapy Institute (GCTI) is a system-wide Institute under Mass General Brigham that fosters a world-class gene and cell therapy program, leveraging groundbreaking scientific research efforts across the MGB system. The mission of GCTI is to bring together the community of MGB investigators who use gene and cell therapy platforms to achieve their scientific and clinical goals and improve the health of patients. This position sits within the Wesselhoeft Laboratory at GCTI and is dedicated to the ARPA-H GIVE program, a multi-institution effort to build an automated continuous manufacturing platform that produces RNA–lipid nanoparticle drug product from digital sequence to vialed dose.

We are seeking a motivated and skilled Process Development Scientist to join our RNA Therapeutics team and lead the translation of RNA and lipid nanoparticle processes from benchtop protocols into a miniaturized, automated manufacturing platform. The candidate who fills this role will develop and optimize unit operations spanning DNA amplification, in vitro transcription, RNA capture and purification, LNP formulation, and fill and finish, and will define the process parameters, in-process controls, and analytics that govern them. They will design and execute rigorous studies to characterize process performance, establish operating ranges, and support technology transfer to the engineering partners building the device, independently or in collaboration with those partners. The successful candidate will have significant experience in RNA process development or manufacturing sciences, be proficient in standard molecular biology and purification techniques, be detail-oriented and organized, and eager to work in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary team environment.

Essential Functions

• Develop, optimize, and characterize RNA and LNP unit operations, including in vitro transcription, capping, affinity capture, tangential flow filtration, and nanoprecipitation, for continuous manufacturing
• Translate benchtop processes into miniaturized and automated formats in collaboration with microfluidics, hardware, and software engineers, and support design reviews and technology transfer to internal and external partners
• Generate high-quality circular RNA, mRNA, and RNA-LNP drug product using techniques such as in vitro transcription, silica and affinity purification, tangential flow filtration, HPLC, cloning, gel electrophoresis, plasmid outgrowth and purification
• Define critical process parameters and in-process controls, and execute design-of-experiment studies to establish operating ranges and demonstrate process robustness
• Perform analytical and in-line process monitoring techniques such as RiboGreen, capillary electrophoresis, dynamic light scattering, zeta potential, and Raman and record quality metrics, with a strong focus on accuracy and reproducibility in work
• Author and maintain process documentation, including protocols, batch records, development reports, and data packages supporting program milestones and deliverables
• Use universal safety precautions and proper personal protective equipment to protect self and co-workers from biohazardous materials; complete requisite trainings as appropriate
• Participate in lab and program meetings, communicate effectively with the team and external partners, discuss progress, share data with supervisors, and contribute to a positive work environment
• Potentially manage one or more direct reports, assign tasks, and ensure high quality of work


Qualifications

REQUIRED COMPETENCIES:

  • PhD with 3+ years of related experience in a life sciences laboratory, process development, or biomanufacturing role
  • Experience synthesizing and purifying RNA via in vitro transcription
  • Experience developing, optimizing, and transferring biologics or nucleic acid unit operations
  • Ability to identify problems and troubleshoot solutions
  • Well-versed in laboratory standards and practices
  • Good organizational skills, detail-oriented
  • Reproducibility of work with accuracy
  • Sound degree of computer literacy
  • Ability to methodically record and analyze data
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Ability to demonstrate professionalism
  • Dedication to excellence

PREFERRED COMPETENCIES:

  • Experience managing direct reports
  • Experience with lipid nanoparticle formulation and physicochemical characterization
  • Experience in a GMP or GMP-adjacent environment, or with quality-by-design and design-of-experiment methodology

Enterprise Product Portfolio Strategy

  • Define and evolve the product strategy across multiple HR product domains, employee journeys, and workforce capabilities.

  • Translate enterprise workforce priorities, employee insights, technology trends, and business needs into multi-year product roadmaps and investment recommendations.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify experiences, reduce fragmentation, improve adoption, and create more connected end-to-end HR experiences.

  • Shape portfolio decisions based on measurable value, risk, adoption, compliance, feasibility, and business impact.

Product Governance, Prioritization & Decision Support

  • Establish portfolio-level prioritization approaches that help leaders make clear trade-offs across products, journeys, and capabilities.

  • Frame decision-ready recommendations for senior leaders, including outcomes, dependencies, risks, investment needs, and sequencing options.

  • Manage strategic dependencies across HR Product, HR Technology, Employee Experience, HR Services, COEs, and enterprise governance forums.

  • Surface enterprise-level risks and decisions early, escalating only when broader leadership alignment or investment decisions are required.

AI-Enabled HR Product Innovation

  • Lead identification, evaluation, and scaling of AI-enabled HR capabilities across assigned product portfolios.

  • Define product expectations for responsible AI use, including trust, transparency, human-in-the-loop controls, quality monitoring, and escalation paths.

  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Risk, Technology, and Compliance teams to ensure AI-enabled capabilities meet enterprise standards and jurisdictional requirements.

  • Evaluate vendor releases, emerging technologies, and external product trends to inform future HR product strategy.

Product Performance & Value Realization

  • Establish portfolio-level success measures tied to adoption, employee experience, operational effectiveness, self-service, cycle time, containment, and business value.

  • Maintain visibility into product performance, benefits realization, portfolio costs, and return on investment.

  • Use analytics, listening signals, service trends, workforce insights, and product adoption data to inform roadmap decisions and continuous improvement.

  • Ensure product teams move beyond feature delivery to measurable outcomes and sustained value realization.

Product Management Maturity & Operating Model Discipline

  • Serve as a thought leader for HR product management practices, reinforcing consistent standards, artifacts, and operating routines.

  • Create reusable frameworks for product one-pagers, decision logs, roadmap visibility, scope boundaries, success metrics, and release-readiness expectations.

  • Mentor Product Managers and matrixed partners to strengthen product thinking, prioritization discipline, and outcome orientation across HR.

  • Advance maturity of McKesson’s HR product operating model by reinforcing single intake, backlog discipline, clear decision rights, and transparent trade-offs.

What Success Looks Like

  • HR product portfolios are clearly aligned to enterprise workforce priorities, employee experience standards, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Senior leaders have decision-ready visibility into product priorities, dependencies, risks, investments, and value realization.

  • AI-enabled HR capabilities are adopted responsibly and reinforce trust, compliance, usability, and business value.

  • Product roadmaps reflect integrated experiences rather than isolated tools or projects.

  • Product management practices become more consistent, scalable, and outcome-oriented across HR.

  • Employees, managers, and HR teams experience more connected, efficient, and trusted HR products over time.

Required Experience

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in product management, digital strategy, transformation, HR technology, employee experience, or related disciplines.

  • Demonstrated experience shaping enterprise-scale product portfolios, multi-year roadmaps, or complex digital transformation initiatives.

  • Experience influencing senior leaders and enterprise prioritization or investment decisions without formal authority.

  • Experience operating in large, matrixed organizations with significant cross-functional dependencies.

  • Exposure to HR, workforce technology, employee experience, service delivery, or regulated environments preferred.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Strategic product leadership — connects workforce strategy, employee experience, technology, data, and business outcomes into a clear product direction.

  • Portfolio management — balances competing priorities, dependencies, sequencing, risk, and investment trade-offs across multiple product domains.

  • Executive influence — frames decision-ready recommendations and aligns senior stakeholders without formal authority.

  • Systems thinking — understands how journeys, platforms, processes, data, and operating models interact across the enterprise.

  • AI and digital fluency — understands how to identify, prioritize, govern, and scale AI-enabled capabilities that improve employee experience, productivity, and business outcomes.

  • Outcome orientation — defines success measures, knows the numbers, and manages products toward adoption, value, and continuous improvement.

Leveling Note

Positioned as an individual contributor at Professional P6 (Principal), subject to Compensation confirmation. This role is broader than a single product or journey owner and is intended to provide enterprise-level product leadership across multiple HR product domains, influence portfolio investment decisions, and mature HR product management practices. Distinguished from M5 by the absence of formal people leadership; impact is delivered through enterprise influence, thought leadership, portfolio strategy, and cross-functional product accountability.

title: Senior Analyst Benefits Analytics
location: Franklin, Tennessee - United States of America
description:
Location(s): Franklin, TN

Job Schedule: Full-time – Hybrid - in office Monday-Thursday

Education Requirement: Bachelor’s

Sponsorship: No

Come Drive Innovation with Us. We are currently looking for a Senior Analyst Benefits Analytics to join our team in Franklin, TN.

The Senior Benefits Analyst serves as a strategic advisor and subject matter expert responsible for the analysis and continuous improvement of employee benefit programs across a large, complex, multi-state/province organization. This role supports a diverse employee population that may include salaried, hourly, field-based, manufacturing, distribution, technical, and executive employees throughout the United States and Canada.

The position combines deep benefits expertise with strategic analytics to ensure benefit programs remain competitive, financially sustainable, compliant, and aligned with organizational objectives. The Senior Benefits Analyst evaluates market trends, utilization patterns, regulatory developments, and workforce demographics to develop recommendations that enhance employee well-being, improve operational effectiveness, and support the organization's Total Rewards strategy.

A critical aspect of this role is serving as a fiduciary steward of employee benefit programs. The incumbent is entrusted with protecting the interests of plan participants, promoting employee wellness and financial security, ensuring regulatory compliance, and maintaining the integrity of benefit plan operations and decision-making processes.

The Senior Benefits Analyst works closely with HR leadership, Legal, Finance, Payroll, Procurement, external consultants, brokers, carriers, and third-party administrators to deliver a high-quality benefits experience while effectively managing risk and cost.

A Day in the Life:

Strategic Benefits Analysis & Planning

  • Continuously analyze the external market to proactively address macroeconomic factors impacting wellness plans

  • Identify opportunities for enhancement based on market benchmarking data and analysis of benefit program performance, utilization trends, employee demographics, claims experience, etc.

  • Support strategic assessments of plan design, competitiveness, employee value, and cost effectiveness.

  • Support data-driven recommendations to align benefit strategy, employee wellness initiatives, and workforce attraction and retention objectives.

  • Monitor emerging industry trends, legislative developments, and best practices to inform future program direction.

  • Support long-range planning and annual benefits strategy discussions through comprehensive reporting and analysis.

Benefits Administration & Program Management

  • Support the Benefit Managers with the administration of health and welfare, retirement, wellness, disability, leave, and voluntary benefit programs.

  • Serve as benefits coordinator for various procurement processes ensuring smooth administration

  • Partner with internal stakeholders and vendors to enhance the employee benefits experience.

Fiduciary Oversight & Employee Advocacy

  • Act as a steward of employee benefit programs by ensuring decisions are made in the best interests of plan participants and beneficiaries.

  • Support initiatives that promote employee health, well-being, financial security, and access to quality benefits.

  • Ensure benefit programs are administered fairly, consistently, and in accordance with plan provisions and governing regulations.

  • Evaluate participant feedback and utilization data to identify opportunities for improving employee outcomes and engagement.

Compliance, Governance & Risk Management

  • Maintain compliance with applicable federal and state regulations including ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, COBRA, FMLA, Medicare, Section 125, and other benefit-related requirements.

  • Support audits, regulatory reviews, and government reporting activities.

  • Coordinate and maintain required plan documentation, notices, filings, and disclosures.

  • Assist in the preparation and management of Form 5500 filings, Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs), Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBCs), and other regulatory materials.

  • Monitor vendor performance and adherence to contractual obligations and service-level agreements.

Vendor, Contract & Procurement Management

  • Support benefit procurement activities, vendor selection processes, and request-for-proposal (RFP) initiatives.

  • Maintain benefit vendor agreements, contracts, statements of work, and procurement documentation.

  • Support benefit leadership in the partnership with Procurement, Legal, and Finance to evaluate vendor performance, manage renewals, and ensure contractual compliance.

  • Participate in vendor governance meetings and recommend service improvements where appropriate.

  • Ensure benefit program records, contracts, and supporting documentation are maintained in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements.

Who We're Looking for:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Healthcare Administration, or related field.

  • Minimum 7 years of progressive experience administering employee benefit programs within a large, complex organization or similar experience in a professional consulting capacity.

  • Strong knowledge of employee benefits administration and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Experience working with multiple employee populations across various geographic locations.

  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Experience managing vendors, consultants, and third-party administrators.

  • Proficiency with HRIS, benefits administration systems, and reporting tools.

Preferred:

  • CEBS, CBP, SHRM-CP/SCP, PHR/SPHR, or related certification.

  • Experience in Benefits consulting

  • Experience supporting non-union employee groups.

  • Experience with benefits procurement, vendor negotiations, and contract administration.

  • Advanced reporting, analytics, and dashboard development skills.

Core Competencies

Strategic & Consultative Competencies:

1. Benefits Strategy & Business Acumen

  • Aligns benefit programs with organizational objectives, workforce needs, and Total Rewards strategy.

2. Analytical Thinking

  • Uses quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, evaluate program effectiveness, and support decision-making.

3. Fiduciary Responsibility

  • Demonstrates sound judgment and stewardship in managing programs affecting employee health, wellness, and financial security.

4. Consultative Partnership

  • Builds trusted relationships and provides expert guidance to leaders, HR partners, and employees.

5. Regulatory & Compliance Expertise

  • Applies comprehensive knowledge of applicable benefit laws and regulations to minimize organizational risk.

Leadership & Execution Competencies:

1. Vendor and Stakeholder Management

  • Effectively manages relationships with carriers, consultants, administrators, and internal business partners.

2. Project Management

  • Successfully coordinates multiple priorities, implementations, renewals, and annual enrollment activities.

3. Process Improvement

  • Identifies efficiencies and implements solutions that improve service delivery, compliance, and employee experience.

4. Communication & Influence

  • Translates complex benefit concepts into clear, actionable information for diverse audiences.

5. Employee-Centric Mindset

  • Maintains a strong commitment to supporting employee well-being, engagement, and positive benefit outcomes.

Why This Role Matters

The Senior Benefits Analyst plays a critical role in shaping the employee experience by ensuring benefit programs are competitive, compliant, sustainable, and aligned with the organization's commitment to employee wellness. Through strategic analysis, fiduciary stewardship, strong governance, and consultative partnership, this role helps protect the organization's investment in its people while supporting the health, financial security, and overall well-being of employees and their families.

What You’ll Look Forward to at Nissan:

Career Growth and Continuous Learning Opportunities: Benefit from diverse career paths, cross-departmental moves, and innovative learning platforms. Enhance your skills through seminars, leadership training, and tuition reimbursement programs, all while playing a vital role in shaping the future of transportation. From day one, you'll have the support to tackle challenges and contribute to impactful solutions across our organization.

Rewards: Be supported with a Comprehensive Benefits Package, including medical, mental health, parental leave, retirement savings & unique Nissan perks, including discounts on lease vehicles as part of our Employee Lease Program and a Vehicle Purchase Program (VPP). title: Senior Director, Corporate Partnerships and Events
description:
Site: The Brigham and Women's Hospital, Inc.


Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.


Job Summary

The Mass General Brigham Development Office represents a team of 400+ vibrant, collaborative, skilled fundraising professionals. We are dedicated to inspiring visionary philanthropy that advances caring and curing for patients in Boston and around the world. Philanthropy enables Mass General Brigham to deliver the highest quality patient care, pursue the most innovative and promising research, train the brightest minds to become the next generation of healthcare leaders and expand and improve our world-class facilities. Join us in our mission to transform the future of medicine. The Mass General Brigham Development Office offers excellent benefits, competitive salaries and a hybrid flexible work schedule.

To Apply:
Applications must include a current resume and a cover letter detailing applicable experience and accomplishments.

The Senior Director of Corporate Partnerships serves as a vital member of our events team—a collaborative, mission-driven, donor- and sponsor-focused group of professionals who are committed to delivering best-in-class events through a spirit of teamwork and support. The Senior Director plays a leadership role in driving revenue to support the fundraising success of annual events that unite and celebrate our vibrant donor community and raise $20M+ annually to support the mission of Mass General Brigham.

The Senior Director is responsible for leading the development, implementation, and strategic expansion of corporate partnership strategies for the MGBDO. This position leads a team that identifies, secures, and manages corporate partners via sponsorship and cause marketing. The Senior Director will design annual sponsorship and cause marketing strategies, create and manage the processes for ensuring execution of sponsorship benefits, develop relationships with critical internal stakeholders, and develop a strong pipeline of prospects.

Additionally, the position will manage fundraising strategies and staff responsible for executing a roster of MGB golf events.

• Lead the strategy, planning, and execution of a comprehensive corporate partnership program for the newly integrated MGB Development office. This includes event sponsorship, cause marketing and overseeing the golf program.
• Design and implement a multi-year strategy to expand corporate partnerships and cause marketing.
• Collaborate closely with MGB Development leaders, key MGB stakeholders, and volunteer leadership to create annual corporate partnerships strategies and develop a strong corporate pipeline focused on donor-connected companies and companies not currently connected to MGB.
• Collaborate with frontline fundraisers to develop multi-pronged solicitation strategies and gift opportunities.
• Meet or exceed annual team revenue and growth targets.
• Build strong rapport and collaborate effectively with MGB colleagues who intersect with corporate entities and/or MGB vendors (supply chain, Corp & Foundation giving, facilities, etc.)
• Manage and mentor a multi-disciplinary team of development professionals responsible for two key areas: corporate partnerships/cause marketing and MGB golf tournaments.
• Oversee a growing roster of MGB Golf Tournaments and the staff who manage them.
• Develop a plan for strategic expansion of the MGB golf program.
• Oversee the creation of new or enhance existing processes for managing corporate partnership-related business operations, including: tracking and reporting activity in CRM, sharing sponsorship updates with MGBDO stakeholders (Comms, Event leads, MGBDO leaders), updating annual pitch decks, create systems to ensure proper sponsor benefit fulfilment, and ensuring contracts, invoices, and other documentation follow MGB policy.
• Manage relationships for a defined portfolio of assigned prospects.
• Support post-event evaluation, including sponsor feedback and data analysis, to continuously improve event and sponsor impact.
• Provide back-up event support and mentorship across the MGB Events team
• Serve as a representative for the MGBDO with faculty, supporters, volunteers and administrative leadership.
• Other duties as assigned.


Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required and 10+ years of related experience. In addition, the ideal candidate will possess the following skills, abilities and competencies:

  • Entrepreneurial approach to sponsorship sales and sales management
  • Demonstrated success in sponsorship sales, corporate partnerships, or cause marketing
  • Seasoned manager of people and teams, ideally in a fundraising office or similar setting
  • Experience successfully working with executive-level stakeholders, both internal and external
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Organizational, time management, problem solving and project management skills
  • Command of Word, PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook, or the ability to learn them quickly
  • Competency using videoconferencing platforms (Zoom and Teams preferred)
  • Proficiency with data entry or data management in a database (Blackbaud CRM or Raiser’s Edge preferred)
  • Attention to detail, creativity and strong work ethic
  • Desire and motivation to learn about the organization and fundraising
  • Awareness of personal work styles in self and others
  • Adaptability and flexibility in times of shifting priorities
  • Ability to work collaboratively with diverse audiences
  • Mission driven
  • Ability to complete assigned projects and tasks independently or with minimal guidance

title: Endodontoloog
description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een ruim opgezette praktijk en wil je aan de slag in een leuk en ervaren team? Lees dan verder!

Voor onze tandartspraktijk Videnti Steuvelslaan in Roosendaal zijn wij op zoek naar een Endodontoloog voor 1 dag in de week op de maandag of vrijdag.

Waar ga je werken?

Onze tandartsenpraktijk in Roosendaal is een grote moderne praktijk met 12 behandelkamer, waarvan 2 operatiekamers. Er is ook een CT scan aanwezig. Daarbij hebben wij ook een groot laboratorium tot ons beschikking, mocht dit nodig zijn.

Patiënten kunnen bij ons terecht voor vrijwel alle denkbare specialismen.

Er werken op deze praktijk vijf tandartsen, één implantoloog, drie mondhygiënisten, één KTP'er en elf assistenten. Er is vrijwel elke dag een tandarts aanwezig.

Er hangt een leuke en gezellige sfeer in de praktijk. Het is een hardwerkend team en iedereen is ook echt bereid wat van elkaar te leren. Collega’s investeren graag in elkaar. Intercollegiaal overleg vinden wij daarom ook erg belangrijk, we bespreken casussen en leren op die manier van elkaar. Middels onze Colosseum Dental Academy worden al onze medewerkers ook regelmatig weer bijgeschoold, hiermee behalen tandartsen KRT punten en mondhygiënisten KRM punten. Werken bij Videnti Streuvelslaan betekent werken met een fijn en professioneel team.

De praktijk is goed bereikbaar, zowel met de auto als het OV. Er is ook voldoende parkeergelegenheid. De praktijk ligt vlakbij een supermarkt en op korte afstand van een winkelcentrum.


Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Het salaris wordt in overleg bepaald
  • Uitstekende bij- en nascholingsmogelijkheden via onze Colosseum Dental Academy
  • Je gaat werken in een inspirerende, professionele werkomgeving als lid van een gemotiveerd team

Onze verwachtingen
• Voor deze vacature komen we graag in contact met een bevlogen Endodontoloog die zich herkent in het volgende:

• Je bent BIG-geregistreerd
• Je hebt een NVvE registratie of minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring als Endodontoloog
• Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal
• Je vindt bij- en nascholing belangrijk in je persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling
• Je kan zowel goed zelfstandig als in teamverband werken

• Je bent in het bezit van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) of bereid deze aan te vragen


Word jij onze nieuwe collega Endodontoloog in Roosendaal?
Herken jij jezelf in deze vacature? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou! Solliciteer via de sollicitatiebutton. Heb je vragen? Dan mag je contact opnemen met Camiel (Recruiter), te bereiken op 06 51 90 32 73 of camiel.naus@colosseumdental.nl

Job Description:

Position Summary:

Under general supervision, provides instruction to students in Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation and First aid courses. Demonstrates the use of appropriate teaching techniques; assisting with setup and cleanup of all equipment, use of appropriate testing and grading procedures including proper maintenance of American Heart Association rosters, and any other record-keeping required; effective use of oral and written communication skills; and knowledge of current in-field procedures. Maintain American Heart Association and CGTC requirements, attend/complete mandatory professional development training. Evaluates student progress in performing CPR and First Aide. Maintain qualifications for employment as described by the Technical College System of Georgia (TCSG) Policy Manual and accreditation standards. Follows rules and regulations as described by the TCSG Policy Manual and other policies and procedures established by the institution. Position will involve, teaching CPR and First Aide, during the day and evening classes, and will require travel to any of the instructional locations with the College’s service area.

Minimum Qualifications: Must upload transcripts which show conferred educational degrees and document qualifications in the employment history:

  • Earned High School Diploma or earned GED equivalent.
  • Documented current Basic Life Support Instructor Certification from the American Heart Association (AHA)

Preferred Qualifications: Preference may be given to applicants who, in addition to meeting the minimum qualifications, provide transcripts of conferred degrees and demonstrate in the employment history possession of one or more of the following:

  • Documented current Pediatric Advanced Life Support Instructor Certification from the AHA
  • Documented current Adult Advanced Life Support Instructor Certification from the AHA

title: Head of Commercial Excellence
description:
Why This Role Matters

Vanguard is seeking a transformational commercial leader to help accelerate growth and execution across Vanguard Workplace Solutions. As Senior Manager, Commercial Excellence, you will serve as a strategic partner to senior leaders and play a critical role in translating business priorities into frontline execution.

This position sits at the intersection of go-to-market activation, sales effectiveness, commercialization, field readiness, and learning. You will lead efforts to activate approved priorities, strengthen sales practices, enhance field readiness, and drive adoption across Sales, Relationship Management, Consultant Relations, and key business partner teams.

Success in this role requires strong commercial judgment, field orientation, and execution discipline. You will ensure that approved business strategies, offers, product priorities, and market insights are translated into actionable activation plans, compelling commercial stories, effective coaching, relevant learning, scalable sales practices, and measurable field adoption.

What You'll Do

Lead Commercial Activation and Execution

  • Translate business, segment, product, and market priorities into actionable go-to-market plans that drive field adoption and support business results.
  • Partners across Sales, Relationship Management, Product, Marketing, Consultant Relations, Technology, Operations, Legal, and Compliance to coordinate commercial activation and field readiness.
  • Develop launch roadmaps, implementation plans, communications, and readiness programs that accelerate adoption and execution.
  • Identify barriers to adoption and drive practical solutions that improve consistency and effectiveness across the organization.

Drive Commercial Excellence and Sales Effectiveness

  • Build and enhance commercial operating frameworks that improve sales execution, pipeline management, account planning, and opportunity discipline.
  • Develop tools, playbooks, and best practices that help teams execute more effectively throughout the client lifecycle.
  • Partner with Sales and Relationship Management leaders to strengthen pipeline quality, opportunity management, account planning, and manager led deal coaching.
  • Partner with front-office leaders to reinforce behaviors, routines and coaching practices that drive sustainable growth.

Lead Product Commercialization and Launch Readiness

  • Oversee go-to-market activation for strategic initiatives, product launches, enhancements, and business priorities.
  • Create commercialization plans, competitive positioning materials, sales enablement content, and adoption strategies in partnership with Product, Offer, Marketing, Sales Strategy, and other accountable teams.
  • Coordinate readiness efforts across multiple stakeholder groups to ensure successful implementation.
  • Measure field adoption and effectiveness and recommend enhancements based on feedback and performance insights.

Elevate Commercial Storytelling and Market Messaging

  • Translate business strategies and value propositions into compelling client, consultant, and field-facing narratives.
  • Develop executive-level messaging, competitive positioning, conversation guides, and proof-point libraries in partnership with Marketing, Product, Offer, Sales Strategy, and subject matter experts.
  • Ensure consistency across marketing materials, client engagements, consultant meetings, product launches, and sales communications.
  • Partner with business leaders to strengthen Vanguard's commercial narrative in the marketplace.

Build Coaching and Leadership Effectiveness

  • Develop frameworks that improve coaching effectiveness across Sales, Relationship Management, and Consultant Relations teams.
  • Enable leaders with tools that support pipeline coaching, deal reviews, account strategy discussions, and client preparation.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, performance, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence.
  • Help leaders reinforce behaviors that drive stronger commercial outcomes.

Lead Learning, Readiness, and Enablement

  • Define and evolve the enablement strategy for client-facing teams across Vanguard Workplace Solutions.
  • Oversee onboarding, professional development, product training, process education, and certification programs.
  • Leverage technology, AI-enabled tools, and data-driven insights to modernize learning and field enablement.
  • Ensure training programs are tightly connected to business priorities and measurable behavior change.

Influence Across the Organization

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and strategic deputy within the Distribution Enablement organization.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that require collaboration, influence, and organizational alignment.
  • Build strong partnerships with senior executives and stakeholders across Vanguard Workplace Solutions.
  • Drive progress through ambiguity and help advance critical commercial priorities.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in financial services, retirement services, asset management, or a related commercial business environment.
  • Demonstrated experience leading go-to-market activation, sales enablement, commercialization, or business transformation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of sales execution, relationship management, pipeline management, and commercial operations.
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
  • Exceptional communication, executive presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Undergraduate degree or an equivalent combination of training and experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within retirement, defined contribution, recordkeeping, workplace benefits, or institutional investment marketplace.
  • Prior leadership experience managing commercial enablement, sales effectiveness, or market activation teams.
  • Expertise developing sales playbooks, coaching frameworks, launch strategies, and commercial messaging.
  • Experience leveraging CRM platforms, analytics, AI tools, and learning technologies to improve field performance.
  • Graduate degree (MBA or related advanced degree).

Special Factors

Sponsorship

Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position.

About Vanguard

At Vanguard, we don't just have a mission—we're on a mission.

To work for the long-term financial wellbeing of our clients. To lead through product and services that transform our clients' lives. To learn and develop our skills as individuals and as a team. From Malvern to Melbourne, our mission drives us forward and inspires us to be our best.

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. description:

The primary responsibility of this position will be to ensure only quality-approved product is packaged for the customer. This includes extrusion or injection molding, weathering, trimming, inspection, and packing. The goal will be to help keep the extrusion lines running or the molding machines running continuously and efficiently while producing a product that meets or exceeds our customers’ expectations.

  • Build/assemble boxes
  • Attach appropriate labels to boxes
  • Notify supervisor of any safety, quality, mechanical, or material issues

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Distinguish colors visually
  • Basic literacy skills required to clearly and legibly complete required paperwork
  • Teamwork Orientation

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE

The employee should have the following:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent and training or certification in relevant skill or trade preferred

  • Must be able to work standing for up to 8-12 hours/shift.
  • Must be able to kneel, squat, bend/twist at the waist, and stack parts at or above head height

  • Ability to work around dust, chemicals, and other substances, and in various environmental conditions

  • with the goals of the business or product line.

We are searching for analytical engineers with signal processing skills to join the Strategic Systems Operation (SSO) Division within the Information Advantage Office at the Applied Research Laboratory (ARL) at Penn State. This role will focus on research, design, development, integration, and testing of advanced signal processing and communications systems.

ARL is an authorized DoD SkillBridge partner and welcomes all transitioning military members to apply.

  • Apply your expertise in signal processing and communications to contribute to programs of national or international impact by identifying emerging challenges, research trends, and future opportunities

  • Advanced understanding of electrical engineering principles associated with communications and signal processing

  • Familiarity with time-, frequency-, and amplitude/phase-difference of arrival for geolocation

  • Understanding of adaptive signal processing methods and techniques (Kalman, Wiener, RMS, LMS, etc.)

  • Acquaintance with digital signal processing techniques used for tuning, filtering, and sampling RF signals

  • Experience in software-defined radio IQ data processing and acquisition

  • Working experience in algorithm design and implementation in software (e.g. C/C++, MATLAB, python, etc.)

  • Understanding of data analysis, statistics, probability, and machine learning applied to IQ signals

  • Experience in sensor design and/or evaluation of sensor data

  • Familiarity with analog and digital conversions along with Nyquist sampling theory

  • Experience or familiarity with statistical signal processing

  • Field test experience in data evaluation and RF troubleshooting

  • Familiarity with simulating signal processing block-diagrams and prototype design

  • Proficiency with converting prototype algorithms from baseline software in MATLAB for near-real time or post-time processing in C++

  • Experience with time or frequency domain datasets

  • An understanding of communications protocols - OSI stack, UDP/TCP/IP

  • Familiarity with wireless specifications such as cellular(4G/5G)/WiFi (802.11)/BLE(802.15)

  • Troubleshooting experience

  • Success in environments where various forms of communication and organizational skills were crucial to be effective

  • Demonstrated capacity to balance detail-oriented thinking while maintaining the ability to see the “big picture”
