title: Data Engineer, Specialist
description:
Role Overview

The Data Engineer, Specialist is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure to support analytics and business intelligence initiatives. This role involves building robust ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, managing databases and optimizing cloud-based data platforms to ensure efficient and seamless integration of data from multiple sources.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain scalable ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to efficiently extract data from diverse sources, transform it as required and load it into data warehouses or analytical systems.
  • Design and optimize database architectures and data pipelines to ensure high performance, availability and security while supporting structured and unstructured data.
  • Integrate data from multiple sources, including APIs, third-party services and on-prem/cloud databases to create unified and consistent datasets for analytics and reporting.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts and business stakeholders to understand their data needs, develop data solutions and enable self-service analytics.
  • Develop automated workflows and data processing scripts using Python, Spark, SQL, or other relevant technologies to streamline data ingestion and transformation.
  • Optimize data storage and retrieval strategies in cloud-based data warehouses such as AWS Redshift, Google Big Query, or Azure Synapse, ensuring scalability and cost-efficiency.
  • Maintain and improve data quality by implementing validation frameworks, anomaly detection mechanisms and data cleansing processes.
  • Thoroughly tests code to ensure accuracy and alignment with its intended purpose. Reviews the final product with end users to confirm clarity and understanding, providing data analysis guidance as needed.
  • Offers tool and data support to business users and team members, ensuring seamless functionality and accessibility.
  • Conducts regression testing for new software releases, identifying issues and collaborating with vendors to resolve them and successfully deploy the software into production.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum of three years data engineering, programming, database administration, or data management experience.
  • Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of training and experience.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python for data manipulation, automation and pipeline development.
  • Experience working with big data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, or Kafka.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based data platforms such as AWS (Glue, S3, Lambda), Data Bricks(Lakehouse, Worklows), or Azure (Synapse, Data Factory).

title: Director of Exceptional Learners
description:
POSITION: Director of Exceptional Learners

LOCATION: DSST: Home Office

SALARY RANGE: $107,500 - $131,100 based on years of aligned experience in a role of similar level and responsibilities, up to 10 years. We also offer a relocation stipend if you are moving from a location greater than 75 miles from Denver!

STATUS/CLASSIFICATION: Full time, benefits eligible, exempt, in-person position (Denver, CO)

START: Immediate start preferred. You can view our current School Year Calendar here.

Applications will be accepted until September 23rd 2026 at 4pm MST.

KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

The Director of Exceptional Learners reports to the Vice President of Teaching, Learning, and Curriculum and works closely with leaders across the organization. This position provides a unique opportunity for an individual with superior special education expertise and people, systems, and instructional leadership skills to play a central role in supporting the advancement of one of the organization's most important priorities.

The Director of Exceptional Learners will lead mission-critical work to:

  • Further develop and actualize DSST’s vision for Exceptional Learners in order to improve academic outcomes for students.

  • Lead the Home Office Exceptional Learners Team in providing excellent service and support to Special Education, 504, and Gifted & Talented leaders and teachers at all DSST schools.

  • Build the capacity of school leaders and teachers throughout the organization to reach desired outcomes for all exceptional learners.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Lead DSST’s Vision for Exceptional Learners (30%):

  • Develop & refine a coherent vision for Special Education, 504, and GT systems, programming, and instruction across the DSST network.

  • Collaborate with the Exceptional Learners Team & network content leaders to adopt and implement curricular materials and resources that drive towards high academic outcomes for Exceptional Learners.

  • Maintain strong line of sight & use data effectively to diagnose the state of instruction, compliance, programming, and other health metrics for exceptional learners, and lead strategic initiatives for continuous improvement.

  • Lead strong systems for school planning in partnership with the Strategy team, the Finance team, Academic Program team, and Human Capital team- ensuring all schools have the staffing, conditions, and systems for strong programming in service of Exceptional Learners.

Lead and Develop a Team for Impactful Programming & School Support (30%):

  • Lead the development of a highly effective team to implement DSST’s vision and achieve results for exceptional learners across the network of schools.

  • Directly coach & manage the Senior Managers of Exceptional Learners, Lead Network SPED Teacher, & Lead Network School Psychologist.

  • Design a clear & sustainable tiered support system for work between the Home Office Exceptional Learners team and schools - ensuring schools are ultimately enabled to achieve our network goals for programming, academic outcomes, and compliance.

  • Analyze Exceptional Learners data through a program, instruction, and compliance lens and create & implement appropriate response plans.

  • Adapt team systems for support as needs change and to support a growing and evolving network of schools.

Develop Network Capacity for Serving Exceptional Learners (25%):

  • Build the capacity of school leaders through the organization to lead effective Special Education programs.

  • Lead highly effective teacher development systems & programming for onboarding and developing special educators across experience levels.

  • Work collaboratively across the organization to ensure coherence between teacher development, coach development, and curriculum implementation in Special Education.

  • Collaborate with school leaders and SPED Admin to identify areas for improvement and provide targeted support to improve and enhance programming for exceptional learners.

External Partnership (10%)

  • Build strong relationships and communication channels with partners at DSST LEAs (Denver Public Schools and Aurora Public Schools)

  • Positively represent DSST with strategic partners, including local Special Education advocacy organizations, regional and national experts, etc.

Additional Duties (5%)

  • Model our Core Values, Commitment to the Human Condition, and our commitment to equity as a Leader within the Network

  • Play an active leadership role in building and sustaining Home Office culture

  • Engage with our school communities to actively build relationships between our schools and the home office

  • Participate in & support the execution of Home Office & Network-wide events


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's Degree required from accredited university

  • Master's Degree or advanced coursework in relevant field strongly preferred

  • At least 3 years of experience as a special education teacher

  • At least 5 years of experience managing programming for exceptional learners

  • You want to change the way the public school system serves students, so that all kids– regardless of race, ethnicity or income – have the opportunity to go to college.

  • Strong commitment to solving education inequity and a passion for the ability of joyful, inclusive culture and student experience to play a role in that solution

  • Proactive problem-solver who demonstrates initiative and ability to work individually and with a team

  • Experience and comfort with facilitation of classroom sessions, professional development, and events

  • Experience and comfort working with middle school and high school students and school staff

  • You create unambiguous systems and procedures to allow others to easily replicate or take advantage of your work and thinking

  • You have a strong customer service mindset and ability to clearly guide users to solutions

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in special education (classroom experience required)

  • 3+ years of experience in school leadership (as an instructional leader, assistant principal, or principal)

  • 2+ years experience in central office or regional leadership


Please note: The DSST Talent Team replies to every application. If you haven’t heard from us by the indicated timeline, please check your spam folder first. If you don’t see an email there, reach out to us at humancapital@scienceandtech.org. We’re committed to providing an exceptional candidate experience.


Application Timeline

This is an evergreen position, meaning DSST Public Schools recruits for this role on an ongoing basis to support current and anticipated hiring needs across our network. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and qualified candidates may be contacted for interviews as opportunities become available.


For positions with a defined hiring timeline, the anticipated application deadline will be listed at the top of the job posting.


Who We Are

At DSST Public Schools, we are proud to achieve transformational results for our 7,500+ students — 97% of whom attend a Green (top-rated) school. Just as important is how we achieve them: values-centered, human-focused, and together.

We invite educators and leaders who share our belief that there is more in us — more brilliance, more courage, more possibility — to join us.

Our Impact

  • 100% of DSST graduates have been admitted to college or a postsecondary program
  • 15 of 16 schools rated Green on the 2024–25 SPF
  • 9 out of 10 DSST families would recommend DSST to a friend
  • 95%+ of staff say their managers check in regularly and care about them as people

Why Work at DSST?

At DSST, our Quantum 5 Culture defines how we help every team member grow, belong, and thrive.

  • Comprehensive Compensation & Benefits: Competitive pay and a Total Rewards package that includes fertility and adoption support, educator-focused mental-health care, and everyday perks like Safeway grocery discounts.
  • Growth & Opportunity: Weekly 1:1 coaching, data-driven feedback, and clear career pathways such as Apprentice Teacher and Emerging Leader.
  • Rewards & Recognition: Core Value and TOAST Awards, milestone celebrations, and the signature Flower Person Award honoring staff who help our community flourish.
  • Whole Human Wellness: Access to the Therapist of Color Collaborative, Wellness Wednesdays, comprehensive health coverage, and six weeks of paid parental leave.
  • Thriving in Colorado: Time to recharge with 11+ weeks off each year, relocation support for out of state applicants, and local discounts that help you enjoy life in our beautiful sunshine filled state.

En stor offentlig vårdorganisation i Stockholmsregionen ska upphandla ett nytt patientövervakningssystem. Upphandlingen är regional och omfattar både större akutsjukhus och mindre sjukhus.

Kraven tas fram tillsammans med företrädare för flera sjukhus, professioner och stödfunktioner. Målet är avtal som skapar nytta för verksamheten och patienterna under lång tid framåt. Uppdragsgivaren vill att rollen bemannas externt, så att den blir oberoende och opartisk.

Om rollen

Du blir huvudprojektledare och den sammanhållande länken mellan verksamheterna, upphandlingsfunktionen och beslutsfattarna. Rollen är både ledande och operativ. Du leder projektet och deltar själv i arbetet.

Du kommer in i ett tidigt skede och följer arbetet från uppstart, genom hela upphandlingen, fram till överlämningen. Därefter tar förvaltningsorganisationen över och genomför införandet på respektive sjukhus.

Uppdraget beräknas pågå i cirka tre år. Det passar dig som har lett upphandlingar enligt LOU tidigare, trivs med att samla många perspektiv och vill se kraven du tar fram bli ett avtal som håller. Rollen förutsätter att du står fri från leverantörer av patientövervakningssystem.

Vad du kommer göra

  • Ta fram och förvalta projektplan, tidplan, budget och resursplan för upphandlingen

  • Leda ett tvärfunktionellt projektteam med deltagare från flera sjukhus och verksamhetsområden

  • Planera och leda möten, workshops och beslutsforum

  • Ta fram tydliga beslutsunderlag för styrgrupp och ledning

  • Samordna kravinhämtningen och se till att behov och krav dokumenteras strukturerat och spårbart

  • Arbeta med risker, beroenden och avvikelser, och planera om när förutsättningarna ändras

  • Kommunicera löpande med alla intressenter om status, risker och beslut

  • Förbereda en strukturerad överlämning till förvaltning och implementering

Vem vi söker

Krav

  • Du har själv varit projektledare för upphandlingsprojekt enligt LOU och har mycket god förståelse för lagen

  • Du har lett större projekt i komplexa organisationer inom region, kommun eller annan offentlig verksamhet

  • Du har lett grupper med många olika professioner och samordnat kravinhämtning från flera verksamheter

  • Du har tagit fram beslutsunderlag till styrgrupp och ledning och arbetat strukturerat med risker och uppföljning

  • Du uttrycker dig mycket väl på svenska i tal och skrift

  • Du kan arbeta heltid på plats hos uppdragsgivaren i Stockholm från 1 oktober 2026

Meriterande

  • Projektledning inom hälso- och sjukvården

  • Erfarenhet av medicinteknik, patientövervakning eller andra vårdnära IT-system

  • Flera genomförda upphandlingar enligt LOU som projektledare, gärna inom vården

  • Erfarenhet av att leda överlämning från projekt till förvaltning

  • Projektledarcertifiering, till exempel IPMA, PMI eller PRINCE2

  • Start: 1 oktober 2026

  • Ersättning: Marknadsenlig, sätts utifrån erfarenhet

Process

  2. Presentation för uppdragsgivaren

  3. Digital intervju med uppdragsgivaren, där du själv deltar

  4. Referenstagning

  5. Besked

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for Senior Software Engineers with 4–6 years of experience to join our Fintech engineering team. In this role, you will be split across two critical pillars of our financial ecosystem: building secure, high-performance customer-facing applications and scaling our internal back-office transaction and operations management software.

While our core ecosystem leverages the MERN Stack, Next.js, and NestJS, we also maintain critical systems built on Laravel. If you have strong JavaScript full-stack skills and hands-on experience with Laravel, this role offers the perfect environment to utilize your entire skillset while scaling secure financial products.


🚀 Key Responsibilities

  • Fintech Product Delivery: Build and maintain responsive, highly secure customer-facing web applications using Next.js and the MERN stack.
  • Back-Office Engineering: Develop scalable back-office systems, internal dashboards, and automated workflows using NestJS to support financial operations, risk management, and compliance teams.
  • Data Integrity & Security: Design optimized database schemas, transaction models, and ledger records in PostgreSQL and MySQL, ensuring absolute data consistency and zero-loss financial tracking.
  • API Ecosystems: Securely build and integrate internal RESTful/GraphQL APIs and third-party financial services (e.g., payment gateways, KYC, banking networks).
  • Code Excellence: Maintain high test coverage (unit/integration tests) for mission-critical payment loops, and perform regular code reviews.
  • Technical Mentorship: Guide junior and mid-level engineers in building resilient backend microservices and sleek frontends.


🛠️ Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Frontend Mastery: Advanced knowledge of React.js and Next.js (Server-Side Rendering, App Router) with a focus on web performance, accessibility, and client-side security.
  • Robust Backend Development: Deep experience with Node.js and building modular, enterprise-grade architectures using NestJS.
  • Relational Database Expertise: Strong proficiency in writing complex, optimized queries, connection pooling, and indexing in PostgreSQL and MySQL.
  • Fintech Mindset: Solid understanding of financial application fundamentals, such as data encryption, secure token management, data audit trails, and handling concurrent transactions.
  • Tooling & DevOps: Strong command over Git, Docker, and standard CI/CD deployment pipelines. Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP) is preferred.

title: Cyber Warfare Engineer
description:
Cyber Warfare Engineer

The Opportunity:

As a Cyber Warfare Engineer, you know how critical it is to stay ahead of evolving threats by identifying and exploiting vulnerabilities before adversaries can. At Booz Allen, you'll bring that expertise to a mission-focused team where you'll conduct testing and analysis to identify vulnerabilities and potential threat vectors into systems and networks, develop exploits, and engineer attack methodologies. You’ll apply advanced engineering skills and extensive technical expertise, develop innovative solutions to complex problems, work without considerable direction, and mentor and supervise team members.

In this role, you’ll perform reconnaissance, collect and analyze open-source intelligence, and conduct enumeration and target profiling to support cyber efforts across the mission owners’ platforms, networks, and systems. Your ability to evaluate, exploit, impact, and develop attack vectors, exploit payloads, and system backdoors will support security and mission owner readiness.

This is your opportunity to help advance national security through cutting-edge cyber capabilities.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience with cybersecurity tools and techniques
  • 3+ years of experience with penetration testing or red or purple team operations
  • 3+ years of experience using risk frameworks, including NIST Risk Management Framework, MITRE ATT&CK or D3FEND, or Diamond Model
  • 3+ years of experience programming with Python, C/C++, Java, PowerShell, or Bash scripting
  • Experience with Blue Force Operations and building and testing virtual machines such as VirtualBox, VMWare, or Parallels
  • Experience with cyber physical systems, architectures, and protocols
  • Ability to be self-motivated, work independently and in a team environment, and mentor junior team members
  • TS/SCI clearance
  • HS diploma or GED
  • Ability to obtain a Security+ Certification within 3 months of hire date

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with processes and best practices related to the management of information and technology risks
  • Experience with security standards and information security and compliance frameworks, controls, and best practices
  • Experience with technical writing and presenting technical information to mixed skill-level audiences, including non-technical and technical peers
  • Experience with cyber threats detection and mitigation, and dynamic malware analysis
  • Experience with malicious network traffic analysis
  • Knowledge of military assessments, training evaluations, and after-action reviews (AARs)
  • Ability to explain, present, demonstrate, and document the operational impact of a vulnerability or exploit
  • Cyber Operations or Penetration Testing Certification such as CEH, GPEN, GPXN, PenTest+, or OSCP Certification

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $86,800.00 to $198,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Working at NLR

NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development.

Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth.

At NLR, you'll find a mission-driven environment supported by state-of-the-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well-being.

Job Description

The Catalytic Carbon Transformation & Scale-Up Center at NLR has an opening for a full time Postdoctoral Researcher within the Economic, Sustainability, and Market Analysis group. The initial appointment is for one year, with possible renewal up to three years.

This position will work primarily on a Center for Bioenergy Innovation (CBI) project, in which we are developing new approaches to cost-effectively convert biomass into realistic biofuels.

https://cbi.ornl.gov/

The successful candidate will work closely with the CBI Lignin Valorization team to conduct biorefinery analyses related to lignin valorization to fuels and chemicals. Analyses will be used to guide experimental R&D and thus a close connection to experimental efforts will be critical. The candidate will work with both AspenPlus and other process modeling tools.

The successful candidate will be able to:

  • assimilate a wide variety of information into assessments

.

With more than 12,000 team members—physicians, surgeons, nurses, pharmacists and other highly skilled health care professionals—UofL Health is focused on one mission: delivering patient-centered care to each and every patient each and every day.

title: Project Manager LATAM
description:
Corteva Agriscience is seeking a Project Manager to lead the development and execution of capital projects supporting a strategic Research & Development (R&D) site in Brazil.

The Project Manager is responsible for delivering projects from Front-End Loading (FEL) through engineering, construction, commissioning, startup, and project closeout, ensuring alignment with business objectives, site priorities, and capital governance requirements.

This role partners with site, regional, and global stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and develop capital investment opportunities that support long-term strategic objectives. The position requires strong leadership of multidisciplinary project teams and third-party contractors, with accountability for project execution, safety, cost, schedule, quality, and communication.

The position is based in Mogi Mirim, Brazil, and reports to Capital Leadership in USA.

What You'll Do

Capital Planning and Front-End Loading (FEL)

  • Lead Front-End Loading (FEL) activities for future capital investments, including scope development, option analysis, risk identification, preliminary engineering, cost estimating, and schedule development.
  • Partner with site, regional, and global leadership to develop and maintain multi-year capital investment plans aligned with strategic business objectives.
  • Facilitate project prioritization discussions to ensure capital resources are allocated effectively across competing opportunities.
  • Develop conceptual estimates and business case documentation to support capital planning and authorization decisions.
  • Ensure project scope, business objectives, assumptions, risks, cost estimates, and execution strategies are clearly defined prior to project authorization.
  • Identify risks and opportunities early in the project lifecycle and implement mitigation strategies to improve project outcomes.

Contractor and Project Execution Leadership

  • Lead project teams through the application of the Core Project Delivery Process .
  • Monitor and analyze project performance through key performance indicators (KPIs), including:
    • Project spending and commitment schedules
    • Project costs versus estimates
    • Engineering and procurement milestones
    • Construction schedules
    • Commissioning and startup plans
  • Oversee third-party engineering, procurement, construction management, and construction contractors.
  • Establish clear contractor roles, responsibilities, expectations, and performance measures.
  • Hold contractors accountable for safety, quality, schedule, cost, and communication performance.
  • Coordinate project resources to support successful project delivery.
  • Resolve issues, barriers, and conflicts that may impact execution.
  • Foster collaboration among contractors, project team members, site personnel, and leadership stakeholders.

Leadership and Stakeholder Management

  • Build and lead high-performing project teams composed of internal stakeholders, engineering partners, construction management resources, and contractors.
  • Promote accountability, teamwork, transparency, and mutual respect.
  • Influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Coach and support project team members and contractors throughout project execution.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and align diverse interests toward common project objectives.
  • Drive a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and proactive problem solving.

Communication and Governance

  • Maintain effective communication with site, regional, and global stakeholders throughout project development and execution.
  • Establish communication and review processes to ensure alignment on project scope, budget, schedule, risks, and business outcomes.
  • Ensure scope changes, budget impacts, and schedule deviations are properly communicated and reviewed through governance processes.
  • Provide timely project updates to site leadership, regional leadership, global stakeholders, and Capital Leadership.
  • Promote transparency and informed decision-making through accurate reporting of project status, risks, opportunities, and action plans.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Chemical, Civil, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering, Chemistry, or a related discipline.
  • 5 to 10 years of experience in project execution, depending on project type, scope, and complexity.
  • Experience developing and executing capital projects within industrial, research, development, pilot plant, laboratory, or technical facility environments.
  • Strong experience with Front-End Loading (FEL), scope development, cost estimating, capital planning, and project execution processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and contractors through influence rather than direct authority.
  • Knowledge of Spanish is a plus.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.
  • Demonstrated commitment to safety leadership and contractor safety management.

Preferred Competencies

  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Proven track record of delivering successful capital projects.
  • Strong project management, engineering, procurement, construction, and project controls knowledge.
  • Excellent organization, planning, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to drive change and make sound decisions in complex environments.
  • Commitment to Inclusion, Diversity, and Equity.
  • High standards of professionalism, integrity, accountability, and business judgment.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Java)
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Backend to join Procore’s Financial Platform and Insights Division. In this role, you’ll own and lead critical backend initiatives, evolve high-throughput distributed architectures, and elevate Procore’s core engineering ecosystem. The primary goal of this role is to scale resilient financial management systems and drive AI-enhanced software solutions for our global customer base.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll partner with Product Managers, Systems Architects, and Engineering Leadership to design scalable services, manage event-driven data streams, and build seamless React user interfaces. Use your expertise in distributed systems, backend development with Java and Ruby, and AI-driven software development to deliver high-impact software that directly influences how communities around the world build schools, hospitals, and homes. Shape the future of construction financial technology—apply today!

This position reports into the Engineering Manager and will be a hybrid role of 2 days per week in our Austin, TX office. We’re looking for someone to join us immediately.

What you’ll do:

  • Architect, build, and scale resilient distributed services and backend infrastructure using Java and Ruby.

  • Design, implement, and maintain high-throughput data streams and message queues using Apache Kafka.

  • Optimize PostgreSQL databases through complex schema design, query performance tuning, and transactional data modeling.

  • Develop and integrate intelligent backend features and workflows leveraging modern AI technologies.

  • Build and maintain interactive, high-performing frontend application components using React.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional product, design, and architecture teams to drive a modern service-oriented architecture.

  • Drive full operational ownership of production services, including deployment, observability, monitoring, and distributed tracing.

  • Write robust, well-tested code following Test-Driven Development (TDD) principles to ensure system reliability.

What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical work experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in backend development using Object-Oriented Programming fundamentals in Java.

  • Proven experience designing, building, and operating event-driven distributed systems with Apache Kafka.

  • Deep technical proficiency in PostgreSQL, including indexing strategies, query optimization, and schema design.

  • Proven experience building interactive web applications using React and modern JavaScript or TypeScript is a plus.

  • Demonstrated experience building software with AI capabilities or integrating AI technologies into development workflows.

  • Strong knowledge of microservice architecture, RESTful API design, and Test-Driven Development (TDD).

  • Pragmatic, curious mindset with a strong ability to evaluate trade-offs between performance, scalability, and business goals.

Additional Information

Base Pay Range:

140,960.00 - 193,820.00 USD Annual

This role may also be eligible for Equity Compensation and/or Bonus Incentive Compensation. Procore is committed to offering competitive, fair, and commensurate compensation. Actual compensation will be based on a candidate’s job-related skills, experience, education or training, and location.

This position requires access to technology, software, and data that is controlled or restricted under U.S. law, regulation, executive order, or government contract.

Procore will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the requirements of applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

A criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: 1. appropriately managing, accessing, and handling confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information, as well as accessing Procore's information technology systems and platforms; 2. interacting with and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external customers, stakeholders, and/or colleagues; and 3. exercising sound judgment.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Join Northrop Grumman on our continued mission to push the boundaries of possible across land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace. Enjoy a culture where your voice is valued and start contributing to our team of passionate professionals providing real-life solutions to our world’s biggest challenges. We take pride in creating purposeful work and allowing our employees to grow and achieve their goals every day by Defining Possible. With our competitive pay and comprehensive benefits, we have the right opportunities to fit your life and launch your career today.

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems is seeking to hire a Staff Systems Engineer to be the Network Integration lead. This position will be located in Roy, Utah and supports the Sentinel Program.

This role may offer a competitive relocation package.

What You'll Get To Do:

This candidate will join the Weapon System Integration (WSI) team under Sentinel Systems Engineering, Integration, & Test (SEIT), working on Network Systems Integration (NSI). Under the guidance of the Sentinel Network Lead, the selected candidate will support the NSI team which works to develop program-wide networking governance and standards, develop and/or synthesize network artifacts at the system level (including cross-segment network interfaces, program network architecture, and network documentation), perform program-wide gap assessments for network development, develop handling plans for any identified issues, and provide networking subject matter expertise to areas such as Major Program Event (MPE) reviews, modeling (architecture, simulation, analysis....), and requirements. NSI team purview includes the deliverable network architecture, incremental/test configs (lab networks), & ITF/MIF/VSFB test networks.

Job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Mentor three mid-career integrators/assignees, each responsible for leading integration activities with a subset of networks
  • Participate in frequent working groups to support iterative development
  • Influence network requirements and interfaces; translate program-level requirements into network-level deliverables
  • Assess the design, implementation, and maintenance of scalable network infrastructure to include network design, architecture, specifications, cross-segment interfaces, and equipment selection per DoD requirements
  • Use Model-Based Systems Engineering practices to design, test, and verify network capabilities
  • Support all phases of the systems lifecycle including concept, design, fabrication, test, installation, operation, maintenance and disposal
  • Apply the principles of engineering to design components and systems using applicable standards and specifications
  • Provide specific and detailed information for hardware and software selection as well as implementation techniques and tools for the most efficient solution to meet business needs, including present and future capacity requirements
  • Create and ensure that appropriate network documentation exists
  • Develop and document technical processes and procedures as needed
  • Recommend and implement system/process enhancements that will improve the performance and reliability of the system

Basic Qualifications

  • Must be a US Citizen with an active U.S. Government Top Secret security clearance with an ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) approval within a reasonable period of time as determined by the company to meet its business need

  • 6+ years of experience with designing, architecting, and deploying complex network infrastructures
  • 2+ years of experience implementing and using model-based systems engineering tools, practices, and methods (including using SysML or UML languages in Cameo or Rhapsody)
  • 4+ years of experience working with requirements including authoring, allocating, tracing, interpreting, etc...
  • 3+ years of strong program execution skills; demonstrated ability to meet program technical, cost, and schedule milestones
  • 5+ years strong partnership/collaboration skills with demonstrated ability to partner cross-IPT/cross-discipline within a team
  • 4+ years of experience with one or more of the following: C2, physical security, cybersecurity, communications systems, facility design, military aerospace development
  • 2+ years of experience guiding the development of governance and standards
  • Experience with systems integration

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's Degree in a relevant technical specialty
  • 2+ years of experience with DOORS
  • Familiarity with DoD security frameworks, NIST 800-53, MIL-STD-1553, Ethernet-AV, CAN-bus
  • Experience with ICBMs, Missile Programs, Command and Control, or Communications related programs
  • Communication and leadership skills and experience leading small teams in a dynamic work environment
  • Large scale / complex system development experience across multiple phases of a development program: preliminary design, detailed design, integration and test, verification and sell off, transition to production
  • Experience with technical reviews for large-scale and complex system development
  • Demonstrated experience in making sound decisions in uncertain and difficult situations
  • Cisco CCNA, CCNP, or CCIE Certification

title: Senior Grid Analyst—Power Flow and Integrated Planning
description:
Posting Title

Senior Grid Analyst—Power Flow and Integrated Planning

.

Location

CO - Golden

.

Position Type

Regular

.

Hours Per Week

40

.

Working at NLR

NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development.

Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth.

At NLR, you'll find a mission-driven environment supported by state-of-the-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well-being.

Job Description

Are you passionate about improving the reliability, resilience, and affordability of the electric grid using improved integrated planning techniques, including power flow, dynamics, and related analyses? Do you enjoy modeling transmission and distribution systems across a range of timescales, spatial resolutions and use cases? Are you able to pass that enthusiasm and these skill sets on to others through trainings, mentoring, and other outreach?

The Grid Planning and Analysis Center (GPAC) at NLR is looking for exceptional candidates to join our team to help conduct bulk/transmission power flow, dynamic, and related contingency modeling including building models in commercial and lab tools, conducting power flow and dynamics studies for both existing and future grids, and help connect such modeling into multi-model workflows. In addition, this role will help lead complex partner projects with a range of partners in the U.S. and worldwide, contribute to distribution-scale modeling and analysis, participate in the development and analysis of new technoeconomic schemes for grid management, and provide technical assistance to partners.

The ideal candidate would bring solid knowledge on bulk power system dynamics, co-simulation, along with experience modeling of distribution systems, and DER & IBR; along with project leadership experience and the ability to teach these skills to other both at the lab and through partnerships.

We are researchers, engineers, software developers, modelers, physicists, product managers, thought leaders, system thinkers, and life-long learners. We strive to push the boundaries of innovation, integrated analysis, and computational tool development. You would join us in developing innovative modeling approaches, collaboratively applying them with a wide-range of research and industry partners to conduct high-impact analysis and working to articulate current trends and chart future needs in integrated grid systems. A sample of ongoing research include reliability studies examining interactions between DER, grid-forming IBRs, and bulk grid dynamics; multi-model frameworks for helping to automate complex grid planning workflows; and bulk transmission-system planning at both regional and continental scales.

Come join a team whose mission is to innovate, inform, and create value for energy systems transitions, including renewable energy, distribution systems, transmission systems, energy storage, markets, and economics and much more.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Build, troubleshoot, and validate large-scale bulk/transmission power system models
  • Conduct AC power flow, dynamics, and contingency simulations across scales ranging from smaller island and regional-scale systems up to national and international interconnections
  • Leading engagement with utilities, including responsibility for setting up technical working groups, leading regular calls, responding to partner requests, etc.
  • Developing/adapting analytical tools as needed to support technology evaluation, planning, approval and integration
  • Supporting the development of and community-building for open-source software tools
  • Developing and delivering training curriculum as appropriate to engineers at grid operators on analytical methods and use of relevant tools in institutional processes
  • Identifying potential research and assistance funding sources and engaging with partners to secure support
  • Design, develop and maintain multi-model frameworks and tool interfaces
  • Apply best-practice in software development techniques
  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams of developers, engineers, and analysts
  • Present work at conferences, symposia, and project meetings
  • Contribute to journal articles, conference papers, and technical reports
  • Work with other staff to develop proposals and partnerships for funding opportunities

What we can offer:

  • A collaborative, supportive, flexible, and fun work environment
  • Training, mentoring, and collaboration to build upon or learn new technical skills
  • Interesting work where you don’t do the same thing every day
  • Projects, professional development, and growth opportunities to help you meet your career goals
  • A professional environment that encourages innovation and imaginative thinking to understand and plan the future electric power system
  • Adaptable schedule to promote work-life balance

.

Basic Qualifications

Relevant PhD and 4 or more years of experience . Or, relevant Master's Degree and 7 or more years of experience . Or, relevant Bachelor's Degree and 9 or more years of experience . Applies extensive engineering technical expertise, and has full knowledge of other related disciplines. Considered a technical resource. Demonstrates leadership in several areas of team, task or project lead responsibilities. Demonstrated experience in management of projects.

* Must meet educational requirements prior to employment start date.

Additional Required Qualifications

  • Experience with commercial power system power flow software such as Powerworld, PSS/E, PowerFactory, or similar
  • Experience with distribution-scale modeling and analysis, such as with CYME, Synergi, PowerFactory, or similar
  • Exceptional written and oral communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently and in team settings

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven expertise with developing, modeling, troubleshooting, and in-depth analysis with large-scale power system power flow and dynamics (phasor, RMS) using widely used commercial software tools including Powerworld, PSS/E, and DIgSILENT
  • Experience with production cost modeling tools, such as PLEXOS-ST or Sienna, and their interactions with power flow models
  • Experience automating, conducting, and visualizing engineering analyses for large-scale grids, including N-1, N-1-1, and N-k contingencies; frequency response; and multiple stability criteria for both strong and weak grids
  • Experience developing and validating dynamic models for both grid-forming and grid-following IBRs with a variety of energy sources, including solar, wind, and storage.
  • Experience troubleshooting and adapting system-scale models for convergence, particularly for future scenarios with extensive changes to the generator fleet and widespread transmission expansion
  • Experience with analyzing the technical and financial impacts of DERs on distribution systems (e.g., hosting capacity, non-wires alternatives, locational value of DPV, etc.)
  • Experience working with utility stakeholders at various levels to translate analysis outputs into implications and actionable recommendations for DER planning, evaluation, approval and integration
  • Experience evaluating economic and business elements of DER policy decisions, including evaluating DER compensation mechanisms, projections of DER consumer uptake, etc.
  • Experience leading trainings and working groups with culturally diverse audiences in a capacity-building setting, including developing training curriculum and materials and building trust and confidence with partners
  • Experience with software development for scripting and automation of such analyses, particularly in Python, Julia, or Rust
  • Experience with multi-model and co-simulation frameworks such as HELICS and MDO4Grid
  • Familiarity with DER and IBR interconnection standards, such as IEEE 2800 or IEEE 1547

.

Job Application Submission Window

The anticipated closing window for application submission is up to 30 days and may be extended as needed.

Annual Salary Range (based on full-time 40 hours per week)

Job Profile: Researcher IV / Annual Salary Range: $100,400 - $180,700

NLR takes into consideration a candidate’s education, training, and experience, expected quality and quantity of work, required travel (if any), external market and internal value, including seniority and merit systems, and internal pay alignment when determining the salary level for potential new employees. In compliance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, a potential new employee’s salary history will not be used in compensation decisions.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; short*- and long-term disability insurance; pension benefits*; 403(b) Employee Savings Plan with employer match*; life and accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance; personal time off (PTO) and sick leave; paid holidays; and tuition reimbursement*. NLR employees may be eligible for, but are not guaranteed, performance-, merit-, and achievement- based awards that include a monetary component. Some positions may be eligible for relocation expense reimbursement. Limited-term positions are not eligible for long-term disability or tuition reimbursement.

* Based on eligibility rules

Badging Requirement

NLR is subject to Department of Energy (DOE) access restrictions. All employees must also be able to obtain and maintain a federal Personal Identity Verification (PIV) card as required by Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12), which includes a favorable background investigation.

Drug Free Workplace

NLR is committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace in accordance with the federal Drug-Free Workplace Act and complies with federal laws prohibiting the possession and use of illegal drugs. Under federal law, marijuana remains an illegal drug.

If you are offered employment at NLR, you must pass a pre-employment drug test prior to commencing employment. Unless prohibited by state or local law, the pre-employment drug test will include marijuana. If you test positive on the pre-employment drug test, your offer of employment may be withdrawn.

Submission Guidelines

Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at NLR you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified. Applications are not kept on file for future positions. Please include a cover letter and resume with each position application.

.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, domestic partner status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.

You will manage operational rhythms, track technology investments, and serve as the primary technical writer for strategic documentation. By translating complex technical architectures into clear executive briefings, win themes, and campaign plans, you will ensure seamless communication between program and engineering teams, corporate leadership, and military customers.

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor's degree with 8 years (or Master's degree with 6 years) of project management, project integration, or strategic communications experience within a technical field.

  • Executive Briefing Skills: Expert-level capability in preparing and presenting analytical data and presentations for executive leadership, suppliers, and customers.
  • Software Tools: High proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel) and documentation tracking tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Project Management, Communications, or STEM.

  • Current Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

title: ECAD Designer
description:
Job Title: ECAD Designer

Job Location: Southfield, MI

What we offer:

Veoneer Safety Systems is the world leader in Automotive Electronic Safety Systems. Veoneer’s scalable, best-in-class restraint control systems are mitigating the effects of a car crash. To date, we have delivered more than 1 billion devices to car manufacturers globally.

Veoneer Safety Systems has an international and collaborative team of 2,700 employees in 11 countries. We empower our people and are dedicated to their professional development and growth.

Veoneer Safety Systems – Protect Everyone in Every Crash.

What you'll do:

Design cost-effective, high-reliability printed circuit boards for automotive applications, with an emphasis on manufacturability, signal integrity, power integrity, and robust production release.

Primary responsibilities include PCB layout design using Altium, performing Design for Manufacturing (DFM) rule checks, conducting signal integrity (SI) and power integrity (PI) simulations using ANSYS, and incorporating simulation results into the final design.
Create PCB layouts to meet project specifications, using Altium Designer.

  • Collaborate with PCB suppliers to understand and implement fabrication requirements.

  • Integrate manufacturing rules and perform DFM(Design for Manufacturing) checks to ensure PCB designs can be reliably mass-produced for automotive applications.

  • Work with EMC specialists and electrical design engineers to understand design requirements and implement them effectively.

  • Perform PCB-level signal integrity and power integrity analysis, including DC and AC drop analysis, and provide layout optimization recommendations based on the results.

  • Perform bench verification using a Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) to validate trace impedance and high-speed signal quality.

  • Document test results, design checks, and verification activities performed on PCB designs.

  • Prepare and release fabrication and assembly drawings, Gerber files, BOMs, and revision-controlled design documents

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years of PCB layout experience, preferably in automotive applications.

  • Experience managing ECAD library models to support the design process.

  • Fluency with the Altium design workflow.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain technical concepts.

  • Detail-oriented approach with the ability to document test plans, execute test procedures, and generate reports.

  • Knowledge of PCB layout practices that support EMC performance and manufacturing requirements.

  • Knowledge of high-speed PCB design concepts, impedance control, and signal-quality optimization within the layout.

  • Understanding of PCB fabrication processes and laminate material selection.

  • Experience using a Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) to verify trace impedance and signal quality.

  • Self-driven, proactive approach to completing tasks and solving problems.

title: Agentic AI Forward-Deployed Engineer
description:
Agentic AI Forward-Deployed Engineer

The Opportunity

As an AI-forward engineer, you know that intelligence has become a commodity. Every organization has access to the same frontier models and the advantage now belongs to those who can deploy them. Your ability to sit with a team, map how their work actually happens, and turn that understanding into reliable AI agents makes you an integral part of transforming how our programs deliver. We need your technical depth, advisory instincts, and ownership mindset to bring agentic AI to the programs where it matters most.

You'll join our growing corps of forward deployed engineers within our Global Defense Disruption Cell, deploying to billable programs where people spend their days executing well-defined processes by hand. Your mission is to turn humans executing flow charts into agents executing flow charts, and to make those humans supervisors of that automation. You'll embed with program teams to map their workflows and exception paths, then exercise judgment about where deterministic software ends and model judgment begins. You'll build agents that are reliable, observable, and auditable from day one, and prove they work with evaluation suites before scaling them from shadow mode to production. Just as important, you'll bring the people along winning trust, managing the change, training the workforce, and leaving each program more capable than you found it.

You won't do this alone. You'll operate with direct reach-back to the Disruption Cell, a team dedicated to clearing your blockers, escalating data-access and policy obstacles, and turning what you build in the field into reusable patterns, playbooks, and shared capabilities for the entire corps. The patterns you build once become capabilities every program can reuse. Work with us to define how AI transformation actually gets delivered one program, one workflow, one agent at a time.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

What You'll Work On:

  • Embed with program teams to observe and document how work actually happens, including workflows, systems, data flows, decision points, and the exception paths that never make it into the documented process.

  • Produce operating maps and automation roadmaps that prioritize high-volume workflows by expected value and risk, and decide where deterministic software, agent judgment, and human-in-the-loop approval each belong.

  • Design, build, and deploy AI agents that reason, plan, and act across the program's existing tools, APIs, and data sources.

  • Build on the systems teams already use rather than forcing a migration.

  • Develop evaluation frameworks, golden datasets, and regression tests that turn non-deterministic behavior into evidence, and scale agents from shadow mode to increasing autonomy to production.

  • Instrument everything including audit trails, monitoring, and metrics that let program leadership see exactly what agents are doing and what value they deliver in hours saved, risk reduced, and outcomes improved.

  • Drive adoption and change management, train the workforce, redesign roles around supervision of automation, and de-risk the transformation for the people living through it.

  • Codify what you learn into playbooks, reusable components, and field feedback for the Disruption Cell, and escalate blockers through direct reach-back so no engagement stalls on access or politics.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, technical advisory, or solutions engineering roles

  • 2+ years of experience building applications with generative and agentic AI technologies, including LLMs, RAG, MCP, or multi-agent orchestration

  • Experience deploying an LLM-powered system or AI agent into a production environment, including evaluation, monitoring, and iteration after launch

  • Experience developing production code in Python or TypeScript

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems and data sources, such as ERP, CRM, ITSM, or SharePoint platforms

  • Experience working directly with customers or business stakeholders to elicit requirements, map business processes, and guide adoption of new technology

  • Knowledge of evaluation techniques for non-deterministic systems, including golden datasets, regression testing, and human-in-the-loop feedback

  • Ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and communicate with audiences ranging from engineers to executives

  • Ability to obtain a Secret clearance

  • Bachelor's degree

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with agentic coding and orchestration tools, such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, LangGraph, or the OpenAI Agents SDK

  • Experience in a forward deployed, embedded, or residency-style engineering role at a customer site

  • Experience with organizational change management, including training, communications, workforce transition, or user adoption programs

  • Experience with business process analysis or process mapping, including BPMN or value stream mapping

  • Experience with cloud platforms and containerized deployment, including AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, or Terraform

  • Ability to quantify automation impact in terms of cost savings, risk mitigation, or revenue uplift

  • Secret clearance

  • Master's degree

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information

Compensation

Competent in employing and directing behavior analytic methodologies including Pivotal Response Training (PRT), Natural Environment Teaching (NET), Picture Exchange Communication System (PECS), Behavior Skills Training (BST), and Experimental Functional Analysis (EFA).

title: Radio Frequency Test Engineer, Mid
description:
Radio Frequency Test Engineer, Mid

The Opportunity:

When a user tries new communication systems, they expect it to be intuitive and run smoothly. Functionality, reliability, and user experience are key to successful system development, and that means rigorous testing. That’s why we need a knowledgeable test engineer like you who knows how to thoroughly test radio and communication systems in laboratory and operational test environments.

As a test engineer on our team, you’ll work with engineers to support the integration, testing, and assessment of radio and communications systems in laboratory and operational test environments. This role is for a hands-on engineer with solid RF experience, sound engineering judgment, and a strong grounding in waveform behavior, signal processing, and radio system performance. The work centers on evaluating communications system performance under complex RF conditions. You will help characterize waveform and data-link behavior, identify performance limits, work with test and measurement hardware and software, and analyze results to support clear technical findings and practical next steps. This role is for someone who is effective at the bench, credible in technical discussions, and comfortable moving between system integration, test execution, and performance analysis. It also fits an engineer who keeps current, can learn new analysis methods and tools without a lot of fanfare, and uses them when they improve the work.

This is an opportunity to leverage your skills by testing radio and communications systems. You’ll also further your experience in systems engineering and hands-on test execution, and explore new areas like satellite communications and enterprise networks.

Work with us as we develop communication solutions to enable our nation's warfighters.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • Experience integrating and testing radio communication systems across hardware and software components
  • Experience analyzing RF or communications test results and preparing technical reports or data products
  • Experience using RF test and measurement equipment and associated software tools
  • Experience assessing communications performance in complex RF environments
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment, supporting work ranging from detailed analysis to routine test and team support
  • Knowledge of waveform behavior, RF system performance, and digital signal processing
  • Ability to learn new test, measurement, and analysis methods, and apply them to practical engineering work
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time to test events
  • Top Secret clearance

title: Civil/Water Engineer – Water Infrastructure Projects
description:
Company Overview:

We are a dynamic organization committed to the development, rehabilitation, and expansion of water infrastructure projects across Nigeria. We collaborate with government institutions, NGOs, and donor agencies to deliver sustainable and impactful water supply and sanitation solutions nationwide.


Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Civil/Water Engineer to support the planning, design, supervision, and implementation of water infrastructure projects.

The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience in water supply systems including reservoirs, treatment plants, transmission mains, distribution networks, and related civil works. Experience working on donor-funded, NGO-sponsored, or government water projects is highly desirable.

The role requires strong technical expertise in civil engineering works related to water systems, construction supervision, and quality control.


Key Responsibilities:

Design & Technical Support:

  • Support the design and review of water infrastructure systems including reservoirs, treatment plants, and pipeline networks.

  • Prepare and review engineering drawings, BOQs, technical specifications, and cost estimates.

  • Conduct hydraulic assessments and ensure proper system sizing and alignment.

  • Ensure compliance with Nigerian regulations and applicable international standards.


Construction Supervision:

  • Supervise civil works including excavation, concrete works, pipeline installation, chamber construction, and structural components.

  • Monitor contractor performance and ensure adherence to approved drawings and specifications.

  • Conduct routine site inspections and verify material quality.

  • Ensure proper backfilling, compaction, and reinstatement procedures.


Quality Assurance & Compliance:

  • Implement QA/QC procedures for civil construction activities.

  • Ensure compliance with environmental, health, and safety standards.

  • Support donor safeguard compliance where applicable.

  • Prepare site reports, progress documentation, and technical records.


Project Coordination:

  • Coordinate with electrical, mechanical, and structural teams for integrated project delivery.

  • Participate in stakeholder meetings and technical review sessions.

  • Support commissioning and handover processes.



Requirements

Qualifications & Requirements:

Education & Experience:

  • BSc/HND in Civil Engineering, Water Resources Engineering, or related field.

  • Minimum of 5–8 years of relevant experience in water infrastructure projects.

  • Experience in reservoirs, water treatment facilities, transmission pipelines, or distribution networks is required.

  • Experience handling donor-funded, NGO-sponsored, or government projects is an added advantage.


Professional Certification (Compulsory):

  • Registered with COREN (Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria) – Mandatory.

  • Active member of NSE (Nigerian Society of Engineers) – Mandatory.


Technical Competencies:

  • Strong understanding of water supply systems and civil construction methods.

  • Knowledge of reinforced concrete works and pipeline installation.

  • Familiarity with hydraulic principles and water system layouts.

  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings and specifications.

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD and other relevant engineering tools is an advantage.


Personal Attributes:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Good site supervision and coordination ability.

  • Excellent communication and reporting skills.

  • Detail-oriented and quality-driven.

  • Willingness to travel for site supervision across Nigeria.



Benefits

Salary: ₦ 400,000 – ₦ 600,000

Job Description:

Position Description

We are seeking a hands on, highly engaged Forward Deployed Engineer (Staff) specializing in Kubernetes, platform modernization, large scale stateful workload migration, and enterprise AI infrastructure. In this role, you will be embedded directly alongside enterprise client teams throughout the entire end to end lifecycle of an engagement. From initial architecture, bare metal/legacy re platforming, and AI cluster setup to live in the field troubleshooting and production rollout.

Because you are part of the core Engineering organization, you won't just file bug reports; you will write production code in the field, build prototype integrations, and channel those contributions directly back to our engineering teams across the Infrastructure Software Division (ISG) to help shape, prioritize, and accelerate high impact platform capabilities. This role sits directly within the Engineering Business Unit (BU), working side by side with product and core software teams. Unlike traditional professional services or post sales support roles, our Forward Deployed Engineering team operates as an extension of core engineering in the field.

Our Core Mission: Reduce customer adoption friction, dramatically shorten software iteration cycles, and establish a high bandwidth, direct feedback loop between real world enterprise deployments and product development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Direct Engineering to Field Collaboration: Act as an embedded engineering liaison across the Infrastructure Software Division, working directly with core software architects, product managers, and enterprise client developers to eliminate deployment friction.
  • Rapid Iteration & Friction Reduction: Identify recurring migration blockers and platform usability gaps in real world customer environments, rapidly building and testing field fixes to shorten feature iteration cycles from months to days.
  • End to End Engagement Ownership: Stay actively embedded with customer technical teams from pre migration discovery through go live and operational stabilization, ensuring successful platform adoption and high customer trust.
  • Hands on Field Implementation & Troubleshooting: Work shoulder to shoulder with client engineers in production environments to write code, build manifests, debug live networking/storage/GPU failures, and optimize VKS performance.
  • Engineering Feedback Loop & Feature Prioritization: Synthesize field tested code, architectural patterns, and customer pain points directly into core engineering requirements. Partner with product managers and core engineers to translate customer contributions into prioritized platform features.
  • VKS & AI Infrastructure Architecture: Architect, deploy, and maintain production grade vSphere Kubernetes Service (VKS) clusters across VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) and hybrid cloud infrastructure, optimized for both general purpose compute and accelerated GPU/NPU workloads.
  • Bare Metal & Legacy Platform Migration: Lead technical migration strategies transitioning enterprise platforms, massive bare metal environments, and legacy data stacks over to VKS or cloud native Kubernetes targets.
  • Enterprise AI & Inferencing Modernization: Deploy, tune, and scale production AI inferencing workloads, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures, vector search, and model serving frameworks on Kubernetes using virtualized GPU resources (NVIDIA vGPU, MIG).
  • Data Services & Messaging Re Platforming: Containerize, refactor, and migrate heavy stateful engines, message brokers (Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ), distributed caches (Redis, Oracle Coherence, Hazelcast), and risk calculation/analytics platforms onto Kubernetes.
  • Modern Data & AI Stack Modernization: Architect operator driven, cloud native deployments for data processing, orchestration, and distributed AI frameworks (Ray, vLLM, Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Trino/Presto, Flink, Dask, Cassandra/ScyllaDB, Milvus/Qdrant).
  • Multi Kubernetes Integration: Guide clients evaluating or operating VKS alongside competing distributions (Red Hat OpenShift, Amazon EKS, Google GKE, Azure AKS, Rancher RKE/RKS).

Key Qualifications

  • Engineering Mindset & Organizational Fit: Deep alignment with product engineering workflows; experience functioning within or closely alongside core software/R&D divisions rather than pure IT or professional services.
  • Full Lifecycle Engagement Experience: Proven track record of staying deeply engaged with customer technical leadership and developers across long term, complex engineering projects.
  • Product Minded Engineering: Demonstrated ability to translate raw technical customer requirements and field workarounds into clean product specifications and feature requests for core development teams.
  • AI & Accelerated Compute Infrastructure: Hands on experience operating GPU accelerated Kubernetes nodes, model serving runtimes (vLLM, TGI, Triton Inference Server), vector databases (Milvus, Qdrant, Pgvector), and distributed AI orchestration (Ray, KubeRay).
  • Distributed Systems & Stateful Workloads: Hands on experience containerizing and operating high throughput/low latency platforms:Distributed Caching & In Memory Grids: Redis, Oracle Coherence, Hazelcast
  • Compute & Analytics Engines: Risk calculation platforms, Hadoop (HDFS/YARN)
  • Messaging & Streaming: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pulsar
  • Cloud Native Data & AI Stack Depth: Deep technical knowledge of deploying, tuning, and scaling containerized data services, AI engines, and orchestrators:
  • Batch, Real Time & AI Processing: Ray, vLLM, Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Dask
  • Orchestration & Workflow: Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Argo Workflows
  • Query, NoSQL & Vector Engines: Trino/Presto, Apache Cassandra / ScyllaDB, Elasticsearch / OpenSearch, Milvus, Qdrant
  • Multi Kubernetes Proficiency: Technical depth across competing enterprise distributions (OpenShift, EKS, GKE, AKS, or Rancher RKE/RKS).
  • Infrastructure as Code & GitOps: Advanced skills in Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes Operators (KPO), Cluster API (CAPI), and GitOps (ArgoCD, Flux).

Experience/Education:

Bachelor's degree preferred. Relevant year's experience in lieu of a degree may be considered.

12+ years related experience required

title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
SentLogic is a Meta-approved platform that turns Instagram DMs into a measurable revenue channel for Shopify brands. Our AI advisor reads buyer intent in a DM thread, answers from live Shopify data like stock and sizing, and closes the sale inside the conversation. Every resulting order is written to an append-only ledger that ties it back to the exact thread that produced it. Most marketing attribution is a statistical guess. Ours is a chain of custody.

We are a small remote team of five across the US and India. The product went live in production in August 2026 and is in its first merchant trials. You would be joining early enough that your work ships and gets used.

The role

Full-time remote internship, six months, with a path to a full-time offer for the right person. You will work directly with the founder and alongside the engineering partner building the platform. This is a small company, not a rotation programme. You get real problems and real code review, but you should want that rather than needing a structured curriculum.

What you'll work on

  • Building and testing features across our Python backend and Next.js dashboard
  • Writing integration tests against the Shopify and Meta Graph APIs
  • Internal tooling that makes a five person team move faster
  • Debugging live issues in webhook processing and background job queues
  • Prototyping against our retrieval layer, including embeddings and brand voice tuning
  • Documenting what you build so the next person does not have to rediscover it

Our stack

Python and FastAPI. Async workers on Arq. Postgres 16 with pgvector. Next.js App Router on the front end. Redis, S3 compatible object storage, Git based workflow with code review on every merge. You will not know all of it on day one. You should be able to name at least one and show us something you built with it.

What we're looking for

  • Working knowledge of at least one of Python, TypeScript, or JavaScript, with code we can look at. A GitHub repo, a personal project, coursework, anything real.
  • Comfort with Git in a team setting: branches, pull requests, resolving your own conflicts.
  • The instinct to read an error message and a stack trace before asking. We will always help, but we want someone who tries first.
  • Clear written English. On a distributed team most communication is asynchronous and written, and this matters more than it sounds like it does.
  • Genuine interest in e-commerce, marketing technology, or attribution. You do not need experience in it. You do need to find it interesting, because you will be reasoning about merchant problems, not just tickets.

Nice to have

REST API integration experience, exposure to Postgres, prior work with LLM APIs or vector search, or a Shopify or Meta developer account you have actually built against.

Formal enrolment in a Computer Science or related degree is preferred but not required. If you can show equivalent work, show us the work.

Compensation and terms

  • ₹25,000 to ₹30,000 per month, depending on experience
  • Six month term, full-time, fully remote
  • Working hours are 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST, Monday to Friday. Hours are fixed to IST. US-side overlap shifts by one hour when US clocks change on 1 November 2026.
  • Strong performers receive a full-time offer at the end of the term. Equity participation becomes available once SentLogic completes its planned conversion to a Delaware C-corporation.
  • All contributors sign an IP assignment agreement before starting

How to apply

Send your CV and a link to something you have built to . In two or three sentences, tell us what you found interesting about the attribution problem described above. We read these.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon.
