Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems is seeking a Mission and Quality Assurance Engineer (Quality Engineer) to support the Relay Ground Station – Asia (RGS A) program. This position supports the Program Mission and Quality Assurance (MA/QA) Lead and operates across Mission Assurance, Quality Assurance, Systems Engineering, and Software/Hardware Development.

The selected candidate will help implement and execute the Systems Engineering Management Plan (SEMP), Mission Assurance Plan (MAP), and related technical plans to ensure first time quality and mission success across software, hardware, integration, and verification activities.

This role requires frequent on site and field presence (up to ~50% travel) to labs, supplier facilities, and the operational site to support inspections, testing, reviews, and deployment readiness.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Management System & Mission Assurance

  • Support the Program MA/QA Lead in executing MA/QA responsibilities in alignment with:
    • Organizational Quality Management System (QMS) (e.g., AS9100 Rev D, ISO 9001)
    • Applicable Northrop Grumman PrOPs and program procedures
    • Customer and contract requirements (PWS, TRD, CDRLs)
  • Assist in planning and executing internal audits of engineering processes (software, hardware, systems, integration/test) to:
    • Assess implementation of the SEMP, MAP, CDM Plan, and related plans
    • Verify compliance with AS9100, PrOPs, and program requirements
    • Document findings and track corrective actions to closure
  • Support Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) activities:
    • Investigate nonconformances, test anomalies, FRACAS records, and audit findings
    • Help develop, implement, and verify corrective/preventive actions
    • Contribute to RCCA / DR / PAR / CAPA tracking tools
  • Help manage nonconformances (DRs) and escapes, coordinating with engineering, suppliers, and integration & test teams.
  • Support development and reporting of quality and engineering metrics (e.g., defect trends, test performance, audit performance) and use them to identify improvement opportunities.

Program-Integrated Mission Assurance Support

  • Assist the MA/QA Lead in integrating mission assurance and quality activities across the program.
  • Identify and document issues and improvement opportunities in program tracking tools.
  • Help define and track corrective/preventive actions related to quality and mission assurance findings.
  • Support MA/QA and technical reviews with quality inputs, status updates, and supporting metrics.

Engineering Process & Work Product Quality

  • Support verification that engineering processes and work products follow the RGS A SEMP, including:
    • Requirements development and management (DOORS, TBX tracking/metrics)
    • System architecture (Cameo models, SSDD, ICDs)
    • Hardware and software design, development, integration, and verification
    • Configuration & Data Management, Technical Reviews, and Engineering Checkpoint Reviews
  • Participate in reviews by:
    • Assessing artifacts for quality, completeness, and coherence with the SEMP, MAP, and CDM Plan
    • Supporting checklists, action item tracking, and closure documentation
  • Provide MA/QA perspective on requirements traceability, closure trends, and metrics derived from JIRA/DOORS/Cameo, as well as test planning, verification methods, and test readiness.

Hardware, Software, and Systems Quality

Hardware QA

  • Support and perform inspections of hardware and associated documentation, including incoming inspection, pre integration readiness checks, and configuration/acceptance inspections.
  • Assist with environmental testing and hardware test readiness from a quality standpoint, including procedure, data, and report review.

Software QA

  • Support mission assurance of software capabilities by:
    • Participating in system/subsystem level software integration and test
    • Reviewing software work products (test procedures/results, anomaly reports) against the SDP and applicable PrOPs
    • Helping confirm configuration control of software baselines and adherence to approved change processes.

Systems & Integration QA

Supplier and Subcontractor Mission Assurance

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Culture

  • Help promote a safety first, quality driven culture emphasizing:
    • Proactive identification and management of technical blockers
    • Disciplined configuration control and data management
    • High integrity technical reviews and open communication across IPTs
  • Be willing and able to travel up to ~50% for design/test events, supplier reviews, on site inspections, and deployment/transition activities.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, or related STEM discipline with 2+ years of relevant experience in mission assurance, quality engineering, or software/hardware/system development/test
    – OR – Master’s degree in a related STEM discipline with 0+ years of experience
    (Additional relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.)
  • Experience in aerospace, defense, or other high reliability environment supporting at least one of:
    • Software or hardware development and/or integration & test
    • Mission assurance or quality engineering
    • Systems engineering or integration activities
  • Familiarity with systems and software engineering processes, including at least one of:
    • Agile development (Scrum, sprint/PI planning, JIRA)
    • Traditional development models (Waterfall, Spiral, V model)
  • Working knowledge of RCCA concepts, nonconformance handling, and basic issue/defect management.
  • Exposure to or familiarity with quality standards and process frameworks such as AS9100, ISO 9001, CMMI, or equivalent.

  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently (up to ~50%, including multi day trips to test sites, suppliers, and deployed locations).
  • Active U.S. DoD Secret security clearance at time of hire, with the ability to maintain that clearance as required by the program.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting or executing Mission Assurance, Quality Assurance, or related quality activities on a complex ground system or space program.
  • Hands on experience with one or more of the following tools or equivalents:
    • IBM Rational DOORS
    • Cameo or other MBSE tools
    • JIRA/Confluence
    • FRACAS / CAPA / DR systems and metrics
  • Experience supporting or participating in SEMP-driven processes:
    • Requirements development
    • Technical reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, SVR, etc.)

title: Out-of-Stock Buyer
description:
Your Mission:

As an Out-of-Stock Buyer on Inspiration's Fleet Operations team, your mission is to source, negotiate, and secure in-stock dealer vehicles that meet client specifications — on time, on spec, and at or below target cost. You will serve as the frontline expert in dealer network navigation, fleet incentive capture, and purchase documentation, playing a critical role in delivering a seamless vehicle acquisition experience for our clients. You will also support the factory order team with procurement activities, data entry, and vehicle follow-up, helping our operations scale efficiently as client demand grows.

You will report to: Senior Director, Acquisitions


Key Responsibilities:

Out-of-Stock Buyer - Vehicle Sourcing & Acquisition – 80% of your time will be:

  • Locating and securing in-stock dealer inventory that matches client-required make, model, trim, and option specifications, minimizing substitutions or costly reconfigurations downstream
  • Negotiating dealer purchase prices that protect fleet program margins and stay within client pricing expectations, including managing markups over invoice, holdback, and applicable incentives
  • Leveraging a broad dealer network — including dealer trades and locates — to expand available inventory and secure preferred pricing
  • Ensuring all applicable fleet incentives, fleet program eligibility, and manufacturer allowances are captured on every out-of-stock purchase
  • Coordinating vehicle follow-up and delivery confirmation, and completing all required system updates accurately and on time
  • Maintaining meticulous purchase documentation and ensuring titling, program eligibility, and compliance records are complete for every unit acquired

Factory Order Support – 15% of your time will be:

  • Providing coverage support to the factory order team as needed, including vehicle purchasing, data entry, status updates, and follow-up
  • Assisting with order expediting when needed to meet client timelines and deployment schedules

Data Management & Process Improvement – 5% of your time will be:

  • Maintaining accurate and up-to-date records across procurement databases, vehicle sourcing and purchase logs, delivery tracking systems, and e-file systems to ensure real-time visibility and audit-readiness
  • Analyzing acquisition data to identify pricing trends, sourcing inefficiencies, and cost-saving opportunities, and surfacing actionable insights to support faster cycle times and stronger program margins
  • Supporting continuous improvement by documenting procurement workflows, maintaining SOPs, and recommending process enhancements as the business scales

Who You Are:

  • You have at least 5 years of full-time professional experience purchasing vehicles from dealerships, with a deep understanding of dealer pricing structures, fleet incentives, and acquisition workflows
  • You are organized, detail-oriented, and skilled at managing and prioritizing numerous tasks simultaneously — without letting anything fall through the cracks
  • You have strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and you act with urgency when sourcing timelines demand it
  • You have excellent verbal and written communication skills, and can synthesize data into clear, well-structured emails, memos, and reports
  • You are a fast learner who embraces new tools and technology platforms to improve your day-to-day efficiency
  • Experience in fleet management, FMC operations, auction management, or dealership fleet sales is strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with productivity and fleet tools — including the Atlassian suite, BI platforms, and CRMs — is a plus
  • Our core values (see below) are part of your inherent DNA, and you have many examples of when you demonstrated these values in your career.


Salary: $75,000 – $95,000 + bonus eligible

Location: This role is remote eligible. However, we have an office in Washington, DC. Our in-office team works from our Dupont Circle office Tuesday through Thursday. Remote work on Mondays and Fridays is voluntary, and employees are welcome to work from the office if they'd prefer.


Why You’ll Love Working Here:

At Inspiration Mobility, you won’t just fill a role—you’ll help build the company. We’re a fast-growing, mission-driven team tackling real, complex challenges at the intersection of transportation, energy, technology, and finance. You’ll have the autonomy to take ownership, move quickly, and turn ideas into action, with leadership that values pragmatism, creativity, and momentum. We believe in clear accountability, low ego, and learning as we go—giving you the chance to shape how we operate, scale, and win, while doing work that has a meaningful impact on the future of mobility.


Our Core Values:

Inspiration’s culture is based on a shared respect for our core values described HERE. Fit with these values is a critical component of our hiring process, and employees are expected to demonstrate these behaviors in their interactions with colleagues, customers, and all stakeholders. An assessment of how each employee has exhibited our values is an important part of our performance review process.


Our Commitment to You:

We are committed to DEIB initiatives and to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

A shared commitment to integrity, accountability, collaboration and agility define our culture, and we strive to create exceptional value for our clients and shareholders and maintain AgriSompo North America as a desirable place to work.

Job Description

Sompo has a unique opportunity for a AgriSompo Senior Claims Auditor on our AgriSompo National Operations team.


As a Senior Crop Insurance Claims Auditor, you will deliver exceptional customer service to agents and producers by accurately and efficiently reviewing and processing medium to complex crop insurance claim files. You will serve as a subject matter expert in at least one area of claims auditing, providing guidance and expertise to support colleagues and ensure consistency and quality across all audit activities.


Location: This position will be remote and may be based in any of the following states: Texas, Oklahoma, Kansas, Missouri, New Mexico, Mississippi, Louisianna or Colorado. We strive for collaboration which is why we offer a work environment where our employees thrive and develop long lasting careers.


Our business, your impact, our opportunity:


What you’ll be doing:

  • Audit and process claims timely and accurately in order to meet quality production standards.
  • Communicate with underwriters, adjusters, agents, and producers to ensure timely resolution of claim-related issues.
  • Work independently and with a team to identify problems, determine solutions and recommend appropriate communication of resolution.

  • Ensure compliance with Federal, State, and internal policies and procedures in all claim activities.
  • Exhibit auditing proficiency in all levels of Crop Claim types and ability to process moderate to advance level claims.
  • Research and resolve complex claims issues with limited supervision while maintaining accuracy and consistency.

What you’ll bring:

  • Preferred minimum of 5 years of crop insurance experience preferred.
  • Proven experience in crop insurance claims auditing and processing preferred.
  • Knowledge of and ability to understand Federal Crop Insurance Corporation (FCIC) policies and company policies, procedures, and related software.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and general technical/computer systems.
  • Effective interpersonal, oral, written, and communication skills with the ability to interact with internal and external customers.

​

Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Ability to stand or sit constantly/continuously.

title: Lead Fraud Strategy Data Scientist
description:

  • Leverages analytics and statistics knowledge to determine risk and recommend plans.

About Vanguard

To work for the long-term financial wellbeing of our clients. To lead through product and services that transform our clients' lives. To learn and develop our skills as individuals and as a team. From Malvern to Melbourne, our mission drives us forward and inspires us to be our best.

title: Kotisiivooja - Espoo
description:
Hei sinä aktiivinen ja elämäniloinen työnhakija!

Oletko kiinnostunut tekemään merkityksellistä työtä ikäihmisten parissa? Liity iloiseen tiimiimme ja hae meille töihin.

Haemme nyt tiimiimme Kotisiivoojia palvelemaan asiakkaitamme Espoon alueella. Tehtävänäsi on toimia ikäihmisen tai vammaisen siivoojana ja huolehtia kodinhoitajana hänen kotinsa siisteydestä luotettavasti ja vastuullisesti.

Kotisiivoojan työ sopii monenlaisissa elämäntilanteissa oleville, sillä voit itse vaikuttaa siihen, mitä työvuoroja otat vastaan. Voit olla eläkeläinen, opiskelija, alan ammattilainen tai jotain siltä väliltä. Saat meiltä kattavan perehdytyksen sekä koulutuksen tehtävään ja esihenkilösi on aina tavoitettavissa.

Tarjoamme:

  • Kiireettömän, vastuullisen ja merkityksellisen työn

  • Lämminhenkisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön

  • Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa työvuoroihin

  • Hyvän perehdytyksen

  • Kilpailukykyinen palkka 15€ /h

Odotamme sinulta:

  • Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

  • Hyviä sosiaalisia taitoja

  • Positiivista asennetta

Eduksi katsomme siivousalan koulutuksen.

Edellytämme lisäksi työnhakijalta pitkäaikaista sitoutumista tehtävään, sillä meillä käy asiakkaan luona aina sama työntekijä, jolloin myös itse työ on tuttua ja turvallista niin asiakkaalle kuin työntekijällekin. Samalla turvaamme palvelun laadun ja jatkuvuuden.

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan osa-aikaisena. Työ sopii hyvin myös reippaalle eläkeläiselle, joka haluaa lisää mielekästä ja vastuullista tekemistä omaan arkeensa.

Tarkistamme valittujen rikosrekisteriotteet Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvontalain mukaisesti.

Palkkaus määräytyy tehtävän vaativuuden mukaan ja on 15 €/h, jonka lisäksi maksetaan yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät. Olemme vastuullinen työnantaja ja meillä kaikki työntekijät ovat työsuhteessa. Kerrytät työssäsi normaalisti eläkettä ja olet luonnollisesti oikeutettu myös lomakorvauksiin.

Lisätietoa tehtävästä antaa maanantaisin ja torstaisin klo. 9-14 välillä HR-koordinaattori Tiia Sjöholm, 050 349 4233 sekä sähköpostitse tiia.sjoholm@suomenseniorihoiva.fi

Mikäli välität aidosti ikäihmisistä ja haluat liittyä iloiseen tiimiimme, hae rohkeasti paikkaa viimeistään 31.10.2026 mennessä urasivujemme kautta osoitteessa . Toimi nopeasti, sillä paikkoja täytetään jo hakuaikana.

Suomen Seniorihoiva Oy on täysin kotimainen hoiva-alan kasvuyritys, jonka tehtävänä on rikastaa senioreiden elämää. Yritys on perustettu vuonna 2013 ja se toimii kaikkialla Suomessa työllistäen noin 700 hoiva-alan ammattilaisia. title: Leasing Professional - Skymor Sanford
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for coordinating the community’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals by performing all activities related to leasing to new residents, providing resident satisfaction throughout the term of the lease, and securing resident lease renewals.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Property Type: Single Family

Stage: Lease Up

Unit Count: 84

Schedule: Monday-Friday + rotating weekends

Essential Responsibilities:
• Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting community tours and showing apartments, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
• Inspects apartments prior to resident move-in and ensures apartments are in move-in ready condition and schedules any outstanding item to be addressed with the maintenance team.
• Stays informed about current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the community’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy.
• Designs and executes marketing activities to create and drive traffic to the community, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools (Craigslist, Facebook, e-mail, and other websites), and following other community-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.
• Uses the on-site property management software (OneSite, Yardi, etc.) to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, and capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents.
• Ensures that the community and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the marketing corridor and leasing tour, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the community’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities.
• Follows-up with prospects and new residents to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew.
• Executes and performs activities in support of the community’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time.
• Responds quickly and courteously to resident and client/owner concerns and questions, and takes prompt action to solve problems and/or document and convey resident or other requests to the appropriate individual(s).

Required Licenses or Certifications:
• Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions

• Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to operate a golf cart on property.

Physical Demands:

  • Incumbents need to be able to stand, walk, and/or sit for extended periods of time and bend, stoop, climb ladders, reach, carry objects, and crawl in confined areas.
  • Incumbents must be able to work inside and outside in all weather conditions (rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, sleet).
  • Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty-five (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance.
  • Rare or regular travel may be required to assist other properties as needed, attend training classes, business meetings, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
  • Incumbents must be able to work a flexible work schedule, which includes taking “call” during evenings, weekends and holidays.

title: Research Associate - School of Computer Science - LTI

The Language Technologies Institute (LTI) at Carnegie Mellon University is a world-renowned research and education hub at the forefront of natural language processing, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and human-computer interaction. Established within the School of Computer Science, LTI pioneers innovative approaches to understanding, processing, and generating human language in both written and spoken forms.

LTI is seeking a Research Associate to join the team! The researcher will contribute to a multidisciplinary project investigating multimodal fusion, team dynamics, and team effectiveness. Responsibilities include designing and running experiments on multimodal data, analyzing results, developing and evaluating fusion approaches, and contributing to scientific publications. This role will also participate in meetings with project sponsors and collaborators, communicate research progress, and prepare technical presentations and project slides. The position requires strong research and analytical skills, experience with machine learning and multimodal data, and the ability to work effectively as part of a collaborative research team.

Core Responsibilities

  • Uses a variety of software packages to input, manipulate, collect and record results or observations.
  • Performs research experiments following experimental protocol and procedures. Researches and documents information by compiling and maintaining accurate and detailed records.

Adaptability, excellence, and passion are vital qualities within Carnegie Mellon University. title: Senior Engineer, HR Data Analytics
description:
Job Description :

Sr Engineer, HR Data & Analytics

Job Title: Sr Engineer, HR Data & Analytics

Department: General HR / HR Operations

Employee Type: Full Time

Location: Bangalore

Reports To: Sr Director, HR Data & Analytics

Direct Reports: None

Budget Holder: No

Operational Scope: Global

About News Corp: News Corp seeks to hire individuals who work well in a team-driven working group, are highly motivated, intelligent, have sound judgment and have demonstrated excellence in prior endeavors. We seek candidates with good problem solving skills. The ability to problem solve through problem identification (what is the problem), solution assessment (what can be done), problem documentation (document for future) and problem response (implementing a solution). News Corp is a global diversified media and information services company focused on creating and distributing authoritative and engaging content to consumers and businesses throughout the world. The company comprises businesses across a range of media, including: news and information services, book publishing, and digital real estate services.

About the team:

The HR Data & Analytics team serves as the central engine for people intelligence across the global News Corp network. We translate complex workforce data into actionable, strategic insights for a diverse group of stakeholders—including business units, regional HR teams, functional leaders, and executive suites.

We are a collaborative team of data storytellers, engineers, and analysts who own the end-to-end data lifecycle. Collectively, our expertise spans:

● Global Insights & Reporting: Empowering regional and global stakeholders with accurate, scalable, and on-demand self-service reporting.

● Advanced Analytics: Moving beyond simple metrics to deliver descriptive and inferential statistics, predictive modeling, and time-series analyses that forecast workforce trends.

● Data Visualization: Transforming complex data structures into intuitive, high-impact dashboards that drive executive decision-making.

● Data Governance & Security: Championing HR Master Data Management (MDM) to ensure the highest standards of data integrity, compliance, and security.

● Continuous Innovation: Keeping our pulse on the market to evaluate and adopt cutting-edge analytics tools and emerging methodologies.

About the role:

As the Senior Analytics Engineer, you will serve as the strategic architect of our data ecosystem. You won’t just build data models; you will design the foundational framework that enables advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI capabilities across the organization. This role requires a blend of deep technical mastery in data modeling, strategic foresight, and the ability to bridge the gap between raw data engineering and cutting-edge AI initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

● Strategic Architecture: Design, scale, and optimize the core HR data warehouse architecture to support enterprise-wide business intelligence, workforce analytics, AI, and machine learning workloads.

● AI & ML Enablement: Partner with Data Science, AI, and HR technology teams to prepare clean training datasets, feature-ready data models, and governed pipelines that support predictive models, LLM applications, and chatbot-based analytics use cases.

● Advanced Data Modeling: Define and implement robust, reusable, and privacy-aware data models using engineering best practices, including version control, CI/CD, automated testing, documentation, and code review.

● Governance, Security & Privacy: Establish frameworks for data governance, quality metrics, lineage, access controls, auditability, and security compliance across all analytics layers, with a strong focus on sensitive HR and employee data.

● Sensitive Data Protection: Design analytics solutions that protect PII and sensitive employee attributes through encryption, masking, tokenization, pseudonymization, row-level security, column-level security, and controlled aggregation.

● Dashboarding & Data Products: Build and support trusted dashboards, curated datasets, and self-service analytics products for HR and business stakeholders, preferably using Tableau or similar visualization platforms.

● Mentorship & Leadership: Act as a technical mentor to junior engineers, championing high standards for code quality, documentation, data modeling, system design, and secure development practices.

Qualifications:

● 5+ years of experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence Engineering, or a similar role, preferably in People Analytics, HR data, or another sensitive data environment.

● Expert-level proficiency with modern cloud data warehouses such as Google BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar platforms, with advanced SQL and strong data modeling skills.

● Hands-on experience with dbt, git workflows, automated testing, and data orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

● Strong understanding of data security principles, including encryption at rest and in transit, cloud KMS, IAM, service accounts, secrets management, key rotation, and secure data-sharing patterns.

● Experience working with PII or sensitive employee data, including practical knowledge of masking, tokenization, pseudonymization, row-level security, column-level security, or controlled aggregation.

● Working knowledge of CI/CD practices, deployment workflows, environment management, and containers such as Docker.

● Exposure to AI/ML, LLM, or chatbot-related data use cases, with Python proficiency highly preferred.

● Experience building dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics products for business users, preferably using Tableau or similar BI tools.

● Deep understanding of HR functions and how data structures, systems, definitions, and processes differ across domains such as workforce, recruiting, compensation, benefits, performance, employee relations, learning, and talent management.

● Experience working with contemporary HR technology platforms is preferred, such as Workday, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise systems.

● Ability to plan and execute complex projects, prioritize competing demands across individual and team responsibilities, and communicate effectively with cross-functional business and technical stakeholders.

● Strong systems thinking and the ability to influence stakeholders while maintaining high standards for data quality, security, documentation, and governance.

Good to Have:

● Experience with semantic layer or metrics layer tools such as dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, or MetricFlow to standardize business definitions and enable consistent self-service analytics.


Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic.


Reasonable Accommodation

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application or participating in an interview due to a disability, email us at humanresources@newscorp.com. Please put "Reasonable Accommodation" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. This inbox will not be monitored for application status updates.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist

Location - Scottish Power HQ, Glasgow (Flexible/Hybrid options available)

Salary + benefits - £55,000 - £68,750 per annum, plus performance bonus, pension scheme (company contribution up to 10%), and Private Medical Insurance

Closing date - 16th September 2026

Help us create a better future, quicker

Are you ready to shape the future of performance reporting and insight across Customer Service? As Data Scientist at ScottishPower, you'll manage a talented team delivering reliable reporting, data insights and evidence-based recommendations that drive measurable improvement across the Directorate. This is a unique opportunity to combine technical expertise with strategic thinking, providing the single source of truth that enables better outcomes, improved customer experiences and operational excellence. You'll work at the intersection of data and action, translating complex information into clear recommendations that influence senior stakeholders and deliver tangible results. If you're passionate about using data to make a real difference, this role offers the platform to innovate and drive meaningful change.

What you'll be doing

You'll manage the Customer Service data team, setting priorities, coordinating workload and developing capability across your team. Your focus will be delivering accurate, timely and meaningful reporting and insight that provides a reliable view of performance across Customer Service, enabling operational control, customer outcomes, regulatory obligations and strategic planning.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across Customer Service and wider business functions, you'll act as a key adviser, ensuring reporting and insight translate directly into action. You'll design and develop intuitive dashboards, scorecards and KPI reporting using modern tools, ensuring outputs are focused on the outcomes they enable.

Providing oversight for regulatory, executive and external reporting is a key accountability. You'll maintain clear definitions, ownership and controls, ensuring performance information is accurate, consistent and reliable. As the technical specialist, you'll set standards across reporting and business intelligence, establishing quality assurance methodologies and acting as the escalation point for complex issues.

You'll interrogate complex datasets to identify trends, root causes, risks and opportunities, converting findings into evidence-based recommendations that improve customer outcomes and operational efficiency. During major incidents, storms and business-critical events, you'll coordinate the provision of timely support, ensuring senior staff have access to clear, accurate real-time information for effective planning.

Representing Performance, Reporting & Insight on high-profile and business-critical projects, you'll define data and reporting requirements early, test assumptions and embed data-informed thinking throughout delivery. You'll drive innovation by promoting modern reporting approaches, automation and effective data visualisation, reducing manual effort while maintaining governance and control.

What you'll bring

You'll bring significant experience in a senior data, reporting, business intelligence or insight role, with proven capability managing people, projects or complex workstreams. Your track record demonstrates your ability to manage a data team, set priorities, coordinate demand, assure quality and develop others effectively.

Your advanced capability enables you to interrogate complex datasets, identify trends and root causes, and translate evidence into clear recommendations. You possess expert Excel skills and strong experience developing dashboards, visualisations and reporting solutions using Tableau, Power BI or comparable tools. Practical experience of data querying, transformation and automation using tools such as SQL, Power Query, R or Python is essential.

You have a strong grasp of data structures, KPI design, reporting methodologies, data quality and governance, with the judgement to apply proportionate controls. Your business partnering skills are demonstrable, with the ability to grasp operational, customer and regulatory context rather than work with data in isolation.

Experience presenting complex findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders is essential, as is your ability to influence outcomes through concise, evidence-based communication. You have a track record of using reporting and insight to improve performance, customer outcomes or operational efficiency, including measuring whether changes delivered the expected benefit.

A degree in Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Analytics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, completes your profile.

What's in it for you

As well as an attractive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we'll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.

At ScottishPower, we believe it's the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family's wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action -- our benefits are designed to help you do just that - so that you have everything you need to take care of your world -- today and tomorrow. That's why our benefits include:

  • 36 days annual leave
  • Holiday Purchase - perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave
  • Equity Plans
  • Payroll Giving and Charity Matched Funding
  • Technology Vouchers - save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases
  • Electric Vehicle Schemes - to help you transition to green/clean driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme and Public Transport Season Ticket Loans
  • Healthcare benefit options including: Dental Insurance, Private Medical Insurance, Health Cash Plan and annual Health Assessments
  • Life Assurance (4x salary)
  • Access to Savesmart financial wellbeing assistance
  • Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more

Why SP Energy Networks

SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world's largest integrated utility companies and a world pioneer in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make-up the transmission network - infrastructure like wind farms into the electricity system. It's a role that puts us right at the heart of Scotland's goal to be Net Zero by 2044. And we're taking it very seriously. We're investing >£5.5 billion into our transmission network, directly enabling the rapid growth needed in renewable energy. With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a focus on investing in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation.

Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Combined with our values, they bring us into a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. It takes all backgrounds of people to build a large-scale business like ours, so whatever your background, you'll fit right in.

We are dedicated to providing reasonable adjustments in our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long term conditions, mental health conditions, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy-related accommodations. If you need assistance, please reach out to careers@scottishpower.com.

Mobility

Do you want to develop training that will transform the United States Army? As an instructional designer and developer, you know that even the best tools and processes can’t have an impact without the right education. Constructing an interactive course that teaches critical information requires a real passion for understanding the needs of your customer. Job Description:

This position plays a key role in maintaining accurate inventory records and supporting daily warehouse, production, and aftermarket operations. The role is responsible for cycle counting, inventory transactions, discrepancy resolution, and identifying process improvements to improve accuracy, efficiency, and cost control. This position will work closely with Distribution, Purchasing, Customer Service, and management to ensure inventory data and reporting support business needs.   • Track rates of accuracy, purchase and return as well as defective items to inform quality control decisions

  • Prepare, generate, and file financial inventory reports; review reports monthly with management

  • Proposes strategies to reduce costs and improve procedures of supply chain logistics

  • Ensure all daily inventory transactions are accurately and promptly enter data into TMS (oracle) and maintain records.

  • Generate monthly cycle count report to include total items, pieces, dollars counted, and all adjustments.

  • Monitor inventory transactions to develop and/or recommend improvements in inventory procedures and work instructions.

  • Reviews, monitors, investigates, and reports on inventory that is on hold, in Quality NCR area, and RGA area.

  • Works with Distribution, Purchasing, and Customer Service to help with inventory variances.

  • Provides locator set up function in TMS (Oracle) for incoming items that do not have a location assigned and new item set up in Item Master

  • High school diploma

title: Youth & Family Development Associate
description:
Department: Youth Prevention and Intervention

Program: Youth Development Academy

Status: Full-time, non-exempt

Hourly rate: $25 per hour

Location: East Mesa Juvenile Detention Facility

Schedule: Schedule may include Saturdays and evening hours up to 8 p.m. and as needed for staff coverage.


Who we are

SBCS (formerly South Bay Community Services) transforms communities to support the well-being and prosperity of children, youth, and families. For more than 50 years, we’ve worked throughout San Diego to provide safe shelter, transitional housing, intervention prevention programs, mental health support, and many other services that meet the ever-changing needs of our communities.


Our organization is dedicated to offering high-quality services and ensuring all services align with the community's needs. To best serve our communities, SBCS partners with various grassroots organizations throughout California to develop innovative strategies that enhance services, empower clients, and ensure that culturally appropriate and trauma-informed care is offered. SBCS provides a wide range of services tailored to meet each client's unique needs. At SBCS, our client-centered approach highlights the importance of respect, empathy, and compassion when interacting with all community members.


As a mission-driven organization, our work is centered around providing exceptional, face-to-face support to our clients and community members in order to foster trust, accessibility and personal connection that are critical to our mission.


About YOU

You are an advocate and champion of nurturing communities where families can pursue their dreams and fulfill their potential.

You are dedicated to and energized by engaging directly with individuals and communities.


You care deeply about the well-being and prosperity of ALL children and youth throughout San Diego.


You want to become a part of an energetic and effective team, and contribute your expertise, creativity, and insights to a unique role encompassing program management, development, and direct counseling services for at-risk children, adolescents, and families.


About our organization

SBCS is home to a committed team of 470 dedicated employees and volunteers who diligently serve all of San Diego County. Having offered services for 52 years, SBCS is committed to providing hope and support for numerous young children, individuals, and families facing adversity. With an annual budget of $68 million, SBCS continues to be a beacon of assistance in the community.


Competitive and Sustainable Employee Pay Package:

SBCS offers competitive pay and additional benefits for full-time employees, including generous vacation time, holidays, health, vision, dental, flexible spending accounts, an employee assistance program, discount programs, public service forgiveness loan, and an excellent retirement plan with matching contributions.


Program

SBCS’ Youth Development Academy (YDA) is a partnership with San Diego County Probation Department to provide evidence informed, pro-social, and developmentally appropriate programming to youth in custody at East Mesa Juvenile Detention Facility. This program serves youth ages 14- to 24-years old who have been committed to long-term sentences for serious felony offenses. The Youth Development Academy uses a trauma-informed, positive youth development model to support the youth and families we serve while in custody, and as they transition back to the community.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Reporting directly to the Program Coordinator, the Youth & Family Development Associate (YFDA) will work closely with the Coordinator to provide assessment driven, strength-based treatment plans to guide their treatment while in custody and upon release from custody. The YFDA will be responsible for collaborating with the other members of the youth team, including Probation Officer, Behavior Health Clinician, and service providers to inform his/her/their treatment. The YFDA will also be responsible for engaging the youth’s family and/or supports both in the facility and the community through home visits. Services will be in keeping with agency goals, objectives, mission, and style and provided within a team framework. Associates are responsible for working with the team in developing team goals and objectives and in meeting those goals and objectives, including but not limited to:


Responsibilities:

  • Provide case management services to youth sentenced to YDA for committing a serious felony offense.
  • Complete comprehensive assessments, as determined appropriate.
  • Develop strength-based, individualized service plans for each youth residing in YDA.
  • Provide quality trauma-informed and Positive Youth Development principles to participants. Nurture a therapeutic environment through interactions with the youth and partners in the facility.
  • Collaborate with multiple professionals (e.g., job navigator, reentry specialist, Probation Officer) to develop and implement service plan.
  • Provide ongoing support and supervision of youth participating in programs.
  • Conduct weekly one-on-one coaching and service planning meetings with youth while in custody.
  • Identify services, resources, job, and school supports for youth upon release and help facilitate enrollment.
  • Provide access to reentry case manager for youth and family for six-months post-release.
  • Maintain case records and client files in the Efforts to Outcomes (ETO) database as required by SBCS and Probation.
  • Provide safe, secure transportation to clients upon their release.
  • Provide crisis intervention to clients as needed.
  • Facilitate evidence-based groups as needed and appropriate.
  • Completion of reports, and communication with colleagues regarding shift updates and other required documents in a timely manner.
  • Provide job placement assistance to eligible youth.
  • Upon release, provide advocacy and referrals to community resources based on clients’ needs.
  • Develop and maintain outreach and linkages to appropriate services in the community.
  • Attend all agency required meetings and training.
  • As other duties assigned.

title: Sr. Product Manager Technical, Amazon Connect Customer
description:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Amazon Connect is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch, Amazon Connect has become an AI leader, transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

Amazon Connect Customer is an AI-native customer experience foundation that enables businesses to deliver engaging, dynamic, and personal customer service experiences. With Amazon Connect Customer, businesses deploy intelligent self-service across voice and digital channels that understands natural language, reasons across knowledge sources, and takes action on behalf of customers. Amazon Connect Customer leverages agentic AI across AWS and Amazon services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Lex, Amazon Polly, and Amazon Transcribe to deliver sub-second voice latency, human-like conversational quality, and self-healing intelligence that detects where AI fails and continuously improves. With this technology, we are transforming the way customers interact with businesses and how agents service them. A key part of this role is owning the agentic foundations and runtime orchestration that enable customers to build, manage, deploy, and improve AI agents across these workloads and broader Amazon Connect Customer.

We have a rapidly growing customer base and an exciting charter in front of us that includes solving highly complex engineering and algorithmic problems while designing beautiful, simple user experiences. We are looking for a passionate, talented, and experienced Product Manager to join Amazon Connect Customer's agentic customer experience team, responsible for the capabilities that help companies deliver agentic experiences at scale across all personas. You will play a crucial role in developing the next generation of generative AI infused agent, supervisor, and end-customer experience capabilities, and have the opportunity to design and deliver high-scale, resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus. As a Product Manager on our team, you will drive strategic initiatives from conception through completion. You will work cross-functionally across teams to solve challenging problems using the latest technologies. You will make data-driven, customer-obsessed decisions and work with leadership across AWS to prioritize your programs.

The position is a rare opportunity to join a fast-growing business of applied AI and help shape the technology and product as we grow. You will play a crucial role in developing the next generation of AWS application services and have the opportunity to design and deliver high-scale, resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus.

Key job responsibilities
- Engage with customers to work backwards from their goals and challenges to define a product vision, including future roadmap, investment, innovation and experimentation
- Influence senior leaders across AWS and communicate your product vision, strategy, goals, status, and customer impact
- Build a roadmap and define features that delight our customers, drive adoption, and increase utilization of our services
- Collaborate with engineering to build new capabilities and source customers for early adoption, beta testing and launch partners
- Launch and promote new capabilities, in collaboration with product marketing
- Deliver compelling presentations, product demos, technical blogs, and discussions to drive adoption of communication offerings

A day in the life
- You like working directly with all levels and types of customers, from CxO to individual contributors and engineers to business people, to solve their most complicated problems through software.
- You enjoy being on a team that fosters a collaborative environment as we work towards common goals.
- You are a passionate learner and are motivated to take on new and, often times, ambiguous challenges.
- You are able to lead and partner with a variety stakeholders to identify and prioritize the right problems to solve and solutions to develop.
- You are comfortable and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
- If you’re entrepreneurial and want to build and own transformative technology-driven products, join us in making history.

About the team
ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Analyst, Sustainable Business & FS (FTC-12 Months)
description:
About CDP:

CDP is a global non-profit that runs the world’s only independent environmental disclosure system. As the founder of environmental reporting, we believe in transparency and the power of data to drive change.

Partnering with leaders in enterprise, capital, policy and science, we surface the information needed to enable Earth-positive decisions. We helped more than 24,800 companies and almost 1,000 cities, states and regions disclose their environmental impacts in 2024. Financial institutions with more than a quarter of the world’s institutional assets use CDP data to help inform investment and lending decisions.

Our team is truly global, united by our shared desire to build a world where people, planet and profit are balanced. Visit cdp.net or follow us @CDP to find out more.

About the Team:

Thought Leadership provides the environmental expertise that drives the evolution of CDP’s disclosure system and its impact. The team leads research and analysis of CDP data and other sources to generate insights that inform decisions across business, finance, and policy. Thought Leadership represents CDP in key stakeholder engagements and expert fora, spearheading strategic partnerships and projects, and contributing actively to the development and application of environmental science, standards, and frameworks.

The Sustainable Business team delivers CDPs thought leadership relating to the development of corporate and financial sustainable business practices. This involves leading the development of CDP’s approach to sustainable finance, resource management and circular economy, sectors, SMEs and other key business perspectives, and deploying the insights generated by the data to drive impact according to CDPs theory of change.

About this role:

This role will work collaboratively with colleagues across CDP, as well as key external stakeholders, to inform the development of insights using CDP data. This includes leading analysis with partners to assess the state of investor climate action. The role will suit someone with strong research, analysis and project management skills, with experience communicating their findings to a range of audiences, including the private sector.

What you will do:

• Supporting coordination with external partners and teams across the organization to develop insights on financial sector transition planning

• Conducting data analysis using outputs from CDP’s questionnaire, to inform collaborative research and shape external recommendations.

• Supporting the development and execution of CDP’s insights and sustainable finance research through project coordination, research & analysis, and preparing and giving webinars where appropriate.

• Collaborating on projects and initiatives both within and outside of CDP.

• Conducting research to support the drafting of position papers.

• Supporting ad-hoc requests for insights and analysis when required.

Actively contribute to an effective and engaged team, clear on its purpose and contribution, by:

• Ensuring you know what is expected of you, through regular 1:1’s, having clear objectives in place, and participating in open and honest performance and development conversations.

• Ensuring a respectful and inclusive workplace, where team members communicate openly, share knowledge so it can be used, and respect difference.

• Living the CDP Values and demonstrating the behaviours appropriate to your position.

Internal stakeholders include: Thought Leadership, Data, Policy

External stakeholders include: Investor Agenda (Ceres, IIGCC, AIGCC, PRI, UNEP-FI).

We're looking for:

• Experience with environmental data, disclosures and/or transition planning, especially where this relates to preparation and use by the financial sector.

• Background in environment, GHG and/or financial accounting and current issues related with these disciplines, and the ability and willingness to rapidly develop a high level of knowledge.

• Data analysis experience and proficiency with Excel and PowerBI, Python or R desirable; GIS proficiency a plus.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including a high standard of written English, with previous experience of producing written research outputs; preferably for a corporate audience.

• An understanding of the corporate reporting landscape and investor expectations around climate and nature-related issues.

• Ability to present complex information in a simple and concise way.

• Detail-oriented and organized thinker who can juggle multiple, competing priorities.

• A self-starter willing to take ownership and develop processes to improve the overall delivery of analysis and research.

Salary and benefits: The salary banding for this role is £32,157 - £40,197/year, 30 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, generous non-contributory pension provision, Employee Assistance Programme, life assurance, training and development, flexible working opportunities and other benefits.

Final offer amount depends on multiple factors such as candidates experience and expertise, geographic location, total compensation, and market data.

This is a Fixed Term role (12 Months) based at CDP’s London office. Interested applicants must be eligible to work legally in the UK and live within a commutable distance of the London office and be comfortable with 2 days in the office per week. We cannot sponsor this role.

We’ll only use the information you provide to process your application. For more details on how we use your information, see our applicant’s privacy notice. By uploading your CV and covering letter, you are permitting CDP to use the information you have provided for recruitment purposes.

Please upload your CV in English via the application form.

description:

title: Senior Software Engineer ID87667
description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help define an agentic-first approach to software development. This person designs agentic workflows using Java, Spring Boot, React, and AI orchestration patterns, turning successful experiments into production systems. Strong judgment around security, reliability, and auditability matters for enterprise customers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Design and build agentic workflows that coordinate tools, services, data, and human approvals.
- Develop reusable patterns for agent orchestration, tool use, context management, memory, and multi-agent collaboration.
- Use agentic coding tools throughout the development lifecycle, including planning, implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, code review, and documentation.
- Integrate agents into software development, testing, deployment, support, and operational workflows.
- Establish standards for agent evaluation, observability, reliability, security, and governance.
- Prototype new agentic capabilities and turn successful experiments into production systems.
- Build complete, usable products—not just demonstrations or isolated model integrations.
- Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and product delivery through agentic development.
- Mentor engineers and help shape an agentic-first technical strategy across the organization.
- Collaborate with product and engineering leaders to connect agentic capabilities to meaningful outcomes.
- Design agentic applications around real user needs, including intuitive experiences, reliable workflows, permissions, audit trails, and meaningful error handling.
- Move agentic solutions from prototype to production by addressing performance, scalability, security, monitoring, evaluation, cost, and ongoing maintenance.

MUST HAVES
- 5+ years of experience in a software product development environment.
- Strong proficiency with Java and Spring Boot.
- Strong proficiency with JavaScript and React.
- Strong proficiency with Relational Databases.
- Hands-on experience building AI agents, tool-using LLM applications, or orchestrated workflows.
- Experience with multi-agent systems, RAG, vector search, agent evaluation, or human-in-the-loop workflows.
- Demonstrated ability to use AI coding agents as productive engineering collaborators across an application codebase.
- Ability to provide agents with clear context, constraints, architecture, acceptance criteria, and technical direction.
- Strong judgment in reviewing, testing, securing, and improving agent-generated code rather than accepting outputs without verification.
- Ability to decompose complex application work into agent-ready tasks while maintaining architectural consistency and product intent.
- Experience creating workflows in which agents can reason, select tools, call APIs, manage state, recover from failures, and escalate to people when appropriate.
- Senior-level experience building and operating production software systems.
- Experience using agents to support coding, code review, testing, release management, or incident response.
- Experience with TypeScript.
- Experience with Python.
- Experience with RESTful APIs.
- Experience with infrastructure on AWS.
- Experience with APIs, workflow engines, event-driven architectures, integrations, or distributed systems.
- Strong understanding of testing, observability, security, permissions, and failure recovery.
- Ability to turn ambiguous opportunities into practical, reliable technical solutions.
- A product mindset: the ability to understand a problem deeply, make appropriate tradeoffs, and deliver a complete solution that customers can depend on.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to influence engineering practices across a team.
- Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Experience building enterprise SaaS or multi-tenant systems.
- Familiarity with higher education technology and its privacy and compliance requirements.
- Experience leading technical transformation or introducing new engineering practices.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
- Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

Meet Our Recruitment Process
Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Hiring Manager Interview
Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit.
If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.

title: Complex Needs Practitioner- Transitions (Birmingham)
description:
Complex Needs Practitioner

Location: Birmingham
Working Hours: 22.5 hours (part time)
Contract Type: Permanent
Salary: £27,751.12 - £29,944.50 (pro rata)

Make a Difference at a Pivotal Time in a Young Person’s Life

Are you passionate about supporting young people to overcome challenges, build resilience and achieve positive change?

We’re looking for an energetic, confident and motivated Complex Needs Practitioner to join our Transitions Team in Birmingham, supporting young people aged 17–25 who may be experiencing substance misuse, mental health difficulties and a range of other complex needs.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a team where your work can make a genuine difference to young people as they navigate important transitions in their lives.

About the Role

As a Complex Needs Practitioner, you will work alongside young people using a person-centred and strengths-based approach, helping them to identify their goals, reduce risk and develop the skills and resilience they need to move towards positive outcomes.

You will support young people who may be experiencing multiple risk factors alongside substance use, including those who have been affected by a parent’s substance misuse.

Working as part of the Transitions Team, you will build trusting relationships with young people and provide a range of interventions tailored to their individual needs. You’ll work flexibly across the community and within multi-agency partnership settings, responding to referrals from a variety of services including health, social care, education and criminal justice.

Your work could include supporting young people with:

  • Substance misuse and reducing associated risks

  • Mental and emotional health

  • Homelessness and housing instability

  • Family relationships and family work

  • Exploitation and vulnerability

  • Physical health and wellbeing

  • Education, social care and wider support needs

  • Building resilience, independence and positive support networks

No two days will be the same, and you'll have the opportunity to work creatively with young people, families and partner agencies to find solutions that work for each individual.

About You

We’re looking for someone who is positive, resilient and confident, with the ability to build strong and meaningful relationships with young people who may have multiple and complex needs.

You’ll be an enthusiastic self-starter who is comfortable working independently while also being a collaborative member of a wider team.

You will have proven experience within health or social care, ideally including experience of working with young people and supporting individuals experiencing mental ill health and/or substance misuse.

Most importantly, you’ll bring empathy, energy and a genuine belief in the potential of young people to make positive changes in their lives.

Please note: The salary listed reflects the full earning potential for this role. Starting salaries depend on experience and progression within the band.

About Waythrough

Waythrough was formed in 2024 following the merger of Humankind and Richmond Fellowship. Together, we’ve created one of the largest mental health and social support charities in England.

Every year, we support around 125,000 people through nearly 200 services – and it’s all made possible by our 3,500 brilliant staff and volunteers.

Make a real difference in your community

Are you passionate about helping others live safer, healthier, more independent lives? Join our team at Waythrough and support people facing challenges around mental health, substance use, housing or domestic abuse. This is more than just a job – it’s a chance to build meaningful relationships and create lasting change.

What We Offer

We value the people who make a difference every day. Alongside meaningful work, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package:

  • 27 days’ annual leave, rising to 32 after 1 year (plus bank holidays)

  • Pension scheme with 4.5% employer contribution, matched up to 6.5%

  • Life assurance (3× annual salary)

  • Enhanced sick pay and family-friendly pay

  • Birthday leave and the option to buy up to 5 extra days’ annual leave

  • Professional fee reimbursement for relevant qualifications

  • 24/7 online GP access and Employee Assistance Programme

  • Recognition and long service awards via our Way to Go and Aspirations portals

  • £500 Recommend a Friend bonus

  • Cycle to Work scheme and Credit Union membership

  • Discounts via Blue Light Card, Charity Discounts, Extras and Tickets for Good

  • Free will writing service and wellbeing initiatives throughout the year

Inclusion and accessibility

Waythrough is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and communities, especially those with lived experience of the issues we support.

We have signed up to the Disability Confident Scheme - all applicants are welcome, and adjustments can be made to enable fair participation.

If you need adjustments or support to apply, please email our recruitment team: recruitmentteam@waythrough.org.uk

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
StraitSys Inc

Regular

The Senior Business Analyst leads enterprise-level analysis efforts by facilitating discovery sessions, defining complex requirements, and aligning stakeholders around clear, actionable solutions. This role drives the development and refinement of policies, procedures, and governance documents while performing in-depth research to support decision-making and compliance needs. The Senior BA manages cross-functional communication, ensures rigorous follow-up and follow-through on open items, and serves as the primary translator between business strategy and technical execution.   • Lead enterprise-level requirements gathering, discovery workshops, and process mapping.

  • Own the development and maintenance of policies, procedures, governance documents, and compliance-aligned artifacts.

  • Conduct deep-dive research on regulatory requirements, industry practices, vendor capabilities, and system impacts.

  • Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and data mappings.

  • Manage issue logs, follow-ups, and action items for cross-functional teams, ensuring resolution and accountability.

  • Serve as a strategic liaison between stakeholders and technical teams, facilitating communication and solution alignment.

  • Perform impact assessments, risk identification, and recommendations for process or system improvements.

  • Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in documentation, requirements, and research methods.

None

  • Familiarity with workflow automation, integration platforms and Agile toolsets (GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jira).

  • 5–8+ years of experience leading business analysis efforts for enterprise systems or multi-department initiatives.

  • Strong analytical and research capabilities; able to break down complex issues and provide clear recommendations.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to guide, clarify, and negotiate requirements with executives and SMEs.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage follow-up and follow-through across multiple stakeholders and workstreams.

title: Designer
description:
goop kitchen is seeking a Designer to help shape and evolve the visual expression of the brand across every guest touchpoint. From social content and email campaigns to menus, packaging, restaurant signage, launch materials, and special projects, the role is responsible for creating thoughtful, elevated design that brings the brand to life.


The work spans concept and execution equally: generating original, culturally relevant creative concepts and bringing them to life across channels, grounded in design, photography, typography and visual storytelling. The role is hands-on, spanning digital and print, and moves between concepting a campaign, designing a menu, art directing a photoshoot, editing a social asset, and preparing production files, working closely with the Director, Social + content across all content and brand work. Creative judgment and high brand standards sit at the center of the role.


The ideal candidate is equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing quickly. They have strong digital and print experience, an obsessive attention to detail, and a willingness to roll up their sleeves—whether they're concepting a campaign, designing a menu, art directing a photoshoot, editing a social asset, or preparing production files. Above all, they must possess exceptional creative judgment and have impeccable taste.


Key Responsibilities


Brand Design

  • Create compelling, on-brand creative across all consumer-facing channels.
  • Help maintain the goop kitchen visual identity, ensuring consistency across digital and physical experiences.
  • Translate marketing objectives and creative direction into thoughtful creative concepts and polished design executions.
  • Contribute ideas that strengthen the brand and elevate the guest experience.

Digital Design + Content

  • Design assets for social media, email marketing, paid media, web, app, and growth.
  • Partner closely with the Director, Social + Content to develop engaging creative that is optimized for platform performance.
  • Create graphics, templates, story assets, Reel covers, and campaign creative that support content production.
  • Design with an understanding of both aesthetics and performance.

Print + Environmental Design

  • Design packaging, in-store collateral, signage, flyers, event materials, and launch assets.
  • Support restaurant openings and local marketing initiatives with thoughtful, brand-right creative.
  • Prepare production-ready files and manage projects through the print process.

Creative Production

  • Partner with Director, Social + Content on content shoots through creative planning, asset selection, and visual direction.
  • Collaborate with photographers, videographers, printers, and external partners as needed.
  • Build scalable templates and systems alongside the Director, Social + Content that help the marketing team move quickly while maintaining quality.
